object.zh: 桌子上那个奇怪的物体是什么？

object.en: I object to the new rules in our class.
object.zh: 我反对我们班的新规定。

possibility.en: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
We are exploring every possibility to solve this problem.
possibility.zh: 我们正在探索解决这个问题的每一种可能性。

means.en: The bus is the cheapest means of transport.
means.zh: 公共汽车是最便宜的交通工具。

means.en: He has the means to buy a new house.
means.zh: 他有能力买一栋新房子。

notice.en: Did you notice the change in her attitude?
notice.zh: 你注意到她态度的变化了吗？

notice.en: Please read the notice on the bulletin board.
notice.zh: 请阅读公告板上的通知。

agency.en: She works for a travel agency in the city.
agency.zh: 她在城里的一家旅行社工作。

agency.en: The government agency is responsible for public health.
agency.zh: 这个政府机构负责公共卫生。

collection.en: He has a large collection of stamps from around the world.
collection.zh: 他收藏了大量来自世界各地的邮票。

collection.en: The museum has a fine collection of paintings.
collection.zh: 博物馆收藏了一批精美的画作。

communication.en: Good communication is important in a team.
communication.zh: 良好的沟通在团队中很重要。

communication.en: Email is a common form of communication today.
communication.zh: 电子邮件是当今常见的交流方式。

considerable.en: She has considerable experience in teaching.
considerable.zh: 她有相当丰富的教学经验。

considerable.en: The project required a considerable amount of time.
considerable.zh: 这个项目需要相当多的时间。

arise.en: Problems may arise if we are not careful.
arise.zh: 如果我们不小心，可能会出现一些问题。

arise.en: A new opportunity arose for her career.
arise.zh: 她的职业生涯出现了一个新机会。

species.en: This species of bird is very rare.
Many species are in danger of extinction.
species.zh: 许多物种面临灭绝的危险。

physical.en: Regular physical exercise is good for health.
physical.zh: 定期的体育锻炼对健康有益。

physical.en: She needs a physical exam before starting the job.
physical.zh: 她需要在开始工作前进行体检。

examine.en: The doctor will examine your eyes carefully.
examine.zh: 医生会仔细检查你的眼睛。

examine.en: We need to examine the evidence before deciding.
examine.zh: 我们需要在决定之前检查证据。

document.en: Please sign this document before leaving.
document.zh: 请在离开前签署这份文件。

document.en: She needs to document all the steps of the experiment.
document.zh: 她需要记录实验的所有步骤。

define.en: Can you define the word 'freedom' for me?
define.zh: 你能为我定义‘自由’这个词吗？

define.en: The rules define what we can and cannot do.
define.zh: 这些规则规定了我们能做什么和不能做什么。

responsible.en: She is responsible for organizing the event.
He is a responsible person who always finishes his work.
responsible.zh: 他是一个负责任的人，总是完成他的工作。

career.en: She chose a career in medicine.
He had a successful career as a teacher.
career.zh: 他作为教师有一个成功的职业生涯。

solution.en: We found a solution to the problem.
solution.zh: 我们找到了问题的解决方案。

solution.en: Salt water is a solution of salt and water.

influence.en: Her words had a great influence on me.
influence.zh: 她的话对我有很大的影响。

influence.en: The media can influence public opinion.
influence.zh: 媒体可以影响公众舆论。

fear.en: She has a fear of flying in airplanes.
Don't fear making mistakes when learning English.
fear.zh: 学习英语时不要害怕犯错误。

opinion.en: In my opinion, this movie is very good.
opinion.zh: 在我看来，这部电影非常好。

opinion.en: Everyone has a right to their own opinion.
opinion.zh: 每个人都有权持有自己的意见。

medical.en: She needs medical attention for her injury.
He is studying medical science at university.
medical.zh: 他正在大学学习医学科学。

hang.en: Please hang your coat on the hook.
hang.zh: 请把你的外套挂在钩子上。

hang.en: The picture will hang above the sofa.
hang.zh: 这幅画将挂在沙发上方。

rock.en: The boat began to rock on the waves.
He threw a rock into the lake.
rock.zh: 他向湖里扔了一块石头。

district.en: This district has many good schools.
district.zh: 这个地区有很多好学校。

district.en: She lives in a quiet district of the city.
district.zh: 她住在城市的一个安静区域。

damage.en: The storm caused a lot of damage.
damage.zh: 暴风雨造成了大量损害。

damage.en: Please do not damage the furniture.

shake.en: The earthquake made the ground shake.
He gave the bottle a good shake.

requirement.en: This course has a reading requirement.
Meeting the requirement is important for graduation.
requirement.zh: 满足要求对毕业很重要。

organization.zh: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
良好的组织使工作更容易。

extra.en: I need an extra chair for the guest.
extra.zh: 我需要一把额外的椅子给客人。

extra.en: She works extra hours on weekends.

edge.en: The knife has a sharp edge.
edge.zh: 这把刀有一个锋利的刀刃。

edge.en: He stood at the edge of the cliff.

stock.en: The store has a large stock of shoes.
stock.zh: 这家店有大量的鞋子库存。

stock.en: She bought stock in a tech company.
stock.zh: 她购买了一家科技公司的股票。

exchange.en: We can exchange gifts after dinner.
exchange.zh: 我们可以在晚餐后交换礼物。

exchange.en: The exchange rate is very good today.

option.en: You have the option to choose any color.
option.zh: 你有选择任何颜色的选项。

option.en: This is the best option for us.
option.zh: 这是对我们最好的选择。

eventually.en: She will eventually finish her homework.
eventually.zh: 她最终会完成她的作业。

eventually.en: Eventually, they found the lost cat.
eventually.zh: 最后，他们找到了丢失的猫。

occasion.en: This is a special occasion for the family.
occasion.zh: 这对家人来说是一个特殊的场合。

highly.en: She is highly respected in her field.
highly.zh: 她在自己的领域非常受尊敬。

arrangement.en: We made an arrangement to meet at noon.

executive.en: The executive made an important decision.
executive.zh: 这位高管做了一个重要决定。

executive.en: She works as an executive in a bank.
executive.zh: 她在一家银行担任高管。

aid.en: First aid can save a person's life.
aid.zh: 急救可以挽救一个人的生命。

aid.en: The government sent aid to the flood victims.
aid.zh: 政府向洪水灾民提供了援助。

attend.en: I will attend the meeting tomorrow.

attend.zh: 她需要照顾生病的母亲。

concept.en: The concept of time is hard to explain.

concept.zh: 他在课堂上介绍了一个新概念。

lack.en: The plant died from lack of water.

lack.zh: 她在公开演讲方面缺乏自信。

sex.zh: 请在表格上填写你的姓名和性别。

sex.en: The doctor explained the differences between sex and gender.
sex.zh: 医生解释了性别和性别的差异。

race.en: He won the race by a small margin.
race.zh: 他以微弱优势赢得了比赛。

race.zh: 所有种族的人都住在这个城市。

forest.zh: 森林是许多动物的家园。

finger.en: She cut her finger while cooking.
He pointed his finger at the map.

slightly.en: The temperature dropped slightly at night.
She is slightly taller than her brother.
slightly.zh: 她比她哥哥稍微高一点。

scene.en: The crime scene was carefully examined.
scene.zh: 犯罪现场被仔细检查了。

scene.en: The sunset was a beautiful scene.
scene.zh: 日落是一个美丽的景象。

gain.en: She hopes to gain more experience.
The company made a big gain this year.
gain.zh: 公司今年获得了巨大收益。

equipment.en: The gym has new exercise equipment.
equipment.zh: 健身房有新的锻炼设备。

equipment.zh: 这次旅行我们需要露营装备。

speech.en: The president gave a long speech.
speech.zh: 总统做了一个长篇演讲。

speech.en: Her speech was clear and powerful.

message.en: I left a message on your phone.
message.zh: 我在你的手机上留了一条消息。

message.en: The message of the story is about kindness.
message.zh: 这个故事的主旨是关于善良。

peace.en: We all want peace in the world.
She enjoys the peace of the countryside.

crime.en: The police are fighting crime in the city.
crime.zh: 警察正在打击城市犯罪。
偷窃是一种严重的罪行。

male.en: The male lion has a big mane.
In many species, the male is larger.
male.zh: 在许多物种中，雄性体型更大。

review.en: I need to review my notes before the test.
review.zh: 考试前我需要复习笔记。

review.en: The book received a positive review.
review.zh: 这本书得到了正面评价。

employee.en: The employee works hard every day.
employee.zh: 这位员工每天努力工作。
这家公司有超过500名员工。

otherwise.en: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late.
He is healthy, otherwise he would not be here.
otherwise.zh: 他很健康，否则他不会在这里。

hardly.en: I can hardly hear you over the noise.
hardly.zh: 在噪音中我几乎听不到你。

status.en: What is the status of your application?
Her social status changed after the promotion.
status.zh: 升职后她的社会地位改变了。

perform.en: The singer will perform on stage tonight.
perform.zh: 这位歌手今晚将在舞台上表演。

perform.en: The doctor will perform the surgery tomorrow.

expression.en: Her expression showed she was happy.
expression.zh: 她的表情显示她很高兴。

expression.en: This is a common expression in English.
expression.zh: 这是英语中一个常见的表达。

christmas.en: We celebrate Christmas with our family.
christmas.zh: 我们和家人一起庆祝圣诞节。

christmas.en: Christmas is a time for giving gifts.
christmas.zh: 圣诞节是送礼物的时节。

sale.en: The store has a big sale today.
This house is for sale right now.

band.en: The band played music at the party.
band.zh: 乐队在派对上演奏音乐。

band.en: She wore a red band on her wrist.
band.zh: 她手腕上戴了一条红色带子。

directly.en: Please go directly to the office.
He looked directly at the teacher.

failure.en: Failure is part of learning new things.
failure.zh: 失败是学习新事物的一部分。

failure.en: The project was a complete failure.

reader.en: She is a fast reader of books.
reader.zh: 她是个读书很快的读者。

reader.en: The reader enjoyed the story very much.
reader.zh: 读者非常喜欢这个故事。

shoulder.en: He put his bag on his shoulder.
She will shoulder the responsibility alone.
shoulder.zh: 她将独自承担这个责任。

fair.en: The weather is fair and sunny today.
That was a fair decision by the judge.

protect.en: We must protect the environment for future.
protect.zh: 我们必须为未来保护环境。

protect.en: Sunscreen helps protect your skin from sun.
protect.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受日晒。

truth.en: Always tell the truth to your friends.
truth.zh: 永远对你的朋友说实话。

truth.en: The truth is sometimes hard to accept.

marriage.en: Their marriage lasted for fifty years.
marriage.zh: 他们的婚姻持续了五十年。

marriage.en: Marriage is a serious commitment between two people.
marriage.zh: 婚姻是两个人之间的严肃承诺。

essential.en: Water is essential for all living things.
essential.zh: 水对所有生物都是必要的。

essential.en: Good communication is essential in a team.
essential.zh: 良好的沟通在团队中至关重要。

confirm.en: Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
confirm.zh: 请在周五前确认你的出席。

confirm.en: The test results confirm the diagnosis.

adopt.en: They decided to adopt a child from abroad.
adopt.zh: 他们决定收养一个来自国外的孩子。

adopt.en: The company will adopt a new policy soon.
adopt.zh: 公司很快将采用一项新政策。

civil.en: Civil rights are important for everyone.
civil.zh: 公民权利对每个人都很重要。

civil.en: Please keep a civil tone during the debate.
civil.zh: 请在辩论中保持礼貌的语气。

trust.en: I trust my best friend completely.
trust.zh: 我完全信任我最好的朋友。

trust.en: Trust is the foundation of any relationship.
trust.zh: 信任是任何关系的基础。

completely.en: I completely agree with your opinion.
The task is completely finished now.

trial.en: The trial will begin next Monday morning.
trial.zh: 审判将于下周一早上开始。

trial.en: We need to run a trial of the software.
trial.zh: 我们需要对软件进行一次试验。

sentence.en: Please write a sentence using the new word.
sentence.zh: 请用这个新单词写一个句子。

sentence.en: The judge will sentence the criminal tomorrow.
sentence.zh: 法官明天将对罪犯宣判。

file.en: Please save the file on your computer.
file.zh: 请把文件保存在你的电脑上。

file.en: The students walked in a single file.
file.zh: 学生们排成一列纵队走。

primary.en: My primary goal is to learn English.
primary.zh: 我的主要目标是学英语。

primary.en: Primary school is for young children.
primary.zh: 小学是为年幼的孩子设立的。

obvious.en: The answer to the question was obvious.
It is obvious that she is very tired.

length.en: The length of the table is two meters.
The movie has a length of two hours.
length.zh: 这部电影的长度是两小时。

nation.en: The whole nation celebrated the victory.
China is a large nation with rich history.
nation.zh: 中国是一个历史悠久的泱泱大国。

branch.en: The bird sat on a tree branch.
The bank has a branch in our town.
branch.zh: 这家银行在我们镇上有一个分行。

doubt.en: I doubt that he will come on time.
doubt.zh: 我怀疑他是否会准时来。

doubt.en: There is no doubt about her honesty.

pain.en: She felt a sharp pain in her leg.
The pain of losing a friend is real.
pain.zh: 失去朋友的痛苦是真实的。

accident.en: He had a car accident last night.
The accident happened because of the rain.
accident.zh: 事故是因为下雨发生的。

spirit.en: She has a very strong and brave spirit.
spirit.zh: 她有非常坚强勇敢的精神。

spirit.en: The holiday spirit filled the whole house.
spirit.zh: 节日的气氛充满了整个房子。

stare.en: Don't stare at people; it's rude.
stare.zh: 不要盯着人看，那是不礼貌的。

stare.en: He gave her a long, hard stare.
stare.zh: 他长时间地、用力地凝视着她。

strength.en: He has great physical strength for his age.
strength.zh: 就他的年龄而言，他体力很强。

strength.en: Her strength lies in her patience.
strength.zh: 她的长处在于她的耐心。

normally.en: I normally wake up at seven o'clock.

contact.en: Please contact me if you need help.
contact.zh: 如果你需要帮助，请联系我。

contact.en: Eye contact is important in conversation.
contact.zh: 眼神交流在对话中很重要。

imagine.en: Imagine a world without any pollution.
imagine.zh: 想象一个没有污染的世界。

imagine.en: Can you imagine living on another planet?
imagine.zh: 你能想象生活在另一个星球上吗？

positive.en: Try to keep a positive attitude every day.
positive.zh: 试着每天保持积极的态度。

positive.en: The test result came back positive.

official.en: The official announcement will be made soon.
official.zh: 官方公告很快就会发布。

official.en: He is a government official in the city.
official.zh: 他是这座城市的一名政府官员。

shape.en: The table has a round shape.
Exercise helps shape your body well.
shape.zh: 锻炼有助于塑造你的好身材。

contribution.en: Her contribution to the team was valuable.
contribution.zh: 她对团队的贡献很有价值。

contribution.en: Thank you for your generous contribution.

transport.en: Buses are a common form of transport.
transport.zh: 公交车是一种常见的交通方式。

transport.en: The truck will transport the goods tomorrow.
transport.zh: 卡车明天将运输这些货物。

senior.en: She is a senior manager at the company.
My senior brother helped me with homework.

cash.en: I need to cash this check today.
cash.zh: 我今天需要兑现这张支票。

cash.en: Do you have enough cash for lunch?
cash.zh: 你有足够的现金吃午饭吗？

The gas stove heats the water quickly.

born.en: She was born in a small town.
He is a born leader and teacher.
born.zh: 他是天生的领导者和老师。

museum.en: We visited the art museum yesterday.
museum.zh: 我们昨天参观了艺术博物馆。

museum.en: The museum has many ancient artifacts.
museum.zh: 博物馆有许多古代文物。

debate.en: They will debate the new policy tomorrow.
debate.zh: 他们明天将辩论新政策。

debate.en: The debate lasted for two hours.

reform.en: The government plans to reform the system.
reform.zh: 政府计划改革这个系统。

reform.en: Education reform is very important now.
reform.zh: 教育改革现在非常重要。

annual.en: We have an annual meeting every March.
The annual report shows good results.
annual.zh: 年度报告显示了好结果。

associate.en: She is my associate at work.
I associate this song with summer.
associate.zh: 我把这首歌和夏天联系起来。

marry.en: They plan to marry next spring.
marry.zh: 他们计划明年春天结婚。

marry.en: He wants to marry his best friend.
marry.zh: 他想和他最好的朋友结婚。

artist.en: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
artist.zh: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。

artist.en: She is a famous artist in Japan.
artist.zh: 她是日本著名的艺术家。

presence.en: Her presence made everyone feel calm.
presence.zh: 她的在场让每个人都感到平静。

presence.en: I felt his presence in the room.

protection.en: Wear a hat for sun protection.
The forest needs protection from fire.

nuclear.en: Nuclear energy is a powerful resource.
nuclear.zh: 核能是一种强大的资源。
他们讨论了核安全问题。

collect.en: I like to collect stamps from different countries.
collect.zh: 我喜欢收集不同国家的邮票。

collect.en: Please collect your books from the table.
collect.zh: 请从桌子上拿走你的书。

queen.en: The queen wore a beautiful crown.
queen.zh: 女王戴了一顶美丽的王冠。

queen.en: She is the queen of the chessboard.

master.en: He wants to master the piano.
The dog knows its master well.

candidate.en: She is a candidate for the job.
candidate.zh: 她是这份工作的候选人。

candidate.en: The candidate gave a good speech.
candidate.zh: 候选人做了一个很好的演讲。

vote.en: Please vote for your favorite song.
vote.zh: 请为你最喜欢的歌曲投票。

vote.en: The vote was close but fair.

huge.en: The elephant is a huge animal.
huge.zh: 大象是一种巨大的动物。

huge.en: They built a huge building downtown.
huge.zh: 他们在市中心建了一栋巨大的建筑。

employ.en: The company will employ more workers.
She is employed as a teacher.

release.en: The movie will release next month.
Please release the bird from the cage.
release.zh: 请把鸟从笼子里放出来。

consequence.en: The consequence of rain is wet ground.
consequence.zh: 下雨的后果是地面湿了。

commercial.en: I saw a commercial for a new phone.
commercial.zh: 我看到一个新手机的广告。

commercial.en: Commercial flights are very common now.

adult.en: An adult must sign the form.
adult.zh: 必须由成年人签署表格。

adult.en: She is an adult with a good job.
adult.zh: 她是一个有份好工作的成年人。

relatively.en: This task is relatively easy for me.
relatively.zh: 这个任务对我来说相对容易。

relatively.en: The weather is relatively warm today.

slowly.en: Please speak slowly so I understand.
slowly.zh: 请慢慢说，这样我能理解。

relevant.en: This information is relevant to our project.
relevant.zh: 这个信息与我们的项目相关。

beginning.en: The beginning of the story is exciting.
beginning.zh: 故事的开头很激动人心。

beginning.en: We are at the beginning of the year.

safe.en: Keep your money in a safe place.
safe.zh: 把你的钱放在安全的地方。

safe.en: The children are safe at home.

proportion.en: The proportion of water to land is large.

consideration.en: Please give this matter careful consideration.
He showed consideration for her feelings.

africa.en: She traveled to Africa last summer.
africa.zh: 她去年夏天去了非洲旅行。

latter.en: The latter part of the book is boring.

emerge.en: The sun will emerge from the clouds.

emerge.zh: 新想法常在讨论中出现。

mark.en: She got a high mark on the test.

separate.en: Please separate the white and black socks.
separate.zh: 请把白袜子和黑袜子分开。

separate.en: They live in separate houses now.
separate.zh: 他们现在住在不同的房子里。

shoot.zh: 植物很快就会长出新叶。

deny.en: She cannot deny her love for music.
deny.zh: 她无法否认对音乐的热爱。

practical.en: This is a practical solution to the problem.
practical.zh: 这是一个实际解决问题的方法。

practical.en: She has a lot of practical experience.

understanding.en: She has a deep understanding of math.

fountain.zh: 公园里有一个美丽的喷泉。

cellar.en: They store wine in the cellar.

carrot.zh: 兔子喜欢吃新鲜的胡萝卜。

carrot.zh: 她把磨碎的胡萝卜加到沙拉里。

procession.zh: 一支长长的队伍在街上行进。

honourable.zh: 他是一个正直诚实的人。

honourable.en: It was an honourable decision to make.
honourable.zh: 这是一个值得尊敬的决定。

sticky.zh: 她的手因果汁而变得粘粘的。

infinite.zh: 她对孩子有无限的耐心。

plaster.zh: 他在割伤的手指上贴了膏药。

Pigeons are common in city parks.
pigeon.zh: 鸽子在城市公园里很常见。

whip.zh: 他甩响鞭子给马发信号。

photographic.zh: 她对面孔有摄影般的记忆力。

photographic.zh: 他买了一台新的照相机。

choke.zh: 他开始被一块肉噎住了。

hen.zh: 母鸡保护她的小鸡免受危险。

cushion.zh: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子。

textbook.zh: 我需要一本新的数学课本。

textbook.zh: 课本清楚地解释了规则。

immigrant.zh: 她是一位来自墨西哥的移民。

virtual.zh: 这个游戏创造了一个虚拟世界。

stack.zh: 他把一摞书放在桌子上。

spoon.zh: 请递给我一个勺子好吗？

wagon.zh: 农夫驾驶一辆装满干草的马车。

wagon.en: The children played with a toy wagon.
wagon.zh: 孩子们玩着一辆玩具马车。

bake.zh: 她会为派对烤一个蛋糕。

tomb.zh: 这座古墓被考古学家发现了。

tomb.zh: 他们参观了国王的陵墓。

detection.zh: 疾病的早期检测能挽救生命。

detection.zh: 烟雾的探测触发了警报。

physician.zh: 我的医生建议我多锻炼。

infect.zh: 这种病毒能感染很多人。

livestock.zh: 农夫在他的土地上饲养家畜。

livestock.zh: 家畜每天都需要食物和水。

optical.zh: 他买了一个新的光学鼠标。

optical.en: Optical illusions can trick your eyes.
optical.zh: 视错觉能欺骗你的眼睛。

velvet.zh: 这条裙子是用柔软的天鹅绒做的。

velvet.zh: 她轻轻地摸了摸天鹅绒布料。

indoor.zh: 因为下雨，我们玩了室内游戏。

reliance.zh: 我们应该减少对石油的依赖。

glow.en: The stars glow brightly in the sky.
glow.zh: 星星在天空中明亮地发光。

glow.en: Her face had a healthy glow after exercise.
glow.zh: 运动后她的脸上有健康的光泽。

conductor.zh: 指挥家优美地指挥了管弦乐队。

conductor.en: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.

orbit.en: The satellite orbits the Earth every day.
orbit.zh: 卫星每天绕地球轨道运行。

orbit.en: The planet's orbit is nearly circular.
orbit.zh: 这颗行星的轨道几乎是圆形的。

rotation.en: The Earth's rotation causes day and night.
rotation.zh: 地球的自转导致昼夜交替。

rotation.en: Crop rotation helps keep soil healthy.
rotation.zh: 轮作有助于保持土壤健康。

undergraduate.zh: 她是大学的一名本科生。

groan.en: He let out a groan of pain.
groan.zh: 他发出了一声痛苦的呻吟。

groan.zh: 你走的时候旧地板会嘎吱作响。

lick.zh: 她快速地舔了一下冰淇淋。

The preceding year was very difficult.

proportional.en: The cost is proportional to the size.
The punishment should be proportional to the crime.

odour.en: A strange odour came from the kitchen.
odour.zh: 一股奇怪的气味从厨房传来。

odour.en: The flower has a sweet odour.

ski.en: They like to ski in the mountains.

noun.en: A noun is a word for a person or thing.
noun.zh: 名词是表示人或事物的词。

noun.en: The word 'dog' is a common noun.

nitrogen.en: Nitrogen is a gas in the air.
nitrogen.zh: 氮是空气中的一种气体。

nitrogen.en: Plants need nitrogen to grow well.
nitrogen.zh: 植物需要氮才能良好生长。

oblige.zh: 法律强制父母送孩子上学。

turning.en: Take the next turning on the left.

noticeable.en: There was a noticeable change in the weather.

noticeable.zh: 他衬衫上的污渍非常显眼。

enlarge.en: You can enlarge the photo on your computer.
enlarge.zh: 你可以在电脑上放大这张照片。

enlarge.en: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
enlarge.zh: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。

heal.en: The cut on my finger will heal soon.
heal.zh: 我手指上的伤口很快就会愈合。

heal.en: Time can heal a broken heart.
heal.zh: 时间可以治愈破碎的心。

vacant.zh: 她带着茫然的表情凝视着。

spark.zh: 火里迸出的火星烫伤了他的手。

spark.zh: 她的演讲激发了很多兴趣。

gratitude.zh: 她用温暖的拥抱表达了感激之情。

gratitude.en: I feel deep gratitude for your help.
gratitude.zh: 我对你的帮助深表感激。

destructive.zh: 这场风暴对小镇破坏性很大。
破坏性行为会伤害人际关系。

sadness.en: He felt great sadness after losing his pet.
sadness.zh: 失去宠物后他感到非常悲伤。

sadness.en: Her eyes were full of sadness.

humble.en: He is a humble and kind person.
humble.zh: 他是一个谦逊而善良的人。

humble.en: They live in a humble little house.
humble.zh: 他们住在一间简陋的小房子里。

tidy.en: She tidied up the desk before leaving.
tidy.zh: 她在离开前整理了书桌。

hardship.en: They faced many hardships during the war.
hardship.zh: 他们在战争期间面临许多苦难。

hardship.en: Hardship can make a person stronger.

adhere.en: The sticker will adhere to the wall.

tolerance.en: We should show tolerance to others.
tolerance.zh: 我们应该对他人表现出宽容。

tolerance.en: He has a low tolerance for cold weather.
tolerance.zh: 他对寒冷天气的忍耐力很低。

shepherd.en: The shepherd led his sheep to the field.
shepherd.zh: 牧羊人把羊群带到田野。

shepherd.zh: 他会带领孩子们过马路。

hopeless.en: He felt hopeless after failing the exam.
hopeless.zh: 考试失败后他感到绝望。

lightning.en: The lightning lit up the whole sky.

lightning.zh: 我们看到远处有一道闪电。

veteran.zh: 我的祖父是一位退伍军人。

veteran.zh: 她是一位有二十年经验的老教师。

unsatisfactory.zh: 他的工作表现不令人满意。

thrive.en: Plants thrive in good soil and sunlight.
thrive.zh: 植物在良好的土壤和阳光下茁壮成长。

thrive.zh: 变革之后，生意开始兴旺起来。

slogan.zh: 这家公司的口号很朗朗上口。

slogan.zh: 他们在抗议中高喊口号。

jewel.zh: 她脖子上戴着一颗美丽的珠宝。

cultivate.zh: 农民耕种土地以种植庄稼。

cultivate.zh: 你应该尽早培养好习惯。

undo.zh: 请解开你衬衫上的纽扣。

mat.en: Wipe your feet on the mat before entering.

mat.zh: 她在热锅下面放了一个垫子。

feasible.zh: 他们找到了一个可行的解决方案。

technician.en: The technician repaired my computer quickly.
technician.zh: 技师很快修好了我的电脑。

rotten.en: The apple is rotten and smells bad.
rotten.zh: 这个苹果腐烂了，闻起来很臭。

rotten.en: Rotten wood cannot be used for building.
rotten.zh: 腐烂的木头不能用于建筑。

imprison.zh: 法庭决定监禁这名罪犯。

sew.en: She can sew a button on a shirt.
sew.zh: 她会把纽扣缝在衬衫上。

sew.zh: 我的祖母教我如何缝纫。

harmful.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.

playground.en: The children are playing in the playground.

cue.zh: 她从导演的点头中得到了提示。

bud.en: The rose bud will open soon.

superficial.en: His knowledge of history is superficial.
superficial.zh: 他对历史的了解很肤浅。

superficial.zh: 她只在纸上划了一道浅浅的口子。

meadow.en: The cows graze in the green meadow.
meadow.zh: 牛群在绿色的草地上吃草。

meadow.zh: 我们在阳光明媚的草地上野餐。

scenery.en: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.

scenery.zh: 我们欣赏了河边的风景。

mankind.zh: 人类在科学上取得了巨大进步。

mankind.zh: 和平对全人类都很重要。

collision.en: The two cars were in a collision.

collision.zh: 高速公路上的碰撞造成了延误。

thickness.en: The wall has a thickness of two feet.

peel.en: Please peel the apple before eating it.

hillside.en: The house is built on a hillside.

greeting.en: He gave me a friendly greeting.
greeting.zh: 他给了我一个友好的问候。

greeting.en: A simple greeting can make someone happy.
greeting.zh: 一个简单的问候能让人开心。

voyage.en: They went on a long sea voyage.
voyage.zh: 他们进行了一次漫长的海上航行。

voyage.zh: 横渡大洋的航程花了三周。

pea.zh: 她在汤里加了一些豌豆。

helpless.zh: 小鸟在地上看起来很无助。

helpless.zh: 手机没电时他感到无能为力。

conquest.zh: 军队庆祝他们征服了这座城市。

conquest.en: Her conquest of fear was a big achievement.
conquest.zh: 她战胜恐惧是一个巨大的成就。

sore.en: My throat is sore from shouting.
sore.zh: 我的喉咙因为喊叫而疼痛。

sore.en: He has a sore on his foot.

slender.en: The slender tree swayed in the wind.

picnic.en: We had a picnic in the park.

picnic.zh: 这个周末我们去野餐吧。

sandy.en: The beach has soft sandy shores.
sandy.zh: 海滩有柔软的沙质海岸。

interruption.en: Sorry for the interruption during your speech.
interruption.zh: 抱歉在你演讲时打扰了。

interruption.en: The phone call was an unwelcome interruption.
interruption.zh: 那个电话是个不受欢迎的中断。

hay.en: The farmer stores hay for the winter.

dam.en: The dam holds back the river water.

dam.zh: 他们建了一座水坝来造湖。

strap.en: He used a strap to tie the box.
strap.zh: 他用一根带子捆住箱子。

strap.en: The bag has a long shoulder strap.

moan.en: He let out a moan of pain.
moan.zh: 他发出了一声痛苦的呻吟。

moan.en: She moaned about the long wait.

thunder.en: The thunder was very loud last night.

comrade.zh: 他在战争中与战友并肩作战。

comrade.zh: 我的伙伴帮我完成了项目。

abnormal.zh: 反常的天气模式令人担忧。

scarf.en: She wore a warm scarf around her neck.
scarf.zh: 她脖子上围了一条温暖的围巾。

scarf.en: He bought a silk scarf as a gift.
scarf.zh: 他买了一条丝巾作为礼物。

vase.en: She put flowers in the vase.

revolt.en: The people rose in revolt against the king.

excursion.en: We went on an excursion to the mountains.
excursion.zh: 我们去山里远足了一次。

excursion.zh: 学校组织了一次去博物馆的短途旅行。

cloak.zh: 他肩上披着一件黑色斗篷。

cloak.en: The fog served as a cloak for their escape.
cloak.zh: 雾气成了他们逃跑的掩护。

thirdly.zh: 第三，我们需要考虑成本。

thirdly.zh: 第三，我想感谢我的家人。

upright.en: Please stand upright during the ceremony.

upright.zh: 他是一个正直诚实的人。

submarine.zh: 他们乘坐潜水艇探索海洋。

athlete.zh: 她是一位热爱运动的有天赋的运动员。

decree.en: The king issued a new decree.

ironically.zh: 讽刺的是，他在雨中丢了伞。

ironically.zh: 她对评论讽刺地笑了笑。

admiration.zh: 他带着赞赏看着那幅画。

foster.zh: 他们培养孩子们对阅读的热爱。

mighty.en: The mighty river flows through the valley.

combat.en: Soldiers train for combat every day.
combat.zh: 士兵们每天为战斗训练。

meaningful.zh: 她意味深长地看了他一眼。

meaningful.en: We had a meaningful conversation today.
meaningful.zh: 我们今天进行了一次有意义的谈话。

irony.zh: 这种情况的讽刺意味很明显。

offspring.zh: 他们的后代都很有才华。

evoke.en: The song can evoke happy memories.
evoke.zh: 这首歌能唤起快乐的回忆。

evoke.zh: 她的演讲在我们心中引起了强烈的情感。

monarch.zh: 这位君主统治了这个国家几十年。

absorption.zh: 植物吸收水分至关重要。

literacy.zh: 这个项目旨在提高成人读写能力。

trivial.zh: 别担心这些琐碎的事情。

fragile.zh: 玻璃很易碎，所以要小心拿放。

offensive.zh: 他粗鲁的评论对大家来说非常冒犯。

offensive.zh: 军队在黎明发动了进攻。

disrupt.zh: 巨大的噪音打断了我们的课堂讨论。

disrupt.zh: 恶劣天气容易打乱旅行计划。

distract.zh: 我学习时请不要打扰我。

distract.zh: 电话铃声分散了她工作的注意力。

bleak.zh: 这个小镇的前景似乎很荒凉。

defy.zh: 孩子违抗父母，在外面待到很晚。

shatter.zh: 玻璃杯掉到地上时摔碎了。

shatter.zh: 坏消息粉碎了她所有的希望。

disperse.zh: 风帮助把种子散布到田野各处。

ascertain.zh: 我们需要查明事情的真相。

kidney.zh: 他把一个肾捐给了他的兄弟。

eternal.zh: 永恒的火焰在纪念地点燃烧。

royalty.zh: 作者从图书销售中获得版税。

royalty.zh: 皇室成员经常参加正式活动。

denial.zh: 他对指控的否认并不令人信服。

unprecedented.en: The storm caused unprecedented damage to the area.
unprecedented.zh: 风暴对该地区造成了前所未有的破坏。

unprecedented.zh: 这一成功在我们公司史上是空前的。

gossip.zh: 不要相信你在工作中听到的流言。

hospitality.zh: 感谢你在我访问期间的热情款待。

hospitality.zh: 这家酒店以出色的款待而闻名。

dentist.zh: 牙医清洁了我的牙齿并检查了蛀牙。

instructor.zh: 驾驶教练教我如何停车。

instructor.zh: 我们的讲师非常清楚地解释了这课。

detain.zh: 我在机场被耽搁了一个小时。

solitary.en: He lives a solitary life in the mountains.
solitary.zh: 他在山里过着孤独的生活。

haunt.zh: 事故的记忆仍然萦绕在她心头。

ethics.zh: 医生必须遵守严格的医学道德规范。

disposition.en: She has a cheerful disposition that everyone likes.

disposition.zh: 家具的布置让房间看起来更大。

violation.en: This is a violation of the law.

violation.zh: 违规行为导致了大问题。

transit.en: The goods are in transit now.

transit.zh: 我们每天使用公共交通。

decorative.zh: 她给沙发加了装饰性靠垫。

pronounced.en: She has a pronounced accent when speaking English.
pronounced.zh: 她说英语时带有明显的口音。

imposing.en: The building was large and imposing.

imposing.zh: 他在房间里有一种威严的气场。

lucrative.en: She found a lucrative job in finance.
lucrative.zh: 她在金融领域找到了一份利润丰厚的工作。

lucrative.zh: 这笔生意非常有利可图。

dire.en: The country is in dire need of food.

dire.zh: 他们的行为导致了可怕的后果。

succumb.en: He succumbed to the pressure and quit.

emanate.en: A strange sound emanated from the room.

mar.en: Rain marred our plans for a picnic.

ration.zh: 每个士兵每天得到一份面包配给。

entrust.zh: 我把这项重要任务托付给你。

entrust.zh: 她把钥匙委托给了一个朋友。

sever.zh: 他们决定断绝商业关系。

saga.zh: 这个家族传奇跨越了三代人。

saga.zh: 他给我们讲了一个关于他冒险的传奇故事。

redeem.zh: 她用优惠券兑换了一杯免费饮料。

redeem.en: He tried to redeem his reputation after the mistake.
redeem.zh: 他在犯错后试图挽回自己的声誉。

upheaval.zh: 政治剧变带来了许多变化。

rewarding.zh: 志愿工作可以是一种有益的体验。

defer.en: We decided to defer the meeting until next week.
defer.zh: 我们决定把会议推迟到下周。

defer.en: I defer to your expertise on this matter.
defer.zh: 在这件事上，我听从你的专业意见。

curtail.en: The company had to curtail its spending.

curtail.zh: 恶劣天气减少了我们的户外活动。

relinquish.en: He refused to relinquish his control.
relinquish.zh: 他拒绝放弃他的控制权。

relinquish.en: She had to relinquish her seat to an elderly man.
relinquish.zh: 她不得不把座位让给一位老人。

dispel.zh: 她友善的话语驱散了我的恐惧。

derelict.zh: 那座旧楼现在被废弃了，空无一人。

contingent.en: Our plans are contingent on the weather.
contingent.zh: 我们的计划取决于天气。

rejoin.en: He will rejoin his family for the holidays.
rejoin.zh: 他将在假期与家人重聚。

banish.en: She tried to banish all negative thoughts.

unaffected.en: She remained unaffected by the criticism.

unaffected.zh: 他自然的态度让人容易交谈。

backdrop.zh: 山脉构成了照片的美丽背景。

backdrop.zh: 红色窗帘用作简单的背景幕。

oversee.zh: 她监督团队的日常工作。

arrogance.zh: 他的傲慢使他在工作中不受欢迎。

intercept.zh: 警察拦截了被盗的汽车。

intercept.zh: 她试图在球落下之前截住它。

bland.zh: 这食物对我来说太乏味了。

bland.zh: 他露出一个温和的微笑，什么也没说。

awe.en: The children looked at the stars in awe.
awe.zh: 孩子们敬畏地看着星星。

nostalgia.zh: 那首老歌让她充满了怀旧之情。

nostalgia.zh: 他对童年的家感到乡愁。

hypothetical.zh: 让我们考虑一个假设的情况。

hypothetical.en: This is just a hypothetical question.

stipulate.zh: 合同规定了付款截止日期。

stipulate.zh: 他们规定所有工人都必须戴头盔。

instinctive.en: Her instinctive reaction was to run away.

instinctive.zh: 鸟类有飞往南方的本能能力。

supersede.zh: 对许多人来说，电子书已经取代了纸质书。

bonnet.en: She wore a warm bonnet in the winter.
bonnet.zh: 她在冬天戴了一顶保暖的软帽。

bonnet.zh: 婴儿的软帽上有一个可爱的小蝴蝶结。

recourse.zh: 他除了接受提议别无他法。

glowing.en: She received a glowing review for her work.
glowing.zh: 她的工作获得了热烈的评价。

subside.en: The pain began to subside after taking medicine.

intuitive.zh: 她对问题有一种直觉的理解。

immaculate.zh: 她的房子总是洁净整齐。

immaculate.zh: 他穿着一尘不染的白色西装去参加派对。

rift.en: A deep rift formed between the two friends.
rift.zh: 两个朋友之间出现了深深的裂痕。

hereditary.zh: 这种疾病在他们家族中是遗传的。

hereditary.zh: 他从父亲那里继承了世袭的头衔。

martial.zh: 暴乱后该国宣布了军事管制。

floppy.en: The puppy had floppy ears that hung down.
floppy.zh: 小狗有松软下垂的耳朵。

scoop.en: She used a scoop to get ice cream.

lust.en: He was driven by lust for power and money.
lust.zh: 他被对权力和金钱的贪欲所驱使。

lust.zh: 这部小说探讨了爱与欲望的主题。

falter.en: She did not falter when facing the challenge.
falter.zh: 面对挑战时她没有蹒跚退缩。

aristocracy.zh: 历史上贵族拥有巨大权力。

aristocracy.zh: 许多贵族成员拥有大庄园。

purport.zh: 这份文件的目的在于澄清规则。

purport.zh: 他声称自己是该话题的专家。

prerogative.zh: 赦免罪犯是国王的特权。

prerogative.en: Choosing your own path is a personal prerogative.
prerogative.zh: 选择自己的道路是个人的特权。

dodge.zh: 她试图避开关于她计划的问题。

cerebral.zh: 这部电影非常理性且发人深省。

barrage.en: The soldiers faced a barrage of enemy fire.

glimmer.en: A glimmer of light appeared in the dark room.
glimmer.zh: 一丝光线出现在黑暗的房间里。

glimmer.en: She saw a glimmer of hope in his eyes.
glimmer.zh: 她在他眼中看到了一丝希望。

entourage.en: The president traveled with a large entourage.
entourage.zh: 总统带着一大群随行人员旅行。

entourage.en: Her entourage included several assistants and guards.
entourage.zh: 她的陪同人员包括几名助理和保镖。

crafty.en: The crafty fox tricked the farmer.
crafty.zh: 那只狡诈的狐狸欺骗了农夫。

crafty.en: He used a crafty plan to win the game.
crafty.zh: 他用了一个巧妙的计划赢得了比赛。

conciliatory.en: She made a conciliatory gesture to end the fight.
conciliatory.zh: 她做了一个安抚的姿态来结束争吵。

conciliatory.en: His conciliatory words helped calm everyone down.
conciliatory.zh: 他安抚的话语帮助大家平静下来。

avalanche.en: The avalanche buried the small village.
avalanche.zh: 雪崩掩埋了那个小村庄。

avalanche.en: An avalanche of emails flooded her inbox.
avalanche.zh: 大量电子邮件涌入了她的收件箱。

oversight.en: The error was due to an oversight.
oversight.zh: 这个错误是由于疏忽造成的。

oversight.en: She has oversight of the entire project.

enunciate.zh: 请清晰地发音你的词语。

enunciate.en: He enunciated his plan to the team.
enunciate.zh: 他向团队明确地叙述了他的计划。

custodian.en: The custodian cleans the school every night.
He is the custodian of the museum's collection.
custodian.zh: 他是博物馆收藏品的管理人。

copious.en: She took copious notes during the lecture.
copious.zh: 她在讲座中做了大量的笔记。

copious.en: The garden produced copious amounts of vegetables.
copious.zh: 花园产出了丰富的蔬菜。

detest.en: I detest getting up early in the morning.
She detests people who lie to her.

retainer.en: The lawyer asked for a retainer before starting work.
retainer.zh: 律师在开始工作前要求预付费用。

retainer.en: She wears a retainer to keep her teeth straight.
retainer.zh: 她戴保持器来保持牙齿整齐。

espionage.en: He was arrested for industrial espionage.
espionage.zh: 他因工业间谍活动被捕。

espionage.en: Espionage is a serious crime in many countries.
espionage.zh: 间谍活动在许多国家是严重的犯罪。

accede.en: The prince acceded to the throne last year.
She acceded to our request for help.
accede.zh: 她同意了我们寻求帮助的请求。

taxing.en: The long hike was very taxing on my legs.
taxing.zh: 长途徒步对我的腿来说非常费力。

taxing.en: This job is mentally taxing but rewarding.
taxing.zh: 这份工作精神上很繁重但有回报。

seminal.en: His book was a seminal work in biology.
seminal.zh: 他的书是生物学领域的开创性著作。

seminal.en: The scientist made a seminal discovery.
seminal.zh: 那位科学家做出了开创性的发现。

languish.en: The plant languished without enough water.
He languished in prison for many years.
languish.zh: 他在监狱中憔悴了许多年。

embroil.en: She was embroiled in a heated argument.
embroil.zh: 她被卷入了一场激烈的争论。

embroil.en: Don't embroil me in your problems.
embroil.zh: 别把我牵连进你的问题里。

veritable.en: The garden was a veritable paradise.
veritable.zh: 那个花园简直是名副其实的天堂。

veritable.en: He is a veritable expert on the subject.
veritable.zh: 他是这个主题上名副其实的专家。

tether.en: The farmer tethered the goat to a tree.
She felt tethered to her desk all day.
tether.zh: 她感觉整天被束缚在办公桌前。

obviate.en: Good planning can obviate many problems.
obviate.zh: 好的计划可以避免许多问题。

obviate.en: This new tool obviates the need for manual work.
obviate.zh: 这个新工具使手工劳动成为不必要。

dilapidated.en: The old house was dilapidated and unsafe.
dilapidated.zh: 那栋旧房子破败不堪且不安全。

dilapidated.en: They lived in a dilapidated building.
dilapidated.zh: 他们住在一栋荒废的楼房里。

dabble.en: She likes to dabble in painting on weekends.
dabble.zh: 她喜欢在周末涉猎绘画。

dabble.en: The children dabble their feet in the water.
dabble.zh: 孩子们把脚浸在水里玩水。

circumstantial.en: He gave a circumstantial account of the event.
circumstantial.zh: 他对事件做了详细的描述。

agile.en: The agile cat jumped over the fence.
agile.zh: 那只敏捷的猫跳过了篱笆。

agile.en: She is an agile thinker in meetings.

accolade.en: She received an accolade for her work.
The award was a great accolade for the team.
accolade.zh: 这个奖项是对团队极大的赞美。

absolve.en: The court absolved him of all charges.
absolve.zh: 法庭宣告他无罪，免除所有指控。

absolve.en: She absolved herself from the responsibility.

stocky.en: The stocky man lifted the heavy box easily.
stocky.zh: 那个矮胖结实的男人轻松地举起了重箱子。

stocky.en: He has a stocky build from years of labor.
stocky.zh: 他因多年劳动而身材健壮结实。

engaging.en: She has an engaging smile that lights up the room.
engaging.zh: 她有迷人的微笑，照亮了整个房间。

engaging.en: The story was so engaging that I couldn't stop reading.
engaging.zh: 故事如此引人入胜，我无法停止阅读。

drench.zh: 雨水把我们完全湿透了。

drench.en: He drenched the plants with water.

coerce.en: They tried to coerce him into signing the contract.
coerce.zh: 他们试图强迫他签署合同。

coerce.en: No one should coerce you to do something wrong.
coerce.zh: 没有人应该强迫你做错事。

anathema.en: The idea was anathema to the community.
anathema.zh: 这个想法对社区来说是可憎的。

pitiful.zh: 被遗弃的小狗看起来很可怜。

pitiful.en: His pitiful excuse did not convince anyone.
pitiful.zh: 他可鄙的借口没有说服任何人。

gratification.en: Eating chocolate gives me instant gratification.
gratification.zh: 吃巧克力给我即时的满足。

gratification.en: She felt gratification after finishing the project.
gratification.zh: 完成项目后她感到喜悦。

virtuous.en: She is a virtuous person who always helps others.
virtuous.zh: 她是一个品德高尚的人，总是帮助别人。

virtuous.en: He led a virtuous life full of good deeds.
virtuous.zh: 他过着充满善行的正直生活。

mania.en: He has a mania for collecting stamps.
mania.zh: 他对集邮有狂热的爱好。

mania.en: The mania for social media is widespread.
mania.zh: 对社交媒体的狂热很普遍。

contravene.en: His actions contravene the company's rules.
contravene.zh: 他的行为违反了公司的规定。
这条法律与宪法相抵触。

barricade.en: The police set up a barricade on the street.
barricade.zh: 警察在街上设置了路障。

barricade.en: They barricaded the door to keep intruders out.
barricade.zh: 他们用障碍物堵住门以防入侵者。

fodder.en: The farmer stored hay as fodder for the cows.
fodder.zh: 农夫储存干草作为奶牛的饲料。

fodder.en: The scandal provided fodder for the media.
fodder.zh: 丑闻为媒体提供了素材。

amicable.zh: 他们达成了友好的协议。

ravage.en: The storm ravaged the coastal town.
War ravaged the country for years.
ravage.zh: 战争蹂躏了这个国家多年。

propriety.en: She always acts with propriety at formal dinners.
propriety.zh: 她在正式晚宴上总是举止得体。

propriety.en: Propriety demands we dress appropriately for the ceremony.
propriety.zh: 礼节要求我们为仪式穿着得体。

prodigious.en: The storm caused prodigious damage to the coast.
prodigious.zh: 风暴对海岸造成了巨大的破坏。

prodigious.en: He has a prodigious talent for playing the piano.
prodigious.zh: 他有弹钢琴的惊人天赋。

subsume.en: This rule subsumes all the previous guidelines.
subsume.zh: 这条规则包含了所有以前的指导方针。

subsume.en: The new category subsumes several older ones.
subsume.zh: 新类别将几个旧类别归入其中。

serene.en: The lake looked serene in the morning light.
serene.zh: 湖面在晨光中显得宁静。

serene.en: She remained serene despite the chaos around her.
serene.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，她依然保持平静。

scourge.en: War is a terrible scourge for humanity.
scourge.zh: 战争是人类可怕的灾祸。

scourge.en: The dictator used his power to scourge the people.
scourge.zh: 独裁者用他的权力蹂躏人民。

prophetic.en: His words turned out to be prophetic.
prophetic.zh: 他的话后来证明是有预见性的。

prophetic.en: The dream felt strangely prophetic to her.
prophetic.zh: 这个梦对她来说奇怪地具有预言性。

proffer.en: He proffered his seat to the elderly woman.
proffer.zh: 他把座位让给了那位老妇人。

proffer.en: She proffered a solution to the problem.
proffer.zh: 她提出了一个解决问题的方案。

pretentious.en: His speech was full of pretentious words.
pretentious.zh: 他的演讲充满了自命不凡的言辞。

pretentious.en: She found his art too pretentious for her taste.
pretentious.zh: 她觉得他的艺术太浮夸，不合她的口味。

lurid.en: The newspaper gave a lurid account of the accident.
lurid.zh: 报纸对事故进行了耸人听闻的报道。

lurid.en: The sky turned a lurid red before the storm.
lurid.zh: 暴风雨前天空变成了可怕的红色。

limbo.en: The project is stuck in limbo waiting for approval.
limbo.zh: 项目处于不确定状态，等待批准。

limbo.en: He felt like his soul was in limbo after the loss.
limbo.zh: 失去后，他感觉自己的灵魂处于地狱边缘。

inquisitive.en: The inquisitive child asked many questions.
inquisitive.zh: 那个好奇的孩子问了很多问题。

inquisitive.en: She has an inquisitive mind and loves to learn.
inquisitive.zh: 她有一颗好奇的心，热爱学习。

incessant.en: The incessant rain ruined our picnic plans.
incessant.zh: 连绵不断的雨毁了我们野餐的计划。

incessant.en: Her incessant chatter made it hard to concentrate.
incessant.zh: 她不停的闲聊让人难以集中注意力。

flaunt.en: He likes to flaunt his wealth in public.
flaunt.zh: 他喜欢在公共场合炫耀他的财富。

flaunt.en: She flaunted her new dress at the party.
flaunt.zh: 她在派对上炫耀她的新裙子。

bereft.en: She felt bereft after her best friend moved away.
bereft.zh: 她最好的朋友搬走后，她感到失落。

bereft.en: The family was bereft of hope after the tragedy.
bereft.zh: 悲剧发生后，这个家庭失去了希望。

aloft.en: The flag flew aloft in the strong wind.
aloft.zh: 旗帜在强风中高高飘扬。

aloft.en: He held the trophy aloft for everyone to see.
aloft.zh: 他把奖杯高高举起，让每个人都能看到。

plod.en: He plodded through the mud after the rain.
plod.zh: 雨后他在泥泞中艰难行走。

plod.en: She plodded along with her homework all evening.
plod.zh: 她整个晚上都在埋头做作业。

flounder.en: The fish floundered on the deck of the boat.
He floundered during his speech and forgot his lines.
flounder.zh: 他在演讲中慌乱失措，忘了台词。

esoteric.en: The book discusses esoteric philosophical ideas.
esoteric.zh: 这本书讨论了深奥的哲学思想。

esoteric.en: Only a few people understand his esoteric jokes.
esoteric.zh: 只有少数人理解他那些晦涩的笑话。

embellish.en: She embellished the story with extra details.
embellish.zh: 她用额外的细节润色了故事。

embellish.en: He embellished the room with beautiful paintings.
embellish.zh: 他用美丽的画作装饰了房间。

broach.en: She decided to broach the topic of salary.
broach.zh: 她决定提出薪水这个话题。

broach.en: He broached the idea of a vacation to his boss.
broach.zh: 他向老板提出了休假的想法。

mayhem.en: The children caused mayhem in the classroom.
mayhem.zh: 孩子们在教室里造成了混乱。

mayhem.en: The accident resulted in mayhem on the highway.
mayhem.zh: 事故导致高速公路上一片混乱。

flit.en: Butterflies flit from flower to flower.
flit.zh: 蝴蝶在花丛间飞来飞去。

flit.en: A thought flitted through her mind briefly.
flit.zh: 一个念头在她脑海中短暂掠过。

piercing.en: The piercing wind made us shiver.
piercing.zh: 刺骨的寒风让我们发抖。

piercing.en: She has a piercing gaze that sees through lies.
piercing.zh: 她有一双敏锐的目光，能看穿谎言。

labyrinth.en: They got lost in the labyrinth of the old city.
labyrinth.zh: 他们在古城迷宫般的街道中迷路了。

labyrinth.en: The problem is a labyrinth of complex rules.
labyrinth.zh: 这个问题是一套复杂的规则迷宫。

fallacy.en: It is a fallacy to think money brings happiness.
fallacy.zh: 认为金钱能带来幸福是一种谬见。

fallacy.en: His argument is based on a common fallacy.
fallacy.zh: 他的论点基于一个常见的谬误。

camouflage.en: The soldier wore camouflage to blend in.
camouflage.zh: 士兵穿着迷彩服以融入环境。

camouflage.en: The lizard's camouflage makes it hard to see.
camouflage.zh: 蜥蜴的伪装使它很难被发现。

arbiter.en: The judge acted as an arbiter in the dispute.
arbiter.zh: 法官在争端中担任仲裁人。

arbiter.en: Fashion critics are often seen as arbiters of style.
arbiter.zh: 时尚评论家常被视为风格的裁决者。

soot.en: The chimney was covered in black soot.
soot.zh: 烟囱上覆盖着黑色的煤烟。

soot.en: Soot from the fire stained the walls.
soot.zh: 火产生的煤烟弄脏了墙壁。

torrential.en: Torrential rain flooded the streets last night.
torrential.zh: 昨晚的暴雨淹没了街道。

torrential.en: The river swelled due to torrential downpours.
torrential.zh: 由于暴雨倾盆，河水上涨了。

complicity.en: He was accused of complicity in the robbery.
Her silence suggested complicity in the plan.
complicity.zh: 她的沉默暗示她与这个计划有共谋。

bystander.en: A bystander called the police after the accident.
bystander.zh: 事故发生后，一名旁观者报了警。

bystander.en: He remained a bystander and did not intervene.
bystander.zh: 他仍然是个旁观者，没有干预。

embryonic.en: The project is still in its embryonic stage.
embryonic.zh: 该项目仍处于萌芽阶段。

embryonic.en: Embryonic cells develop into different organs.
embryonic.zh: 胚胎细胞发育成不同的器官。

unproductive.en: The meeting was unproductive and wasted time.
unproductive.zh: 会议毫无成效，浪费了时间。

unproductive.en: This land is unproductive for farming.
unproductive.zh: 这块土地不适合耕作，产量很低。

valiant.en: The valiant soldier saved his comrades.
valiant.zh: 那位英勇的士兵救了他的战友。

valiant.en: She made a valiant effort to finish the race.
valiant.zh: 她做出了英勇的努力来完成比赛。

wilt.en: The flowers wilted in the hot sun.
His confidence began to wilt under pressure.
wilt.zh: 在压力下，他的信心开始减弱。

penchant.en: She has a penchant for spicy food.
He has a penchant for collecting old coins.

senile.en: The old man became senile in his later years.
senile.zh: 那位老人晚年变得衰老糊涂。

senile.en: Senile patients often need special care.
senile.zh: 老年患者通常需要特殊护理。

piecemeal.en: They solved the problem piecemeal over time.
piecemeal.zh: 他们随着时间的推移逐步解决了问题。

piecemeal.en: The reforms were introduced in a piecemeal fashion.
piecemeal.zh: 改革是以零碎的方式引入的。

pester.en: The child pestered his mother for candy.
Stop pestering me with your questions!
pester.zh: 别再用你的问题烦我了！

dour.en: His dour expression made everyone uncomfortable.
dour.zh: 他阴沉的脸色让所有人都不舒服。

dour.en: The dour weather matched his mood perfectly.
dour.zh: 阴沉的天气与他的心情完全吻合。

dignitary.en: The dignitary visited our school today.
dignitary.zh: 那位要人今天访问了我们学校。

dignitary.en: A foreign dignitary attended the ceremony.
dignitary.zh: 一位外国高官出席了典礼。

redirect.en: Please redirect the mail to my new address.
redirect.zh: 请将邮件改寄到我的新地址。

redirect.en: We need to redirect the traffic flow.
redirect.zh: 我们需要重新引导交通流向。

populace.en: The populace welcomed the new leader.
The entire populace celebrated the festival.
populace.zh: 全体大众庆祝了这个节日。

placid.en: The lake was placid and beautiful.

meander.en: The river meanders through the valley.
We like to meander in the park.
meander.zh: 我们喜欢在公园里漫步。

din.en: The din from the street kept me awake.
din.zh: 街上的喧嚣让我睡不着。

din.en: He tried to din the rules into us.
din.zh: 他试图反复向我们灌输规则。

crease.en: There is a crease on your shirt.
crease.zh: 你的衬衫上有一道折痕。

crease.en: Be careful not to crease the paper.

swerve.en: The car swerved to avoid a dog.
swerve.zh: 汽车突然转向以避开一只狗。

swerve.en: He made a sudden swerve to the left.

paranoia.en: His paranoia made him distrust everyone.
paranoia.zh: 他的偏执狂让他不信任任何人。

notch.en: He cut a notch in the stick.
notch.zh: 他在棍子上刻了一个凹痕。

notch.en: She notched another victory in the game.
notch.zh: 她在比赛中又赢得了一场胜利。

insoluble.zh: 这个问题似乎无法解决。

brash.en: His brash behavior offended many people.
brash.zh: 他无礼的行为冒犯了许多人。

brash.en: She made a brash decision without thinking.
brash.zh: 她没多想就做了个仓促的决定。

nova.en: A nova appeared in the night sky.
nova.zh: 一颗新星出现在夜空中。
天文学家观测到了一颗明亮的新星。

hobble.en: The old man hobbled down the street.

escalation.en: The escalation of prices worried everyone.
escalation.zh: 价格的上涨让每个人担忧。

escalation.en: We must avoid an escalation of conflict.
escalation.zh: 我们必须避免冲突升级。

droplet.en: A droplet of water fell from the leaf.
Tiny droplets formed on the glass.

stipulation.en: The contract has a clear stipulation.
stipulation.zh: 合同里有一条明确的规定。
他在一个条件下同意了。

phantom.en: He saw a phantom in the dark room.
phantom.zh: 他在黑暗的房间里看到了一个幻影。

phantom.en: The phantom pain still bothered him.

connoisseur.en: She is a connoisseur of fine wine.
He is a connoisseur of modern art.

susceptibility.en: His susceptibility to colds is high.
She has a susceptibility to infections.

permanence.en: We seek permanence in our relationships.
permanence.zh: 我们在关系中寻求持久。

permanence.en: The permanence of the building is impressive.
permanence.zh: 这座建筑的永久性令人印象深刻。

gist.en: I got the gist of his speech.
gist.zh: 我理解了他演讲的要点。

gist.en: Tell me the gist of the story.

kiosk.en: She bought a newspaper at the kiosk.
kiosk.zh: 她在报摊买了一份报纸。

kiosk.en: There is a small kiosk in the park.

visionary.zh: 他是一位有远见的领导者。

visionary.en: Her visionary ideas changed the company.
visionary.zh: 她富有远见的想法改变了公司。

spoke.en: One spoke of the wheel is broken.

soggy.en: The bread became soggy in the rain.
The ground is soggy after the storm.

palate.en: The wine is good for the palate.
He has a refined palate for food.
palate.zh: 他对食物有精致的品味。

insatiable.en: She has an insatiable appetite for books.
insatiable.zh: 她对书有不知足的渴望。
他贪求无厌的好奇心驱使他。

expedient.en: It was an expedient solution to the problem.
expedient.zh: 这是解决问题的一个权宜之计。

expedient.en: He chose the most expedient method.
expedient.zh: 他选择了最方便的方法。

evasive.en: He gave an evasive answer to the question.
evasive.zh: 他对问题给出了一个回避的回答。

remittance.zh: 汇款昨天通过邮件到达了。

invertebrate.en: An insect is an invertebrate animal.
Many invertebrates live in the ocean.
invertebrate.zh: 许多无脊椎动物生活在海洋中。

domicile.en: His domicile is in New York City.
She chose to domicile in a small town.
domicile.zh: 她选择定居在一个小镇。

croak.en: The frog let out a loud croak.
croak.zh: 青蛙发出了一声响亮的呱呱叫。

croak.en: He croaked a few words in a hoarse voice.
croak.zh: 他用沙哑的声音咕哝了几个字。

blooming.en: The garden is blooming with colorful flowers.
blooming.zh: 花园里盛开着五颜六色的花。

blooming.en: She looked blooming and healthy after the vacation.
blooming.zh: 假期后她看起来容光焕发、健康。

candidacy.en: She announced her candidacy for mayor.
candidacy.zh: 她宣布了竞选市长的候选人资格。

candidacy.en: His candidacy was supported by many voters.
candidacy.zh: 他的候选资格得到了许多选民的支持。

tundra.en: The tundra is cold and treeless.
Animals in the tundra have thick fur.
tundra.zh: 冻原上的动物有厚厚的皮毛。

hamstring.en: He injured his hamstring while running.
hamstring.zh: 他在跑步时拉伤了后腿腱。

hamstring.en: The new law could hamstring the project.
hamstring.zh: 新法律可能会使项目瘫痪。

anterior.en: The anterior part of the body is the front.
This event is anterior to the war.
anterior.zh: 这个事件发生在战争之前。

truancy.en: Truancy is a problem in some schools.
truancy.zh: 旷课是一些学校的问题。

truancy.en: He was punished for his truancy.

photosynthesis.en: Plants use photosynthesis to make food.
photosynthesis.zh: 植物利用光合作用制造食物。
光合作用需要阳光和水。

curd.en: She added lemon juice to make curd.
curd.zh: 她加了柠檬汁来制作凝乳。

curd.en: Curd is used to make cheese.

dissociation.en: Dissociation can happen after a trauma.
The chemical dissociation occurs at high heat.
dissociation.zh: 化学离解在高温下发生。

transplantation.zh: 移植需要匹配的捐赠者。

piazza.en: We met at the piazza for coffee.
piazza.zh: 我们在广场见面喝咖啡。

piazza.en: The piazza is full of tourists today.
piazza.zh: 今天广场上挤满了游客。

parallelism.zh: 平行结构使写作更平衡。

parallelism.en: There is a parallelism between the two stories.
parallelism.zh: 这两个故事之间有相似之处。

pedagogy.en: Good pedagogy helps students learn better.
pedagogy.zh: 好的教学法帮助学生学得更好。

incisor.en: He broke his front incisor while playing.
The incisor is used for cutting food.

pathogen.en: The pathogen caused a serious disease.
pathogen.zh: 这种病原体引起了一种严重疾病。
洗手能去除许多病原体。

ingestion.en: Ingestion of food starts in the mouth.
ingestion.zh: 食物的摄取从口腔开始。

ingestion.en: Proper ingestion is important for health.
ingestion.zh: 适当的摄食对健康很重要。

carat.en: A carat is a unit for precious stones.
carat.zh: 克拉是宝石的重量单位。

genome.zh: 科学家绘制了人类基因组图谱。

genome.en: The genome contains all genetic information.
genome.zh: 基因组包含所有遗传信息。

pancreas.en: The pancreas produces insulin for the body.
pancreas.zh: 胰腺为身体产生胰岛素。

pancreas.en: He had a problem with his pancreas.

harpsichord.en: She played a beautiful piece on the harpsichord.
harpsichord.zh: 她用羽管键琴演奏了一首优美的曲子。

harpsichord.en: The harpsichord sounds different from a piano.
harpsichord.zh: 羽管键琴的声音与钢琴不同。

adobe.en: The house was built with adobe bricks.
adobe.zh: 这房子是用土坯砖建造的。

adobe.en: Adobe is common in dry climates.
adobe.zh: 土坯在干燥气候中很常见。

madrigal.en: The choir sang a lovely madrigal.
madrigal.zh: 合唱团唱了一首可爱的情歌。

madrigal.en: Madrigals were popular in the Renaissance.
madrigal.zh: 情歌在文艺复兴时期很流行。

microorganism.en: A microorganism is too small to see.
Some microorganisms are helpful to humans.
microorganism.zh: 有些微生物对人类有益。

lexicographer.en: The lexicographer wrote a new dictionary.
lexicographer.zh: 这位词典编纂者写了一本新词典。

lexicographer.en: A lexicographer studies words and their meanings.
lexicographer.zh: 词典编纂者研究词汇及其含义。

aquifer.en: The aquifer provides water for the town.
aquifer.zh: 含水层为小镇提供水源。

aquifer.en: They drilled deep to reach the aquifer.
aquifer.zh: 他们钻得很深以到达含水层。

peptic.en: He suffers from a peptic ulcer.

peptic.zh: 胃蛋白酶有助于消化食物。

lumen.en: The lumen is a unit of light measurement.
The blood vessel has a narrow lumen.

reticent.en: He is reticent about his personal life.
reticent.zh: 他对自己的私生活保持沉默。

reticent.en: She was reticent and rarely spoke.

thorny.en: The rose bush has thorny stems.
This is a thorny problem to solve.
thorny.zh: 这是一个棘手的问题需要解决。

methodical.en: She is very methodical in her work.

methodical.zh: 有条理的方法节省时间。

tortuous.en: The path was tortuous and hard to follow.
His explanation was tortuous and confusing.
tortuous.zh: 他的解释转弯抹角，令人困惑。

surmise.en: I surmise that she is telling the truth.
His surmise turned out to be correct.

tarnish.en: Silver can tarnish if not polished.
tarnish.zh: 银器不擦亮会失去光泽。

nicety.en: He explained the nicety of the rule.
She observed every nicety of etiquette.
nicety.zh: 她遵守了礼仪的每一个细节。

abhor.en: I abhor violence in any form.
abhor.zh: 我憎恶任何形式的暴力。

abhor.en: She abhors the taste of bitter medicine.

hypocritical.zh: 他伪善的话激怒了所有人。

hypocritical.en: It is hypocritical to say one thing and do another.
hypocritical.zh: 说一套做一套是伪善的。

concoct.en: She concocted a delicious soup for dinner.
concoct.zh: 她调制了一锅美味的汤当晚餐。

concoct.en: He concocted an excuse for being late.
concoct.zh: 他编造了一个迟到的借口。

capitulate.en: The army had to capitulate after the battle.
capitulate.zh: 军队在战斗后不得不投降。

capitulate.en: He refused to capitulate to their demands.
capitulate.zh: 他拒绝屈服于他们的要求。

unobtrusive.en: She wore an unobtrusive dress to the party.
unobtrusive.zh: 她穿了一件不引人注目的裙子去派对。

unobtrusive.en: The security guard was unobtrusive but alert.

trepidation.en: He felt trepidation before the exam.
She entered the room with trepidation.
trepidation.zh: 她带着忧虑走进了房间。

inflame.en: The wound became inflamed and painful.
His speech inflamed the crowd's anger.
inflame.zh: 他的演讲激起了人群的愤怒。

enormity.en: The enormity of the crime shocked everyone.
enormity.zh: 罪行的严重性震惊了所有人。

enormity.en: He realized the enormity of his mistake.
enormity.zh: 他意识到自己错误的巨大。

blight.en: The blight destroyed the tomato plants.
blight.zh: 枯萎病毁掉了番茄植株。
贫困破坏了他们的童年。

drove.en: A drove of cattle crossed the road.
Tourists came in droves to see the sight.
drove.zh: 游客成群结队地来看这个景点。

docile.en: The dog is very docile and friendly.
She is a docile student who follows instructions.
docile.zh: 她是个温顺的学生，听从指示。

astound.en: The magician's trick astounded the audience.
astound.zh: 魔术师的把戏使观众震惊。

astound.en: I am astounded by her talent.
astound.zh: 我对她的才华感到震惊。

resourceful.en: She is resourceful and solves problems quickly.
resourceful.zh: 她足智多谋，能迅速解决问题。

resourceful.en: A resourceful person can handle any situation.
resourceful.zh: 一个机智的人能应对任何情况。

hallowed.en: This is a hallowed place for many people.
hallowed.zh: 对许多人来说，这是一个神圣的地方。

hallowed.en: They walked through the hallowed halls of the temple.
hallowed.zh: 他们走过寺庙神圣的大厅。

untoward.en: Nothing untoward happened during the trip.
untoward.zh: 旅途中没有发生任何麻烦事。

untoward.en: His untoward behavior surprised everyone at the party.
untoward.zh: 他在聚会上的不当行为让所有人惊讶。

wallow.en: The pig likes to wallow in the mud.
Don't wallow in self-pity for too long.
wallow.zh: 不要长时间沉浸在自怜中。

sustenance.en: Food provides sustenance for our bodies.
sustenance.zh: 食物为我们的身体提供营养。

sustenance.en: They needed sustenance after the long hike.
sustenance.zh: 长途徒步后他们需要食物。

prosaic.en: His writing style is very prosaic and plain.
prosaic.zh: 他的写作风格非常平淡无奇。

prosaic.en: She found the lecture too prosaic to enjoy.
prosaic.zh: 她觉得讲座太乏味，无法享受。

outmoded.en: This old computer is completely outmoded now.
outmoded.zh: 这台旧电脑现在完全过时了。

outmoded.en: Outmoded ideas can hold back progress.
outmoded.zh: 过时的想法会阻碍进步。

exhilaration.en: She felt a sense of exhilaration after winning.
exhilaration.zh: 获胜后她感到一阵兴奋。

exhilaration.en: The roller coaster ride brought pure exhilaration.
exhilaration.zh: 过山车带来了纯粹的愉悦。

deluge.en: The heavy rain caused a deluge in the city.
deluge.zh: 大雨在城市里引发了洪水。

deluge.en: They received a deluge of emails after the announcement.
deluge.zh: 公告后他们收到了大量电子邮件。

castigate.en: The teacher castigated the student for being late.
castigate.zh: 老师因学生迟到而严厉批评了他。

castigate.en: He was castigated for his careless mistake.
castigate.zh: 他因粗心的错误而受到惩罚。

wrought.en: The artist wrought a beautiful sculpture from stone.
wrought.zh: 艺术家用石头制作了一件美丽的雕塑。

wrought.en: Great changes were wrought by the new law.
wrought.zh: 新法律带来了巨大的变化。

gimmick.en: The product's success was just a marketing gimmick.
gimmick.zh: 这个产品的成功只是一个营销噱头。

gimmick.en: Don't fall for that cheap gimmick.
gimmick.zh: 不要被那个廉价的花招所欺骗。

finesse.en: She handled the difficult situation with great finesse.
finesse.zh: 她以高超的技巧处理了困难局面。

finesse.en: His finesse in negotiation impressed everyone.
finesse.zh: 他在谈判中的策略给所有人留下了深刻印象。

destitute.en: The family was left destitute after the fire.
destitute.zh: 火灾后这个家庭变得一无所有。

destitute.en: Many people in the area are destitute and need help.
destitute.zh: 该地区许多人穷困潦倒，需要帮助。

delude.en: Don't delude yourself into thinking it's easy.
delude.zh: 不要欺骗自己认为这很容易。

delude.en: He deluded her with false promises.
delude.zh: 他用虚假的承诺欺骗了她。

squabble.en: The children squabbled over the toy.
squabble.zh: 孩子们为玩具争吵起来。

squabble.en: They had a silly squabble about nothing.
squabble.zh: 他们为一点小事发生了愚蠢的口角。

intertwine.en: The vines intertwine around the old tree.
Their lives became intertwined after they met.
intertwine.zh: 他们相遇后生活变得交织在一起。

divest.en: The company decided to divest its unprofitable division.
divest.zh: 公司决定剥离其不盈利的部门。

divest.en: He was divested of his authority after the scandal.
divest.zh: 丑闻后他被剥夺了权力。

canny.en: She is a canny investor who never loses money.
canny.zh: 她是一个精明的投资者，从不亏钱。

canny.en: His canny decision saved the company from bankruptcy.
canny.zh: 他精明的决定使公司免于破产。

antiquated.en: The school uses antiquated teaching methods.
antiquated.zh: 这所学校使用过时的教学方法。

antiquated.en: This antiquated machine needs to be replaced.
antiquated.zh: 这台陈旧的机器需要更换。

relent.en: The storm finally relented after three days.
relent.zh: 暴风雨终于在三天后减弱了。

relent.en: She refused to relent and kept her strict rules.
relent.zh: 她拒绝让步，坚持严格的规定。

sadistic.zh: 他虐待狂的行为震惊了所有人。

sadistic.en: The villain in the movie was cruel and sadistic.
sadistic.zh: 电影中的反派残忍且残酷成性。

obnoxious.en: His obnoxious attitude made him unpopular.
obnoxious.zh: 他令人讨厌的态度使他不受欢迎。

obnoxious.en: The obnoxious noise kept everyone awake.
obnoxious.zh: 令人讨厌的噪音让所有人都睡不着。

euphemism.en: They used a euphemism to avoid saying the truth.
euphemism.zh: 他们用委婉语来避免说出真相。

euphemism.en: Passed away is a euphemism for died.
euphemism.zh: 去世是死亡的委婉说法。

dearth.en: There is a dearth of clean water in the region.
The dearth of jobs caused many problems.
dearth.zh: 工作机会的缺乏导致了许多问题。

averse.en: He is averse to taking any risks.
She is not averse to trying new foods.

voluminous.en: She wore a voluminous dress to the party.
voluminous.zh: 她穿了一件宽松的连衣裙去参加聚会。

voluminous.en: The author wrote a voluminous history book.
voluminous.zh: 这位作者写了一部大部头的历史书。

unpalatable.en: The food was unpalatable and bland.
unpalatable.zh: 食物不可口且淡而无味。

unpalatable.en: The truth can sometimes be unpalatable.
unpalatable.zh: 真相有时可能令人难以接受。

prohibitive.en: The cost of the car was prohibitive for them.
prohibitive.zh: 汽车的价格对他们来说高得令人望而却步。

prohibitive.en: Prohibitive laws prevented the sale of alcohol.
prohibitive.zh: 禁止性的法律阻止了酒精销售。

exuberance.en: The children's exuberance filled the playground.
exuberance.zh: 孩子们的活力充满了操场。

exuberance.en: Her exuberance was contagious to everyone.
exuberance.zh: 她的热情感染了每个人。

calamity.en: The earthquake was a terrible calamity.
calamity.zh: 地震是一场可怕的灾难。

calamity.en: They survived the calamity with great courage.
calamity.zh: 他们以巨大的勇气幸免于这场灾难。

belittle.en: Don't belittle his efforts; he tried hard.
belittle.zh: 不要贬低他的努力；他尽力了。

belittle.en: She felt belittled by her boss's comments.
belittle.zh: 她感到被老板的评论轻视了。

abject.en: He lived in abject poverty for many years.
The abject apology did not satisfy her.
abject.zh: 卑微的道歉没有让她满意。

scruple.en: He had no scruple about lying to get ahead.
scruple.zh: 他对为了成功而撒谎毫无顾忌。

scruple.en: She scrupled to accept the money without working.
scruple.zh: 她对于不劳而获地接受这笔钱感到犹豫。

reverberate.en: The sound of the bell reverberated through the hall.
The news reverberated across the entire country.
reverberate.zh: 这个消息在全国引起了反响。

nullify.en: The new law will nullify the old one.
The court decided to nullify the contract.
nullify.zh: 法院决定宣布合同无效。

deft.en: The surgeon's deft hands performed the operation.
deft.zh: 外科医生灵巧的双手进行了手术。

deft.en: She gave a deft reply to the difficult question.
deft.zh: 她对那个难题给出了巧妙的回答。

anachronistic.en: Using a quill pen today seems anachronistic.
anachronistic.zh: 今天使用羽毛笔似乎不合时宜。

anachronistic.en: The movie had an anachronistic scene with a smartphone.
anachronistic.zh: 电影中有一个出现智能手机的时代错误场景。

animate.en: Her smile seemed to animate her whole face.
animate.zh: 她的微笑似乎让她整张脸都生动起来。

animate.en: The cartoon characters are animated by computers.
animate.zh: 卡通角色由电脑赋予生命。

forgo.en: I will forgo dessert to save calories.
forgo.zh: 我将放弃甜点以节省热量。

forgo.en: They decided to forgo the trip due to bad weather.
forgo.zh: 由于天气不好，他们决定放弃旅行。

captivate.en: The beautiful music captivated the audience.
captivate.zh: 优美的音乐迷住了观众。

captivate.en: Her story captivated everyone in the room.
captivate.zh: 她的故事吸引了房间里的每个人。

whet.en: He used a stone to whet the knife.
The story will whet your appetite for adventure.
whet.zh: 这个故事会激起你对冒险的渴望。

intrepid.en: The intrepid explorer climbed the highest mountain.
intrepid.zh: 无畏的探险家爬上了最高的山。

intrepid.en: She is an intrepid journalist reporting from war zones.
intrepid.zh: 她是一名在战区报道的无畏记者。

innuendo.en: His comment was full of innuendo about her past.
innuendo.zh: 他的评论充满了对她过去的暗讽。

innuendo.en: She ignored the innuendo and continued her work.
innuendo.zh: 她无视了暗讽，继续她的工作。

amputate.en: The doctor had to amputate his leg to save him.
amputate.zh: 医生不得不截掉他的腿来救他。

amputate.en: They will amputate the infected finger tomorrow.
amputate.zh: 他们明天将截掉感染的手指。

adage.en: The old adage says time heals all wounds.
adage.zh: 老谚语说时间能治愈一切创伤。

adage.en: She lives by the adage 'honesty is the best policy'.
adage.zh: 她遵循‘诚实为上策’这句格言生活。

welter.en: The ship weltered in the stormy sea.
welter.zh: 船在暴风雨的海上翻滚。

welter.en: He weltered in a sea of paperwork all day.
welter.zh: 他整天沉溺于一大堆文书工作中。

terse.en: His terse reply was just 'yes' or 'no'.
terse.zh: 他简洁的回答只是‘是’或‘不是’。

terse.en: She gave a terse summary of the meeting.
terse.zh: 她对会议做了一个简洁的总结。

solace.en: Music provides solace during difficult times.
solace.zh: 音乐在困难时期提供安慰。

solace.en: She found solace in her friend's kind words.
solace.zh: 她在朋友善意的话语中找到了安慰。

rung.en: He stepped on the bottom rung of the ladder.
rung.zh: 他踩在梯子的最底横档上。

rung.en: The chair's rung broke when he sat down.
rung.zh: 他坐下时椅子的横档断了。

preposterous.en: That idea is completely preposterous and impossible.
preposterous.zh: 那个想法完全荒谬且不可能。

preposterous.en: She laughed at his preposterous suggestion.

excerpt.en: He read an excerpt from the novel aloud.
excerpt.zh: 他大声朗读了小说的一段摘录。

excerpt.en: The teacher asked us to excerpt key points.
excerpt.zh: 老师要求我们摘录关键点。

decimate.en: The disease could decimate the entire population.
decimate.zh: 这种疾病可能大批杀害整个种群。

decimate.en: The army was decimated in the fierce battle.
decimate.zh: 军队在激烈的战斗中遭受重创。

vouch.en: I can vouch for his honesty and hard work.
vouch.zh: 我可以担保他的诚实和勤奋。

vouch.en: She will vouch that he was at the meeting.
vouch.zh: 她会证明他当时在会议上。

haggle.en: They haggled over the price of the car.
haggle.zh: 他们就汽车的价格讨价还价。

haggle.en: She hates to haggle at the market.

sketchy.en: The report was too sketchy to be useful.
sketchy.zh: 报告太概略了，没什么用。

sketchy.en: He gave a sketchy description of the event.
sketchy.zh: 他对事件做了一个概略的描述。

unwieldy.en: The box was too unwieldy to carry alone.
unwieldy.zh: 箱子太笨重了，一个人搬不动。

unwieldy.en: The new software is unwieldy and difficult to use.

succinct.en: Her speech was succinct and very clear.
He gave a succinct answer to the question.
succinct.zh: 他对问题给出了一个简洁的回答。

reminisce.en: They reminisced about their childhood together.
reminisce.zh: 他们一起追忆童年往事。

reminisce.en: She likes to reminisce about her college days.
reminisce.zh: 她喜欢追忆她的大学时光。

panacea.en: There is no panacea for all problems.
panacea.zh: 没有能解决所有问题的万能药。

panacea.en: People often seek a panacea for their troubles.
panacea.zh: 人们常常为烦恼寻找灵丹妙药。

hospitable.en: The local people are very hospitable to visitors.
hospitable.zh: 当地人对游客非常热情好客。

hospitable.en: They live in a hospitable climate.
hospitable.zh: 他们生活在宜人的气候中。

dogged.en: His dogged determination helped him succeed.
dogged.zh: 他顽强的决心帮助他成功了。

dogged.en: She showed dogged persistence in her studies.
dogged.zh: 她在学习中表现出顽强的毅力。

convulsion.en: The patient had a convulsion and fell down.
convulsion.zh: 病人抽搐了一下，倒在地上。

convulsion.en: The country was in a convulsion after the war.
convulsion.zh: 战后这个国家陷入了动乱。

attune.en: She tried to attune her ears to the music.
attune.zh: 她试图让耳朵适应音乐。

attune.en: We must attune our plans to the new rules.
attune.zh: 我们必须使计划与新规则协调。

tenacity.en: Her tenacity helped her finish the marathon.
tenacity.zh: 她的坚韧帮助她完成了马拉松。

tenacity.en: He showed great tenacity in solving the problem.
tenacity.zh: 他在解决问题时表现出极大的不屈不挠。

masquerade.en: They attended a masquerade ball last night.
masquerade.zh: 他们昨晚参加了一个化装舞会。

masquerade.en: His kindness was just a masquerade for greed.
masquerade.zh: 他的善良只是贪婪的伪装。

incisive.en: She made an incisive comment about the issue.
incisive.zh: 她对这个问题发表了敏锐的评论。
他敏锐的分析给所有人留下了印象。

imprecise.en: The measurements were imprecise and unreliable.

imprecise.zh: 他不精确的语言造成了混乱。

forestall.en: They acted quickly to forestall any problems.
forestall.zh: 他们迅速行动以预先阻止任何问题。

forestall.en: She forestalled his criticism by apologizing first.
forestall.zh: 她先道歉，阻止了他的批评。

acrimonious.en: The debate became acrimonious and personal.
acrimonious.zh: 辩论变得尖刻且针对个人。

acrimonious.en: They had an acrimonious divorce settlement.
acrimonious.zh: 他们有一个尖刻的离婚协议。

gratuitous.en: His gratuitous advice was not appreciated.
gratuitous.zh: 他无理由的建议不被欣赏。

whittle.en: He likes to whittle wood into small figures.
whittle.zh: 他喜欢把木头削成小雕像。

whittle.en: They whittled down the list to ten candidates.
whittle.zh: 他们把名单削减到十个候选人。

teeter.en: The child teetered on the edge of the bed.
teeter.zh: 孩子在床沿上摇摇晃晃。

teeter.en: The company is teetering on the brink of bankruptcy.
teeter.zh: 公司正摇摇欲坠地处于破产边缘。

tantamount.en: His silence was tantamount to admitting guilt.
tantamount.zh: 他的沉默等同于承认有罪。

tantamount.en: Refusing help is tantamount to giving up.

jettison.en: The plane had to jettison fuel to land safely.
jettison.zh: 飞机不得不抛弃燃料以安全着陆。

jettison.en: They jettisoned the old plan for a new one.
jettison.zh: 他们抛弃了旧计划，采用新计划。

frenetic.en: The frenetic pace of city life exhausted her.
frenetic.zh: 城市生活狂热的节奏让她筋疲力尽。

frenetic.en: He worked at a frenetic speed to finish on time.
frenetic.zh: 他以狂热的速度工作以按时完成。

fortuitous.zh: 他们的相遇完全是偶然的。

fortuitous.en: A fortuitous discovery led to a new invention.
fortuitous.zh: 一个偶然的发现导致了一项新发明。

dexterity.en: She showed great dexterity in playing the piano.
dexterity.zh: 她在弹钢琴时表现出极大的灵巧。

dexterity.en: The surgeon's dexterity saved the patient's life.
dexterity.zh: 外科医生的灵巧救了病人的命。

barter.en: They used barter to trade goods without money.
barter.zh: 他们用物物交换来交易货物，不用钱。

barter.zh: 在一些村庄，人们仍然用物物交换换取食物。

atrocious.en: The crime was atrocious and shocked everyone.
atrocious.zh: 罪行残暴，震惊了所有人。

atrocious.en: The weather was atrocious during the entire trip.
atrocious.zh: 整个旅行期间天气恶劣。

stalwart.zh: 他是球队的坚定支持者。

stalwart.zh: 那个健壮的警卫站在门口。

serviceable.zh: 她穿了一件耐用的外套去徒步。

ruse.en: His excuse was just a clever ruse.
ruse.zh: 他的借口只是个聪明的计策。

ruse.en: She used a ruse to avoid the party.
ruse.zh: 她用了一个诡计来避开派对。

outwit.en: The fox outwitted the hunter easily.
outwit.zh: 狐狸轻松地以智取胜了猎人。

outwit.en: She outwitted her opponent in the game.
outwit.zh: 她在游戏中以智取胜了对手。

itinerant.zh: 那个巡回工人从一个农场搬到另一个。

itinerant.en: He lived as an itinerant musician for years.
itinerant.zh: 他作为巡回音乐家生活了多年。

denigrate.en: Do not denigrate your coworkers publicly.
denigrate.zh: 不要公开诋毁你的同事。

denigrate.en: He tried to denigrate her achievements.

coalesce.en: The two groups coalesced into one team.
coalesce.zh: 这两个团体合并成了一个团队。

coalesce.en: Their ideas coalesced into a clear plan.
coalesce.zh: 他们的想法合并成了一个清晰的计划。

cameo.en: She wore a beautiful cameo brooch.
cameo.zh: 她戴了一枚美丽的浮雕宝石胸针。

cameo.en: The actor made a cameo in the movie.
cameo.zh: 那位演员在电影中客串了一个角色。

bondage.en: They lived in bondage for many years.
bondage.zh: 他们在奴役中生活了许多年。

bondage.en: He escaped from the bondage of debt.

vindictive.en: She gave him a vindictive look after the argument.
vindictive.zh: 争吵后她给了他一个怀恨的眼神。

vindictive.en: His vindictive actions only made things worse.
vindictive.zh: 他报复性的行为只会让事情更糟。

tint.zh: 她在颜料中加入了一点蓝色色彩。

tint.en: The windows have a slight green tint.

riotous.en: The party was riotous and full of laughter.
riotous.zh: 派对很喧闹，充满了笑声。

riotous.en: Riotous behavior is not allowed in school.
riotous.zh: 学校里不允许有暴乱行为。

epithet.zh: 他赢得了“勇敢者”的称号。

epithet.en: She used a rude epithet in anger.
epithet.zh: 她愤怒中用了粗鲁的绰号。

crescendo.en: The music reached a loud crescendo.
crescendo.zh: 音乐达到了响亮的声音渐强。

crescendo.en: The crowd's cheers grew to a crescendo.
crescendo.zh: 人群的欢呼声逐渐增强。

deride.en: They deride his efforts to learn English.
deride.zh: 他们嘲笑他学习英语的努力。

deride.en: Do not deride others for their mistakes.

shoddy.zh: 以次充好的工艺让所有人失望。

shoddy.en: He bought a shoddy product that broke quickly.
shoddy.zh: 他买了一个以次充好的产品，很快就坏了。

despondent.en: She felt despondent after failing the test.
despondent.zh: 考试失败后她感到丧气。

despondent.en: He became despondent about his future.
despondent.zh: 他对自己的未来变得失望。

motley.en: The crowd was a motley group of people.

motley.zh: 他穿了一件杂色的外套。

indecisive.en: She is too indecisive to choose a restaurant.
indecisive.zh: 她太犹豫不决，无法选择餐厅。

indecisive.en: His indecisive nature frustrates his friends.
indecisive.zh: 他犹豫不决的性格让朋友沮丧。

fastidious.en: She is fastidious about her appearance.

fastidious.zh: 他是个挑剔的食客，不喜欢杂乱。

untold.en: The storm caused untold damage to the city.
untold.zh: 风暴给城市造成了数不清的损失。

resplendent.en: The palace was resplendent with gold decorations.
resplendent.zh: 宫殿因金色装饰而辉煌灿烂。

resplendent.en: She looked resplendent in her wedding dress.
resplendent.zh: 她穿着婚纱看起来辉煌灿烂。

ramshackle.en: They lived in a ramshackle old house.
ramshackle.zh: 他们住在一间摇晃的老房子里。

ramshackle.zh: 摇晃的篱笆在风中倒下了。

palpable.zh: 房间里的紧张气氛是可感知的。

palpable.en: There was a palpable sense of relief.

irate.en: The irate customer demanded a refund.

irate.zh: 她对航班延误感到生气。

earthy.en: The wine has an earthy flavor.

amalgam.en: The team was an amalgam of different skills.
amalgam.zh: 这个团队是不同技能的混合体。

rowdy.en: The rowdy children ran through the hall.
rowdy.zh: 吵闹的孩子们跑过大厅。

rowdy.zh: 一群吵闹的人聚集在体育场外。

overpowering.en: The smell of garlic was overpowering.

overpowering.zh: 她感到一种无法抵抗的睡意。

neutralize.zh: 他们试图迅速消除威胁。

garish.en: The garish colors hurt my eyes.
garish.zh: 花哨的颜色刺痛了我的眼睛。

garish.en: She wore a garish dress to the party.
garish.zh: 她穿了一件花哨的裙子去派对。

charade.zh: 他们在派对上玩字谜游戏。

blemish.en: She had a small blemish on her cheek.
blemish.zh: 她脸颊上有一个小污点。

blemish.en: The accident blemished his perfect record.
blemish.zh: 那次事故玷污了他的完美记录。

summarily.en: He was summarily dismissed from his job.

nautical.en: He loves nautical adventures on the sea.
nautical.zh: 他喜欢海上的航海冒险。

nautical.en: The room had a nautical theme with anchors.
nautical.zh: 房间有航海主题，装饰着锚。

altruistic.en: Her altruistic nature made her help others.
altruistic.zh: 她利他的天性让她帮助他人。

altruistic.en: He performed an altruistic act of kindness.
altruistic.zh: 他做了一件无私的善举。

affliction.en: He suffered from a painful affliction.
affliction.zh: 他遭受了一种痛苦的折磨。

affliction.en: Poverty is a common affliction in many areas.
affliction.zh: 贫困是许多地区的常见苦恼。

predilection.en: She has a predilection for spicy food.

predilection.zh: 他对爵士乐的偏爱是众所周知的。

paucity.en: There is a paucity of clean water here.

paucity.zh: 证据的缺乏导致他被释放。

obliging.en: The obliging waiter helped us with the menu.
obliging.zh: 乐于施惠的服务员帮我们看菜单。

obliging.en: She is an obliging person who always assists.
obliging.zh: 她是个乐于施惠的人，总是帮忙。

molest.en: It is wrong to molest anyone.
molest.zh: 骚扰任何人都是错误的。

molest.en: The law punishes those who molest others.
molest.zh: 法律惩罚那些骚扰他人的人。

exorbitant.en: The price of that car is exorbitant.

exorbitant.zh: 他们对这项服务收取了过高的费用。

dereliction.en: His dereliction of duty caused problems.
dereliction.zh: 他的玩忽职守导致了问题。

dereliction.en: The guard was fired for dereliction.
dereliction.zh: 那名警卫因玩忽职守被解雇。

tedium.en: The long meeting was full of tedium.
tedium.zh: 漫长的会议充满了单调乏味。

tedium.en: She tried to escape the tedium of daily life.
tedium.zh: 她试图逃避日常生活的单调乏味。

spout.en: Water came out of the teapot spout.
spout.zh: 水从茶壶的壶嘴流出来。

spout.en: The whale spouted water into the air.

plush.en: The hotel room had plush carpets.
plush.zh: 酒店房间铺有长毛绒地毯。

plush.en: She bought a plush toy for her child.
plush.zh: 她给孩子买了一个长毛绒玩具。

pander.en: He would not pander to their bad habits.
pander.zh: 他不愿迎合他们的坏习惯。

pander.en: The movie panders to the lowest tastes.
pander.zh: 这部电影迎合最低级的趣味。

fledgling.en: The fledgling bird tried to fly.
fledgling.zh: 那只刚会飞的鸟试图飞翔。

fledgling.en: He is a fledgling in this business.
fledgling.zh: 他在这个行业是个新手。

dupe.en: He was a dupe of the scam artist.
dupe.zh: 他是那个骗子的受骗者。

dupe.zh: 他们试图欺骗她购买假货。

counterbalance.en: Her kindness is a counterbalance to his temper.
counterbalance.zh: 她的善良是对他脾气的平衡。

capricious.en: The weather here is very capricious.
capricious.zh: 这里的天气非常反复无常。

capricious.en: She is capricious and changes her mind often.
capricious.zh: 她反复无常，经常改变主意。

acumen.zh: 她的商业头脑令人印象深刻。

acumen.en: He has great acumen for solving problems.
acumen.zh: 他有很强的解决问题能力。

sanguine.en: She is sanguine about the future.

sanguine.zh: 他对生活抱有乐观的看法。

epitaph.en: The epitaph on the tombstone was simple.
epitaph.zh: 墓碑上的墓志铭很简单。

epitaph.en: He wrote a beautiful epitaph for his friend.
epitaph.zh: 他为朋友写了一篇优美的墓志铭。

commensurate.en: Her salary is commensurate with her experience.
commensurate.zh: 她的薪水与她的经验相称。

commensurate.en: The punishment should be commensurate with the crime.

mash.en: She mashed the potatoes for dinner.
The baby ate a bowl of mashed fruit.

abdicate.en: The king decided to abdicate the throne.
He abdicated his responsibility as a leader.
abdicate.zh: 他放弃了作为领导者的责任。

teem.en: The market teems with shoppers on weekends.
teem.zh: 周末市场里挤满了购物者。

sojourn.en: They had a brief sojourn in Paris.

sojourn.zh: 他在山里旅居了一个月。

recuperate.en: She needs time to recuperate after surgery.
recuperate.zh: 她手术后需要时间恢复。

recuperate.en: He is recuperating at home from the illness.

impel.en: Curiosity impelled her to explore the cave.
impel.zh: 好奇心驱使她探索洞穴。

impel.en: Hunger impelled him to find food.
impel.zh: 饥饿迫使他去寻找食物。

unsound.en: His argument is unsound and illogical.
unsound.zh: 他的论点不健全且不合逻辑。

unassuming.en: He is a kind and unassuming man.
unassuming.zh: 他是一个善良而谦逊的人。

unassuming.en: Her unassuming manner made her popular.
unassuming.zh: 她谦逊的态度使她受欢迎。

stupendous.en: The view from the mountain was stupendous.
stupendous.zh: 从山上看去的景色壮观极了。

stupendous.en: They made a stupendous effort to win.
stupendous.zh: 他们付出了巨大的努力去赢。

paltry.en: He offered a paltry sum of money.
paltry.zh: 他提供了一笔微不足道的钱。

paltry.en: That is a paltry excuse for being late.
paltry.zh: 那是一个迟到的可鄙借口。

misrepresent.en: He misrepresented his qualifications on the form.
misrepresent.zh: 他在表格上虚报了自己的资历。

mete.en: The judge will mete out a fair punishment.
mete.zh: 法官将给予公平的惩罚。

mete.en: They meted out justice to the criminals.

intoxicate.en: The wine began to intoxicate him.

impunity.en: He broke the rules with impunity.
impunity.zh: 他违反规则却不受惩罚。

impunity.en: No one can commit crimes with impunity.
impunity.zh: 没有人可以犯罪而不受惩罚。

hone.en: He honed his skills through practice.
hone.zh: 他通过练习磨练了技能。

hone.en: She used a stone to hone the knife.

exalt.en: They exalt the virtues of hard work.
The king was exalted above all others.
exalt.zh: 国王被提升到高于所有人的地位。

dislocate.en: He dislocated his shoulder playing football.
dislocate.zh: 他踢足球时肩膀脱臼了。

dislocate.en: The accident dislocated the traffic flow.

corroborate.zh: 你能证实她的不在场证明吗？

boisterous.en: The children were boisterous at the party.

boisterous.zh: 喧闹的人群挤满了体育场。

admonish.en: The teacher admonished the student for talking.
admonish.zh: 老师因学生讲话而训诫他。

admonish.en: She admonished him to drive carefully.

gratify.en: The good news gratified her greatly.

gratify.zh: 他通过读这本书满足了好奇心。

foreshadow.en: His words foreshadowed the coming crisis.
foreshadow.zh: 他的话预示了即将到来的危机。

eminence.en: She achieved eminence in her field.
eminence.zh: 她在自己的领域取得了显赫地位。

eminence.en: He is a scholar of great eminence.
eminence.zh: 他是一位非常杰出的学者。

zenith.en: The sun reached its zenith at noon.

zenith.zh: 他的事业当时处于顶峰。

virulent.en: He made a virulent attack on his opponent.
virulent.zh: 他对对手进行了恶毒的攻击。

stimulant.zh: 咖啡是一种常见的兴奋剂。

stimulant.en: The news was a stimulant for the team.
stimulant.zh: 这个消息对团队是一种激励。

downpour.en: We got caught in a sudden downpour.
downpour.zh: 我们突然遇到了倾盆大雨。

downpour.zh: 倾盆大雨很快淹没了街道。

edict.en: The king issued a new edict.
edict.zh: 国王颁布了一项新法令。

edict.en: The edict changed the law quickly.
edict.zh: 这项法令迅速改变了法律。

wanton.zh: 这种恶意的破坏震惊了所有人。

wanton.en: She was known as a wanton woman.

unremitting.zh: 她不懈的努力得到了回报。

unremitting.en: The rain was unremitting all day.

tribulation.zh: 他们共同面对巨大的苦难。

ruthlessness.en: Ruthlessness is not a good quality.

paragon.en: She is a paragon of virtue.

minuscule.en: He wrote in a minuscule script.

infest.zh: 寄生虫可以寄生于人体。

gusto.en: He ate the meal with gusto.
gusto.zh: 他津津有味地吃了这顿饭。

gusto.en: She sang the song with great gusto.
gusto.zh: 她满怀热情地唱了这首歌。

elated.en: She felt elated after winning the prize.
elated.zh: 获奖后她感到兴高采烈。

elated.zh: 团队因胜利而兴高采烈。

regale.en: He regaled us with funny stories.
