painkiller.en: She took a painkiller for her headache.
painkiller.zh: 她吃了止痛药来治头痛。

painkiller.en: The doctor prescribed a strong painkiller.
painkiller.zh: 医生开了一种强效止痛药。

hiatus.en: There was a hiatus in the conversation.
The show returned after a long hiatus.
hiatus.zh: 节目在长时间中断后回归了。

fallow.en: The field lay fallow for a season.
fallow.zh: 那块地休耕了一个季节。

fallow.en: Farmers let the land rest as fallow.
fallow.zh: 农民让土地休耕以休息。

dossier.en: The detective reviewed the suspect's dossier.
dossier.zh: 侦探审查了嫌疑人的档案。

dossier.en: She kept a dossier on all her clients.
dossier.zh: 她保存了所有客户的卷宗。

mermaid.en: The mermaid sang beautifully by the shore.
mermaid.zh: 美人鱼在岸边优美地歌唱。

mermaid.en: Children love stories about a mermaid.
mermaid.zh: 孩子们喜欢关于美人鱼的故事。

emissary.en: The king sent an emissary to negotiate peace.
emissary.zh: 国王派了一名使者去谈判和平。

emissary.en: The emissary delivered the message secretly.
emissary.zh: 密使秘密地传递了消息。

peruse.en: He perused the menu before ordering.
peruse.zh: 点餐前他仔细研究了菜单。

modicum.en: He showed a modicum of respect.
She needs a modicum of patience to succeed.
modicum.zh: 她需要一点耐心才能成功。

indelible.en: The memory left an indelible mark on her.
indelible.zh: 那段记忆给她留下了难以磨灭的印记。

indelible.en: The ink made an indelible stain on the shirt.
indelible.zh: 墨水在衬衫上留下了难以消除的污渍。

dandy.en: He dressed like a dandy for the party.
dandy.zh: 他为了派对打扮得像花花公子。

dandy.en: The dandy always wore the latest fashion.
dandy.zh: 那个花花公子总是穿最新潮的服装。

untimely.zh: 他的早逝震惊了所有人。

untimely.en: The rain came at an untimely moment.

untapped.en: The region has untapped natural resources.
untapped.zh: 该地区有未开发的自然资源。

untapped.en: Her potential remains untapped in this job.
untapped.zh: 她的潜力在这份工作中尚未被利用。

unjustly.en: He was unjustly accused of the crime.
unjustly.zh: 他被不公正地指控犯罪。

unjustly.en: The worker was unjustly fired from his job.
unjustly.zh: 那名工人被不公正地解雇了。

staid.zh: 那位严肃的教授很少微笑。

staid.en: She preferred a staid and quiet life.
staid.zh: 她更喜欢一种沉静而安稳的生活。

solemnity.en: The ceremony was filled with solemnity.
solemnity.zh: 仪式充满了庄严的气氛。

solemnity.en: He spoke with great solemnity about the event.
solemnity.zh: 他极其严肃地谈论了那个事件。

repugnant.en: The idea of cruelty to animals is repugnant.
repugnant.zh: 虐待动物的想法令人厌恶。
他令人反感的行为冒犯了所有人。

puny.en: The puny kitten struggled to climb the stairs.
puny.zh: 那只瘦弱的小猫挣扎着爬楼梯。

puny.en: His puny effort was not enough to win.
puny.zh: 他微小的努力不足以获胜。

ponderous.zh: 笨重的大象缓慢地移动。

ponderous.en: His ponderous speech bored the audience.
ponderous.zh: 他沉闷的演讲让观众感到无聊。

outlandish.en: She wore an outlandish hat to the party.
outlandish.zh: 她戴了一顶古怪的帽子去派对。

outlandish.en: His outlandish ideas surprised his colleagues.
outlandish.zh: 他古怪的想法让同事们惊讶。

mannered.zh: 他矫揉造作的讲话显得不自然。

mannered.en: The actor's mannered performance was criticized.
mannered.zh: 那位演员矫饰的表演受到了批评。

inconsequential.en: The mistake was inconsequential to the project.
inconsequential.zh: 这个错误对项目来说无关紧要。
她担心一些不重要的细节。

fortitude.en: She faced the challenge with great fortitude.
fortitude.zh: 她以极大的毅力面对挑战。

fortitude.en: His fortitude during the crisis inspired us.
fortitude.zh: 他在危机中的坚毅激励了我们。

drudgery.en: He hated the drudgery of housework.
Daily drudgery made her feel tired.
drudgery.zh: 每天的苦工让她感到疲惫。

circumscribe.zh: 规则限制了我们的行动。

circumscribe.en: Please circumscribe the area with a line.
circumscribe.zh: 请用线在区域周围画线。

cautionary.en: The story has a cautionary message.
cautionary.zh: 这个故事有警告的寓意。

cautionary.en: He gave a cautionary warning to us.

belie.en: Her smile belies her true sadness.
belie.zh: 她的微笑掩饰了真实的悲伤。

belie.en: His actions belie his kind words.
belie.zh: 他的行为与他的好话不符。

abeyance.en: The project is in abeyance now.
The law remained in abeyance for years.
abeyance.zh: 这项法律暂停了好几年。

wily.en: The wily fox escaped the trap.
wily.zh: 狡猾的狐狸逃脱了陷阱。

wily.en: She is a wily negotiator in business.
wily.zh: 她在生意上是个狡猾的谈判者。

sidestep.en: He tried to sidestep the question.
She took a quick sidestep to avoid him.
sidestep.zh: 她快速横跨一步躲开他。

recast.en: The director decided to recast the role.
recast.zh: 导演决定改换这个角色。

recast.en: They will recast the metal into a new shape.
recast.zh: 他们将把金属重铸成新形状。

pittance.en: He worked for a mere pittance.
pittance.zh: 他为了微薄的报酬工作。

pittance.en: The salary was a pittance for the hard work.
pittance.zh: 这份薪水对于辛苦工作来说只是少量。

pelt.en: The children began to pelt each other with snowballs.
pelt.zh: 孩子们开始互相投掷雪球。

pelt.en: The hunter sold the animal's pelt.
pelt.zh: 猎人卖掉了动物的毛皮。

malleable.en: Gold is a very malleable metal.
malleable.zh: 金是一种非常有延展性的金属。

malleable.en: Young minds are malleable and easy to teach.
malleable.zh: 年轻的思想是可塑的，容易教导。

luscious.en: The cake had a luscious chocolate flavor.
luscious.zh: 蛋糕有甘美的巧克力味道。

luscious.en: She wore a luscious red dress to the party.
luscious.zh: 她穿了一件满足感官的红色连衣裙去派对。

leeway.en: We have some leeway in the schedule.
leeway.zh: 我们在时间表上有一些余地。

leeway.en: The captain allowed for leeway in the wind.

fickle.en: The weather is fickle in spring.
She is fickle and changes her mind often.

dutiful.en: The dutiful son always helps his parents.
dutiful.zh: 这个尽职的儿子总是帮助父母。

dutiful.en: She is a dutiful employee at work.
dutiful.zh: 她在工作中是个忠实的员工。

disengage.en: Please disengage the clutch before shifting gears.
He tried to disengage from the argument.

blare.en: The car horn began to blare loudly.
blare.zh: 汽车喇叭开始高声鸣叫。

blare.en: The blare of music filled the room.
blare.zh: 音乐的巨响充满了房间。

affable.en: The teacher is very affable and kind.
affable.zh: 这位老师非常和蔼可亲。

affable.en: He has an affable smile for everyone.
affable.zh: 他对每个人都有友善的微笑。

abysmal.en: The performance was abysmal and boring.
The abysmal depth of the ocean is scary.
abysmal.zh: 海洋深不可测的深度很可怕。

turquoise.en: She wore a beautiful turquoise necklace.
turquoise.zh: 她戴了一条美丽的绿松石项链。

turquoise.en: The sea was a bright turquoise color.
turquoise.zh: 大海是明亮的绿松石色。

podium.en: The speaker stood on the podium.
He stepped onto the podium to receive the award.
podium.zh: 他走上领奖台接受奖项。

lethargy.en: The heat caused a feeling of lethargy.
lethargy.zh: 炎热引起了一种昏睡感。

lethargy.en: He suffered from lethargy after the illness.

expediency.en: They chose the path of expediency.

expediency.zh: 权宜指导了他们的决策。

despicable.en: She found the lie despicable and wrong.
despicable.zh: 她觉得这个谎言卑劣且错误。

demur.en: She did not demur when asked to help.
demur.zh: 当被要求帮忙时，她没有提出异议。

demur.en: The lawyer filed a demur to the claim.
demur.zh: 律师对索赔提出了异议。

unkempt.en: His hair was unkempt and messy.
The garden looked unkempt and wild.
unkempt.zh: 花园看起来未被照管好，很荒芜。

menial.en: He did menial tasks in the kitchen.
menial.zh: 他在厨房做卑微的工作。

menial.en: She worked as a menial servant for years.

gruff.en: The old man had a gruff voice.
gruff.zh: 这位老人有粗哑的声音。

gruff.en: His gruff manner scared the children.
gruff.zh: 他粗鲁的态度吓到了孩子们。

brazen.en: She made a brazen attempt to cheat.
brazen.zh: 她厚颜无耻地试图作弊。

brazen.en: The brazen statue stood in the square.
brazen.zh: 黄铜制的雕像矗立在广场上。

sultry.en: The sultry weather made everyone sweat.
sultry.zh: 闷热的天气让每个人出汗。

sultry.en: She gave him a sultry look across the room.
sultry.zh: 她在房间对面给了他一个放荡的眼神。

ordinance.en: The city passed a new parking ordinance.
ordinance.zh: 城市通过了一项新的停车条例。

ordinance.en: The ordinance prohibits loud noise at night.
ordinance.zh: 这项法令禁止夜间大声喧哗。

transitory.en: Happiness can be transitory in life.
transitory.zh: 幸福在生活中可能是短暂的。

transitory.en: The beauty of flowers is transitory.

quip.en: He made a clever quip during the meeting.
quip.zh: 他在会议中说了句聪明的妙语。

quip.en: She responded with a quick quip and smile.
quip.zh: 她用一句快速的讽刺话和微笑回应。

roster.en: The team roster has twenty players.
roster.zh: 球队花名册上有二十名球员。

roster.en: Check the roster for your shift time.
roster.zh: 查看花名册了解你的班次时间。

quarantine.en: The patient was put in quarantine.
They had to quarantine the sick animals.
quarantine.zh: 他们必须隔离生病的动物。

scythe.en: He used a scythe to cut the grass.
The farmer scythed the field in the morning.
scythe.zh: 农民早上用大镰刀割了田地。

unrepentant.en: He remained unrepentant for his actions.
unrepentant.zh: 他对自己的行为毫不悔改。

unrepentant.en: The unrepentant criminal showed no remorse.
unrepentant.zh: 这个不改悔的罪犯没有表现出悔意。

temerity.en: He had the temerity to argue with the boss.
Her temerity surprised everyone in the room.
temerity.zh: 她的蛮勇让房间里每个人惊讶。

replete.en: The book is replete with useful information.
replete.zh: 这本书充满了有用的信息。

replete.en: After the meal, he felt replete and happy.
replete.zh: 饭后，他感到吃饱了且快乐。

redoubtable.en: She is a redoubtable opponent in chess.
redoubtable.zh: 她在象棋中是个可敬的对手。

redoubtable.en: The redoubtable warrior led the army.
redoubtable.zh: 这个厉害的战士领导了军队。

redolent.en: The garden was redolent of roses.
redolent.zh: 花园里弥漫着玫瑰的芬芳。

redolent.en: This old book is redolent of history.
redolent.zh: 这本旧书令人想起历史。

precipice.en: He stood at the edge of the precipice.
The car nearly fell off the precipice.

nebulous.en: His plan was still very nebulous.
The idea seemed nebulous and unclear.
nebulous.zh: 这个想法似乎朦胧不清。

minutia.en: She focused on the minutia of the task.

figurehead.en: The king was just a figurehead.
The ship had a wooden figurehead.
figurehead.zh: 这艘船有一个木制船头人像。

attrition.en: The war was a war of attrition.
attrition.zh: 这场战争是一场消耗战。
消耗削弱了敌人的力量。

wick.en: The candle wick needs to be trimmed.
He replaced the old lamp wick.

underscore.en: This event underscores the need for change.
underscore.zh: 这一事件强调了变革的必要性。

tussle.en: The two boys had a tussle over the toy.
tussle.zh: 两个男孩为玩具扭打起来。
他们短暂扭打后分开了。

naivety.en: Her naivety made her trust everyone.
naivety.zh: 她的天真使她信任每个人。

naivety.en: He was amused by her childlike naivety.
naivety.zh: 他被她孩子气的天真逗乐了。

improvised.zh: 他们进行了一场即兴表演。

improvised.en: We used an improvised shelter for the night.
improvised.zh: 我们用了临时准备的庇护所过夜。

daunt.en: The difficult task did not daunt her.
daunt.zh: 艰巨的任务没有吓倒她。

artistry.en: Her artistry in painting is remarkable.
artistry.zh: 她在绘画方面的艺术性很出色。
这位音乐家展现了高超的艺术性。

alias.en: He used an alias to hide his identity.

vindication.en: The evidence was a vindication of his claims.

vendetta.en: The two families had a long vendetta.
vendetta.zh: 这两个家族有长期的世仇。

vendetta.en: He started a vendetta against his rival.

rendition.en: Her rendition of the song was beautiful.
rendition.zh: 她对这首歌的表演很优美。

rendition.en: The actor gave a powerful rendition.
rendition.zh: 这位演员给出了有力的表演。

manifold.en: The benefits of exercise are manifold.
manifold.zh: 锻炼的好处是多方面的。

manifold.en: He had manifold responsibilities at work.
manifold.zh: 他在工作中有多种责任。

legible.en: Her handwriting is neat and legible.
Make sure your signature is legible.
legible.zh: 确保你的签名清晰可辨。

inimical.en: The cold weather was inimical to plants.
His attitude was inimical to cooperation.
inimical.zh: 他的态度对合作有敌意。

gullible.en: He is too gullible and believes everything.

gullible.zh: 骗子以易受骗的人为目标。

remonstrate.en: She remonstrated with him about his behavior.
remonstrate.zh: 她对他的行为表示抗议。

remonstrate.en: They remonstrated against the new policy.

morose.en: He has been morose since losing his job.

morose.zh: 她郁闷的情绪影响了每个人。

digress.en: Let me not digress from the main point.
He tends to digress during lectures.
digress.zh: 他讲课时容易扯到枝节上。

capitalize.en: You should capitalize the first letter.
capitalize.zh: 你应该大写第一个字母。

capitalize.en: She capitalized on her good luck.

ascetic.en: He lived an ascetic life in the mountains.
ascetic.zh: 他在山里过着苦行的生活。

ascetic.en: The monk was known for his ascetic practices.
ascetic.zh: 这位僧人以禁欲修行闻名。

interpose.en: She interposed a question during the meeting.
interpose.zh: 她在会议中插嘴问了一个问题。

interpose.en: He interposed himself between the fighters.

insular.en: The island has an insular culture.
insular.zh: 这个岛有与世隔绝的文化。

insular.en: His views are quite insular and narrow.
insular.zh: 他的观点相当保守狭隘。

grating.en: The metal grating covered the drain.
grating.zh: 金属格栅盖住了排水沟。

grating.en: Her voice had a grating sound.

fraternal.en: They have a fraternal bond like brothers.
The fraternal organization helps the community.
fraternal.zh: 这个兄弟会组织帮助社区。

ameliorate.en: We need to ameliorate the living conditions.
ameliorate.zh: 我们需要改善生活条件。

ameliorate.en: The new policy will ameliorate the situation.

bottleneck.en: Traffic creates a bottleneck on the highway.
bottleneck.zh: 交通在高速公路上造成瓶颈。

bottleneck.en: The process has a bottleneck in production.
bottleneck.zh: 这个过程在生产中有瓶颈。

boo.en: The crowd began to boo the speaker.
boo.zh: 人群开始对演讲者喝倒彩。

boo.en: He heard a loud boo from the audience.
boo.zh: 他听到观众发出大声的嘘声。

germinate.en: The idea began to germinate in his mind.
germinate.zh: 这个想法开始在他脑中萌芽。

chameleon.en: The chameleon changed its color to blend in.
chameleon.zh: 变色龙改变颜色以融入环境。

chameleon.en: He is a political chameleon, always adapting.
chameleon.zh: 他是个政治上的善变者，总是适应。

seine.en: They used a seine to catch fish.
The fishermen seined the river for salmon.
seine.zh: 渔民在河里用曳网捕鲑鱼。

phobia.en: She has a phobia of spiders.
His phobia of heights keeps him indoors.
phobia.zh: 他的恐高症让他待在室内。

gregarious.en: She is a gregarious person who loves parties.
gregarious.zh: 她是个爱社交的人，喜欢派对。

unsubstantiated.en: The claim was unsubstantiated by evidence.
unsubstantiated.zh: 这个说法未经证据证实。
他提出了未经证实的指控。

unbridled.zh: 他无拘束的愤怒吓坏了每个人。

unbridled.en: She showed unbridled enthusiasm for the project.
unbridled.zh: 她对项目表现出不受控制的热情。

shackle.en: The prisoner wore a heavy shackle on his leg.
shackle.zh: 囚犯腿上戴着沉重的镣铐。

shackle.en: Fear can shackle your dreams and ambitions.
shackle.zh: 恐惧会束缚你的梦想和抱负。

resound.en: The music will resound through the hall.
His laughter resounded across the quiet room.
resound.zh: 他的笑声在安静的房间里回响。

enmesh.en: The bird became enmeshed in the net.
He was enmeshed in a web of lies.
enmesh.zh: 他陷入了一个谎言网中。

cogent.en: She gave a cogent argument for the plan.
cogent.zh: 她为这个计划提出了有说服力的论点。

cogent.en: His reasoning was clear and cogent.
cogent.zh: 他的推理清晰且令人信服。

unfailing.zh: 她经久不衰的善良感动了每个人。

unfailing.en: He is an unfailing source of support.
unfailing.zh: 他是一个可靠的支持来源。

opportune.en: This is an opportune moment to speak.
opportune.zh: 这是一个说话的好时机。

lamentable.zh: 这支队伍的表现令人惋惜。

lamentable.en: It is a lamentable state of affairs.

eavesdrop.en: She tried to eavesdrop on their conversation.
eavesdrop.zh: 她试图偷听他们的谈话。

eavesdrop.en: It is rude to eavesdrop on others.
eavesdrop.zh: 偷听别人说话是不礼貌的。

decry.en: Many people decry the new policy.
decry.zh: 许多人谴责这项新政策。

decry.en: They decry the lack of honesty in politics.
decry.zh: 他们谴责政治中缺乏诚信。

blissful.en: They spent a blissful day at the beach.
blissful.zh: 他们在海滩度过了充满喜悦的一天。
这对夫妇在一起看起来非常幸福。

acrimony.en: The meeting was filled with acrimony.
acrimony.zh: 会议充满了尖刻的言辞。

acrimony.en: Their divorce was marked by acrimony.
acrimony.zh: 他们的离婚充满了尖刻。

wistful.en: She had a wistful look in her eyes.
wistful.zh: 她眼中带着渴望的神情。

wistful.en: He felt wistful about his childhood.

scald.en: Be careful not to scald your hand.
The hot water gave him a bad scald.
scald.zh: 热水给他造成了严重的烫伤。

prodigal.en: The prodigal son returned home at last.
He was a prodigal with his money.

crockery.en: She washed all the crockery after dinner.
crockery.zh: 晚饭后她洗了所有陶器。

crockery.en: The cupboard is full of fine crockery.
crockery.zh: 橱柜里装满了精美的陶器。

annotate.en: Please annotate the text with notes.
The teacher asked us to annotate the poem.
annotate.zh: 老师要求我们给这首诗作注解。

alacrity.en: She accepted the offer with alacrity.
alacrity.zh: 她欣然接受了这个提议。

alacrity.en: He jumped to help with great alacrity.
alacrity.zh: 他非常敏捷地跳起来帮忙。

unguarded.en: He made an unguarded comment about her.
unguarded.zh: 他对她做了一个不留神的评论。

unguarded.en: The door was left unguarded all night.

nexus.en: The city is a nexus of trade routes.
nexus.zh: 这个城市是贸易路线的连接点。

nexus.en: There is a nexus between poverty and crime.
nexus.zh: 贫困和犯罪之间有联系。

mire.en: The car got stuck in the mire.
He was mired in debt for years.

idyll.zh: 他们在农场的生活是一首田园诗。

apposite.zh: 她的评论与讨论非常贴切。

vicissitude.zh: 他平静地忍受了命运的盛衰。

inexhaustible.en: The ocean is an inexhaustible source of water.
inexhaustible.zh: 海洋是取之不尽的水源。

volition.zh: 她凭自己的意志做了决定。

acrid.zh: 辛辣的烟雾让每个人都咳嗽。

acrid.en: His acrid remarks hurt her feelings.
acrid.zh: 他刻薄的言论伤害了她的感情。

transcendental.en: He had a transcendental meditation experience.
transcendental.zh: 他有一次超凡的冥想体验。
先验哲学探索精神真理。

scalpel.en: The surgeon used a sharp scalpel.
scalpel.zh: 外科医生使用了一把锋利的手术刀。

scalpel.en: He carefully held the scalpel in his hand.

pennant.en: The team won the pennant this year.
pennant.zh: 这支队伍今年赢得了锦旗。

pennant.en: A pennant flew from the ship's mast.
pennant.zh: 一面三角旗从船桅上飘扬。

plumb.en: The wall is not plumb; it leans slightly.
plumb.zh: 这面墙不垂直，有点倾斜。

plumb.en: He used a plumb to check the depth.

ballast.en: The ship needs more ballast for stability.
ballast.zh: 船需要更多压舱物来保持稳定。

ballast.en: Gravel is used as ballast for the railroad.
ballast.zh: 砾石被用作铁路的道砟。

personification.en: She is the personification of kindness.
The poet used personification in his poem.
personification.zh: 诗人在诗中使用了拟人法。

lout.en: That lout pushed me on the bus.
lout.zh: 那个蠢人在公交车上推了我。

lout.en: Don't act like a lout in public.
lout.zh: 别在公共场合表现得像个蠢人。

caper.en: The lamb began to caper in the field.
caper.zh: 小羊开始在田野里跳跃。

caper.en: She added capers to the salad.
caper.zh: 她在沙拉里加了刺山柑花蕾。

appendage.en: The tail is an appendage of the animal.
He considered the job an unnecessary appendage.
appendage.zh: 他认为这份工作是多余的附加物。

uncouth.zh: 他粗野的举止让每个人都尴尬。

uncouth.en: She found his behavior uncouth and rude.
uncouth.zh: 她觉得他的行为笨拙且粗鲁。

revile.en: They began to revile the politician loudly.
revile.zh: 他们开始大声辱骂那位政客。

revile.en: Do not revile others in anger.
revile.zh: 不要在愤怒中斥责他人。

plummet.zh: 股票价格一夜之间暴跌。

plummet.en: Temperatures plummeted below freezing last night.
plummet.zh: 昨晚气温骤降至冰点以下。

gamut.en: Her emotions ran the gamut from joy to sorrow.
gamut.zh: 她的情绪从喜悦到悲伤涵盖了整个范围。

gamut.en: The music covered the entire gamut of notes.

feckless.en: The feckless manager lost the contract.
feckless.zh: 无能的经理丢掉了合同。

feckless.en: He was criticized for his feckless behavior.
feckless.zh: 他因不负责任的行为而受到批评。

exterminate.en: They plan to exterminate the pests.
The disease could exterminate the entire population.
exterminate.zh: 这种疾病可能根绝整个种群。

disembodied.en: A disembodied voice spoke from the darkness.
disembodied.zh: 一个脱离肉体的声音从黑暗中传来。

disembodied.en: He felt like a disembodied spirit.
disembodied.zh: 他感觉自己像一个脱离肉体的灵魂。

consummate.en: She is a consummate professional in her field.
consummate.zh: 她是自己领域里完美的专业人士。

consummate.en: They consummated their marriage with a ceremony.
consummate.zh: 他们通过仪式完成了婚姻。

unwitting.en: He was an unwitting participant in the crime.
unwitting.zh: 他是这起犯罪的不知情参与者。

unwitting.en: She made an unwitting mistake on the test.
unwitting.zh: 她在测试中犯了一个无意识的错误。

swipe.en: He took a swipe at the ball.
She swiped her card to enter the building.

sinew.en: The athlete has strong sinews in his legs.
sinew.zh: 这位运动员腿上有强健的肌肉。

sinew.en: He pulled a sinew while running.

perishable.en: Milk is a perishable food item.
Store perishable goods in the refrigerator.
perishable.zh: 将易腐坏的食物存放在冰箱里。

lug.en: He had to lug the heavy suitcase upstairs.
lug.zh: 他不得不把沉重的行李箱拖上楼。

lug.en: The lug on the machine broke off.
lug.zh: 机器上的耳状物断裂了。

kindred.en: They are kindred spirits who love art.
kindred.zh: 他们是热爱艺术的志趣相投的人。

kindred.en: She met her kindred relatives at the reunion.
kindred.zh: 她在聚会上遇到了同族的亲戚。

grisly.en: The movie had a grisly murder scene.
grisly.zh: 电影里有一个可怕的谋杀场景。

grisly.en: They found a grisly sight in the forest.
grisly.zh: 他们在森林里发现了一个令人畏惧的景象。

flabby.en: He has flabby muscles from lack of exercise.
flabby.zh: 他因缺乏锻炼而肌肉松弛。

flabby.en: Her flabby argument was easily defeated.
flabby.zh: 她软弱的论点轻易被驳倒了。

desultory.en: His desultory reading habits annoyed the teacher.
desultory.zh: 他散漫的阅读习惯让老师恼火。

desultory.en: They had a desultory conversation about the weather.
desultory.zh: 他们进行了一次关于天气的漫无目的的谈话。

daub.en: He tried to daub paint on the wall.
daub.zh: 他试图在墙上涂抹油漆。

daub.en: The child's painting was just a daub.
daub.zh: 孩子的画只是一幅拙劣的画。

convoluted.en: The plot of the story was very convoluted.
She gave a convoluted explanation for her absence.
convoluted.zh: 她对缺席给出了一个复杂的解释。

compendium.en: This book is a compendium of useful facts.
compendium.zh: 这本书是有用事实的纲要。

compendium.en: He published a compendium of his research.
compendium.zh: 他出版了自己研究的概略。

balmy.en: The balmy breeze felt pleasant on the skin.
balmy.zh: 温和的微风拂过皮肤感觉很舒适。

balmy.en: We enjoyed a balmy evening by the sea.
balmy.zh: 我们在海边享受了一个温和的夜晚。

tepid.en: The water in the pool was tepid.
tepid.zh: 游泳池里的水是微温的。

tepid.en: His tepid response showed little interest.
tepid.zh: 他不太热烈的回应显示出没什么兴趣。

prank.en: He played a silly prank on his friend.
prank.zh: 他对朋友开了一个愚蠢的玩笑。

prank.en: The prank made everyone laugh at school.
prank.zh: 这个恶作剧让学校里的每个人都笑了。

pallid.en: Her face looked pallid after the long illness.
pallid.zh: 久病之后她的脸色看起来很苍白。

pallid.en: The pallid sky signaled an approaching storm.
pallid.zh: 暗淡的天空预示着暴风雨的来临。

inscrutable.en: His expression remained inscrutable during the meeting.
inscrutable.zh: 会议期间他的表情仍然难以捉摸。

inscrutable.en: The ancient text was inscrutable to modern readers.
inscrutable.zh: 古代文本对现代读者来说是无法理解的。

incendiary.en: The incendiary device was found near the building.
incendiary.zh: 燃烧装置在大楼附近被发现。

incendiary.en: His speech was incendiary and caused a riot.
incendiary.zh: 他的演讲具有煽动性，引发了一场骚乱。

grumpy.en: The old man was grumpy because he didn't sleep well.
grumpy.zh: 老人脾气暴躁，因为他没睡好。

grumpy.en: She felt grumpy after waiting for an hour.
grumpy.zh: 等了一个小时后，她感到生气。

gloat.en: He couldn't help but gloat over his victory.
gloat.zh: 他忍不住对自己的胜利幸灾乐祸。

gloat.en: She gave a gloat when she saw his mistake.
gloat.zh: 看到他犯错时，她露出了满足的注视。

exorcise.en: The priest tried to exorcise the evil spirit.
They performed a ritual to exorcise the ghost.
exorcise.zh: 他们举行仪式来驱除鬼怪。

ethereal.en: The music had an ethereal quality that calmed her.
ethereal.zh: 音乐有一种飘渺的特质，让她平静下来。

ethereal.en: The ethereal beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
ethereal.zh: 日落那超凡脱俗的美让每个人惊叹。

debar.en: The new rule will debar students from cheating.
debar.zh: 新规定将防止学生作弊。

debar.en: They debar anyone under eighteen from entering.
debar.zh: 他们禁止任何十八岁以下的人进入。

cactus.en: The cactus grows well in dry desert areas.
cactus.zh: 仙人掌在干燥的沙漠地区生长良好。

cactus.en: She bought a small cactus for her desk.
cactus.zh: 她为她的桌子买了一棵小仙人掌。

truism.en: It is a truism that hard work pays off.
truism.zh: 努力工作会有回报是自明之理。

truism.en: The statement was a truism everyone already knew.
truism.zh: 这个说法是每个人都知道的老生常谈。

sedative.en: The doctor gave her a sedative to help her sleep.
sedative.zh: 医生给了她镇静剂帮助她入睡。

sedative.en: This tea has a natural sedative effect on the body.
sedative.zh: 这种茶对身体有天然的镇静作用。

preservative.en: This food contains no artificial preservatives.
preservative.zh: 这种食物不含人工防腐剂。

preservative.en: Salt acts as a preservative for meat.

livid.en: He was livid when he heard the bad news.
livid.zh: 听到坏消息时，他脸色铁青。

livid.en: Her livid expression showed how angry she was.
livid.zh: 她铁青的表情显示了她有多生气。

juxtapose.en: The artist likes to juxtapose light and dark colors.
juxtapose.zh: 艺术家喜欢将明亮和暗色并置。

juxtapose.en: We can juxtapose the two ideas for comparison.
juxtapose.zh: 我们可以将这两个想法并列进行比较。

decorum.en: He behaved with great decorum at the formal dinner.
decorum.zh: 他在正式晚宴上表现得很有礼貌。

decorum.en: The students maintained decorum during the ceremony.
decorum.zh: 学生们在仪式上保持了礼仪。

steeple.en: The church steeple can be seen from far away.
steeple.zh: 教堂的尖塔从远处就能看到。

steeple.en: Birds often sit on top of the steeple.
steeple.zh: 鸟儿经常坐在尖塔顶上。

prodigy.en: The young pianist was a prodigy at age five.
prodigy.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在五岁时就是个神童。

prodigy.en: She is a prodigy in mathematics and science.
prodigy.zh: 她在数学和科学方面是个奇才。

ferment.en: The grapes ferment to make wine in the cellar.
ferment.zh: 葡萄在地窖里发酵制成酒。

ferment.en: Political ferment spread quickly through the country.
ferment.zh: 政治动乱迅速在全国蔓延。

quack.en: The duck made a loud quack by the pond.
quack.zh: 鸭子在池塘边发出响亮的叫声。

quack.en: Don't trust that quack who sells fake medicine.
quack.zh: 不要相信那个卖假药的冒牌医生。

collude.en: The two companies colluded to fix the prices.
collude.zh: 这两家公司串通一气操纵价格。

collude.en: They collude in secret to cheat the system.
collude.zh: 他们秘密勾结来欺骗系统。

gangway.en: Please make a gangway for the emergency workers.
gangway.zh: 请为急救人员让出一条通道。

gangway.en: The sailors walked across the gangway to the ship.
gangway.zh: 水手们走过跳板上了船。

chalice.en: The priest held a golden chalice during the service.
chalice.zh: 牧师在仪式中手持一个金圣餐杯。

chalice.en: She drank wine from a beautiful silver chalice.
chalice.zh: 她用一只漂亮的银酒杯喝酒。

decibel.en: The noise reached a dangerous level of decibels.
decibel.zh: 噪音达到了危险的分贝水平。

decibel.en: A whisper is about twenty decibels in sound.
decibel.zh: 耳语的声音大约有二十分贝。

predisposition.en: She has a genetic predisposition to heart disease.
predisposition.zh: 她有心脏病的遗传倾向。

predisposition.en: His upbringing gave him a predisposition to be kind.
predisposition.zh: 他的成长经历使他天生善良。

fractional.en: There was only a fractional increase in sales.
fractional.zh: 销售额只有微小的增长。

fractional.en: The fractional ownership of the house is shared.
fractional.zh: 房子的部分所有权是共享的。

unicorn.en: The child dreamed of riding a magical unicorn.
unicorn.zh: 孩子梦想骑着一只神奇的独角兽。

unicorn.en: Unicorns are often depicted as white horses with horns.
unicorn.zh: 独角兽常被描绘成有角的白马。

duckling.en: The duckling followed its mother to the pond.
duckling.zh: 小鸭子跟着妈妈去了池塘。

duckling.en: A yellow duckling is very cute and fluffy.
duckling.zh: 黄色的小鸭子非常可爱和毛茸茸的。

sentinel.en: The sentinel stood guard at the castle gate.
A sentinel watches for any sign of danger.
sentinel.zh: 哨兵警戒任何危险的迹象。

privation.en: The family suffered great privation during the war.
privation.zh: 战争期间这家人遭受了极大的贫困。

privation.en: He endured years of privation in the wilderness.
privation.zh: 他在荒野中忍受了多年的穷困。

invigorating.en: The cold shower was invigorating in the morning.
invigorating.zh: 早上的冷水澡令人精力充沛。

invigorating.en: A walk in the fresh air is very invigorating.
invigorating.zh: 在新鲜空气中散步非常提神。

harbinger.en: The first robin is a harbinger of spring.
harbinger.zh: 第一只知更鸟是春天的预兆。

harbinger.en: Dark clouds are often a harbinger of rain.
harbinger.zh: 乌云通常是下雨的先兆。

unregulated.en: The unregulated market caused many problems.
unregulated.zh: 未经调节的市场导致了许多问题。

unregulated.en: Unregulated fishing harms the ocean ecosystem.
unregulated.zh: 未受监管的捕捞危害海洋生态系统。

ungainly.en: The young giraffe looked ungainly when it walked.
ungainly.zh: 小长颈鹿走路时显得笨拙。

ungainly.en: His ungainly movements made everyone laugh.
ungainly.zh: 他笨拙的动作让每个人都笑了。

renown.en: The scientist achieved great renown for her work.
renown.zh: 这位科学家因她的工作获得了巨大声望。

renown.en: His renown as a painter spread across the world.
renown.zh: 他作为画家的名声传遍了世界。

proscribe.en: The law proscribes the use of certain chemicals.
proscribe.zh: 法律禁止使用某些化学品。

proscribe.en: The school proscribes bullying in any form.
proscribe.zh: 学校禁止任何形式的欺凌。

plaintive.en: The dog gave a plaintive whine at the door.
plaintive.zh: 狗在门口发出哀伤的呜咽声。

plaintive.en: Her plaintive song touched everyone's heart.
plaintive.zh: 她哀伤的歌曲触动了每个人的心。

laconic.en: His laconic reply was just a single word.
laconic.zh: 他简洁的回答只有一个字。

laconic.en: She gave a laconic nod instead of speaking.
laconic.zh: 她简洁地点了点头，而不是说话。

impressionable.en: Young children are very impressionable and learn fast.
impressionable.zh: 小孩子非常易受影响，学得很快。

impressionable.en: He was impressionable and easily influenced by friends.
impressionable.zh: 他易受影响，很容易被朋友影响。

immemorial.en: This tradition has existed since time immemorial.
immemorial.zh: 这个传统从远古时代就存在了。

immemorial.en: The forest has been here from immemorial times.
immemorial.zh: 这片森林从远古时期就在这里。

hubbub.en: The hubbub in the market was overwhelming.
hubbub.zh: 市场里的吵闹声让人受不了。

hubbub.en: I couldn't hear him over the hubbub.
hubbub.zh: 在吵闹声中我听不见他说话。

holocaust.zh: 大屠杀造成了巨大的痛苦。

holocaust.en: They remember the holocaust every year.
holocaust.zh: 他们每年都纪念大屠杀。

brag.en: He likes to brag about his car.

barbarous.zh: 这野蛮的行为震惊了所有人。

barbarous.en: Their barbarous treatment of prisoners was cruel.
barbarous.zh: 他们对囚犯的野蛮待遇很残忍。

vicarious.en: She felt vicarious joy through her son.
vicarious.zh: 她通过儿子感受到间接的快乐。

vicarious.en: He gets vicarious thrills from movies.
vicarious.zh: 他从电影中获得替代性的刺激。

verve.en: She danced with great verve and energy.
verve.zh: 她带着极大的热情和活力跳舞。

verve.en: His speech was full of verve.

smudge.en: There is a smudge on the window.
Don't smudge the painting with your fingers.
smudge.zh: 不要用手指弄脏这幅画。

skew.en: His opinion may skew the results.
skew.zh: 他的意见可能会使结果产生偏差。

riveting.zh: 这个故事非常引人入胜。
我觉得这部纪录片很吸引人。

rickety.en: The old chair is rickety and unsafe.
rickety.zh: 这把旧椅子摇摇晃晃，不安全。

rickety.en: They live in a rickety wooden house.
rickety.zh: 他们住在一间摇摇欲坠的木屋里。

oatmeal.en: I eat oatmeal for breakfast every day.
She added honey to her oatmeal.
oatmeal.zh: 她在燕麦粥里加了蜂蜜。

needlework.en: She enjoys doing needlework in her free time.
needlework.zh: 她喜欢在空闲时间做针线活。

needlework.en: The needlework on this dress is beautiful.
needlework.zh: 这件裙子上的刺绣很漂亮。

loiter.en: Don't loiter near the school gate.
He was warned not to loiter in the mall.
loiter.zh: 他被警告不要在商场里闲荡。

indefatigable.zh: 她是一个不知疲倦的工作者。
他不知疲倦的精神激励了每个人。

ensconce.en: She ensconced herself in a cozy chair.
ensconce.zh: 她安顿在一张舒适的椅子里。

ensconce.en: He ensconced himself in the corner of the room.
ensconce.zh: 他把自己安置在房间的角落里。

dejected.en: He looked dejected after losing the game.
dejected.zh: 输掉比赛后，他看起来很沮丧。

dejected.en: She felt dejected by the bad news.
dejected.zh: 她因坏消息而感到沮丧。

contort.en: Don't contort the truth to fit your story.
contort.zh: 不要扭曲事实来迎合你的说法。

codify.en: They want to codify the new rules.
codify.zh: 他们想把新规则编成法典。

codify.en: The lawyer helped codify the company's policies.
codify.zh: 律师帮助编纂了公司的政策。

aphorism.en: He often quotes a famous aphorism.
aphorism.zh: 他经常引用一句著名的格言。

aphorism.en: This aphorism teaches us about patience.
aphorism.zh: 这句格言教会我们耐心。

accost.en: A stranger accosted her on the street.
accost.zh: 一个陌生人在街上跟她搭讪。

accost.en: He was accosted by a beggar for money.
accost.zh: 一个乞丐上前向他讨钱。

servile.en: His servile attitude annoyed his boss.
servile.zh: 他卑躬屈膝的态度惹恼了老板。

servile.en: She refused to be servile to anyone.
servile.zh: 她拒绝向任何人卑躬屈膝。

rapt.en: The children listened with rapt attention.
rapt.zh: 孩子们全神贯注地听着。

rapt.en: She was rapt in her book.

evince.en: He evinced great interest in the project.
evince.zh: 他对这个项目表现出极大的兴趣。

evince.en: She evinced no surprise at the news.
evince.zh: 她对这消息没有表现出惊讶。

decadence.en: The city's decadence worried many people.
decadence.zh: 这座城市的颓废让许多人担忧。

decadence.en: They criticized the decadence of modern society.
decadence.zh: 他们批评现代社会的颓废。

cob.en: He fed the horse some corn on the cob.
A cob is a type of horse.

cacophony.en: The cacophony of traffic kept me awake.
cacophony.zh: 交通的嘈杂声让我睡不着。

cacophony.en: The classroom was a cacophony of voices.
cacophony.zh: 教室里一片嘈杂的说话声。

artifact.en: This artifact is from ancient Egypt.
artifact.zh: 这件人工制品来自古埃及。

artifact.en: The museum displays many historical artifacts.
artifact.zh: 博物馆展示了许多历史文物。

schism.en: The schism divided the political party.
schism.zh: 分裂使政党分成了两派。

schism.en: A schism occurred in the religious group.
schism.zh: 这个宗教团体内部发生了分裂。

saintly.en: She led a saintly life of service.
saintly.zh: 她过着圣洁的奉献生活。

saintly.en: His saintly behavior earned him respect.

heretic.zh: 异教徒因其信仰而受到惩罚。

heretic.en: In history, a heretic often faced severe consequences.
heretic.zh: 历史上，异端者常常面临严重后果。

bullion.en: The bank stores gold bullion in its vault.
bullion.zh: 银行在金库中储存金条。

bullion.en: Bullion is often traded as bars or ingots.
bullion.zh: 金银通常以条或锭的形式交易。

habitable.en: The house is habitable after the repairs.
habitable.zh: 房子修理后可以居住了。

habitable.en: Scientists search for habitable planets in space.
habitable.zh: 科学家在太空中寻找适宜居住的行星。

lubricant.en: Use lubricant to reduce friction in the engine.
lubricant.zh: 使用润滑油减少发动机的摩擦。

lubricant.en: The mechanic applied lubricant to the squeaky door.
lubricant.zh: 机械师给吱吱作响的门上了润滑剂。

mackintosh.en: She wore a mackintosh to stay dry in the rain.
mackintosh.zh: 她穿了件雨衣以在雨中保持干燥。

mackintosh.en: His old mackintosh was made of rubberized fabric.
mackintosh.zh: 他的旧雨衣是用防水胶布做的。

regressive.en: The tax system is regressive for low-income people.
regressive.zh: 这个税收制度对低收入人群是倒退的。

regressive.en: His regressive behavior made him seem younger.
regressive.zh: 他退化的行为让他显得更年轻。

totem.en: The tribe used a totem pole to tell stories.
totem.zh: 部落用图腾柱来讲述故事。

totem.en: Each family has its own totem animal for protection.
totem.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的图腾动物以求保护。

squall.en: A sudden squall hit the boat during the storm.
squall.zh: 暴风雨中一阵突然的飑袭击了船。

squall.en: The baby began to squall loudly for attention.
squall.zh: 婴儿开始大声哭闹以引起注意。

juggernaut.en: The company became a juggernaut in the industry.
juggernaut.zh: 那家公司成了行业中的主宰力量。

juggernaut.en: The juggernaut of change crushed all opposition.
juggernaut.zh: 变革的巨力碾压了所有反对。

attenuate.en: The medicine helps attenuate the pain over time.
attenuate.zh: 这种药随时间推移有助于减轻疼痛。

attenuate.en: The signal will attenuate if you go too far.
attenuate.zh: 如果你走得太远，信号会减弱。

simile.en: A simile uses 'like' or 'as' to compare things.
simile.zh: 明喻用‘像’或‘如同’来比较事物。

simile.en: Her smile was like sunshine is a common simile.
simile.zh: 她的笑容像阳光是一个常见的明喻。

fiend.en: The villain in the story was a cruel fiend.
fiend.zh: 故事中的反派是个残忍的魔鬼。

fiend.en: He is a fiend for chocolate and eats it daily.
fiend.zh: 他是个巧克力狂，每天都吃。

gallows.en: The criminal was sent to the gallows for his crime.
gallows.zh: 罪犯因罪行被送上绞刑架。

gallows.en: The gallows stood tall in the town square.
gallows.zh: 绞刑架高高矗立在镇广场上。

morass.en: The hiker got stuck in a muddy morass.
morass.zh: 徒步者陷入了一片泥泞的沼泽。

morass.en: The project became a morass of confusion and delay.
morass.zh: 项目变成了一团混乱和拖延的困境。

halcyon.en: Those were halcyon days of peace and happiness.
halcyon.zh: 那些是宁静幸福的日子。

halcyon.en: The halcyon bird is said to calm the sea.
halcyon.zh: 据说翡翠鸟能平息海浪。

foible.en: His main foible is being late for meetings.
foible.zh: 他的主要缺点是开会迟到。

foible.en: Everyone has a small foible that makes them unique.
foible.zh: 每个人都有一个小缺点，这让他们独特。

virility.en: He wanted to prove his virility through sports.
virility.zh: 他想通过运动证明自己的男子气概。

virility.en: The ancient statue symbolized strength and virility.
virility.zh: 那座古代雕像象征着力量和雄浑。

sartorial.en: He has a keen sartorial sense.
Her sartorial style is always elegant.
sartorial.zh: 她的裁缝风格总是优雅。

probity.en: She is known for her probity.

mollify.en: He tried to mollify his angry boss.
mollify.zh: 他试图平息老板的怒气。

mollify.en: A kind word can mollify a tense situation.
mollify.zh: 一句好话能缓和紧张局势。

invidious.zh: 那是一个引起反感的比较。

invidious.en: He made invidious remarks about her work.
invidious.zh: 他对她的工作说了惹人不快的话。

fractious.en: The fractious child refused to obey.
fractious.zh: 那个倔强的孩子拒绝服从。
一群易怒的人群聚集在外面。

exult.en: She exulted when she heard the news.
exult.zh: 她听到消息时非常高兴。

blanch.en: Blanch the vegetables for two minutes.
She blanched the almonds before cooking.
blanch.zh: 她在烹饪前将杏仁漂白。

aplomb.en: She handled the crisis with aplomb.
His aplomb impressed everyone in the room.
aplomb.zh: 他的泰然自若给房间里每个人留下印象。

sanctify.en: The priest will sanctify the new church.
sanctify.zh: 牧师将使新教堂神圣化。

sanctify.en: They sanctify the water for the ritual.
sanctify.zh: 他们为仪式使水神圣化。

infatuation.en: His infatuation with her faded quickly.
infatuation.zh: 他对她的迷恋很快消退。
青少年的迷恋可能很强烈。

gesticulate.en: He gesticulated wildly to get attention.
gesticulate.zh: 他疯狂地用手势吸引注意。

gesticulate.en: She gesticulated while telling the story.
gesticulate.zh: 她讲故事时用手势表达。

bane.en: Mosquitoes are the bane of summer.
Procrastination is the bane of productivity.

antagonize.en: His words antagonized the entire group.
antagonize.zh: 他的话引起了全组的反抗。

waddle.en: The duck waddled across the path.
waddle.zh: 鸭子摇摇摆摆地走过小路。

waddle.en: The toddler waddled toward his mother.
waddle.zh: 幼儿蹒跚地走向他母亲。

stash.en: He stashed the money under the bed.
She has a secret stash of chocolate.
stash.zh: 她有一个秘密的巧克力隐藏处。

sapling.en: The sapling grew into a tall tree.
He planted a sapling in the garden.
sapling.zh: 他在花园里种了一棵小树。

opine.en: He opined that the plan was flawed.
opine.zh: 他认为这个计划有缺陷。

opine.en: She opined on the matter openly.
opine.zh: 她公开地就此事发表意见。

insinuate.en: He tried to insinuate himself into the group.
insinuate.zh: 他试图巴结进入那个团体。

insinuate.en: She insinuated that he was lying.

inferno.en: The building was an inferno of flames.
inferno.zh: 那座建筑是火焰的地狱。

inferno.en: The forest fire turned into an inferno.
inferno.zh: 森林大火变成了地狱般的地方。

extraneous.en: That information is extraneous to the topic.

surcharge.en: There is a surcharge for late payment.
The airline surcharged for extra baggage.
surcharge.zh: 航空公司对额外行李收附加税。

dank.en: The basement felt cold and dank.
dank.zh: 地下室感觉又冷又阴湿。

dank.en: A dank smell came from the cave.
dank.zh: 一股潮湿的气味从洞穴传来。

affix.en: The prefix is an affix added to a word.
affix.zh: 前缀是加在单词上的词缀。

pervert.en: He tried to pervert the truth.
That person is a dangerous pervert.
pervert.zh: 那个人是危险的堕落者。

frigid.en: The frigid wind chilled us to the bone.
frigid.zh: 寒冷的寒风使我们冷彻骨髓。

frigid.en: She gave him a frigid stare.
frigid.zh: 她给了他一个冷淡的凝视。

concussion.en: He suffered a concussion from the fall.

frond.en: The fern's frond was green and lush.
A palm frond fell to the ground.

celibate.en: He chose to remain celibate for life.
The monk is a celibate person.

incongruity.en: There was an incongruity in his story.
incongruity.zh: 他的故事中有不协调之处。

incongruity.en: The incongruity of the colors was striking.
incongruity.zh: 颜色的不一致很引人注目。

uncommitted.en: He remains uncommitted to any plan.
uncommitted.zh: 他对任何计划都不受约束。

uncommitted.en: She is uncommitted to the project yet.
uncommitted.zh: 她尚未对项目做出承诺。

municipality.en: The municipality built a new park.
municipality.zh: 市政府建了一个新公园。
我们的自治区有干净的街道。

ballerina.en: The ballerina danced gracefully on stage.
ballerina.zh: 芭蕾舞女演员在舞台上优雅地跳舞。

ballerina.en: She dreams of becoming a ballerina.
ballerina.zh: 她梦想成为芭蕾舞女演员。

cleave.en: He cleaved the wood with an axe.
The knife can cleave through bone.

deleterious.en: Smoking has deleterious effects on health.
deleterious.zh: 吸烟对健康有有害影响。

deleterious.en: This chemical is deleterious to plants.
deleterious.zh: 这种化学物质对植物有害。

archetype.en: The hero is a common archetype in stories.
archetype.zh: 英雄是故事中常见的原型。

archetype.en: This design is the archetype of modern chairs.
archetype.zh: 这个设计是现代椅子的原型。

charlatan.zh: 不要相信那个江湖医的建议。

gradation.en: There is a gradation of colors in the sky.
gradation.zh: 天空中有颜色的逐渐变化。

gradation.en: The gradation of difficulty is clear.

quandary.en: She was in a quandary about what to do.
quandary.zh: 她对于做什么感到困惑。

quandary.en: His decision left him in a quandary.
quandary.zh: 他的决定使他陷入为难。

fulsome.en: His fulsome praise made everyone uncomfortable.
fulsome.zh: 他过分的赞扬让所有人都不舒服。

fulsome.en: She gave a fulsome apology that seemed fake.
fulsome.zh: 她做了过分的道歉，看起来很假。

mortify.en: He tried to mortify his body through fasting.
mortify.zh: 他试图通过禁欲来抑制身体。

mortify.en: Her criticism will mortify him deeply.
mortify.zh: 她的批评会让他深感羞辱。

interlock.zh: 拼图块完美地连锁在一起。

interlock.en: Their schedules interlock for the project.
interlock.zh: 他们的日程为项目而连结。

glib.en: His glib answer lacked real thought.
glib.zh: 他流畅的回答缺乏真正的思考。

glib.en: She gave a glib speech without substance.
glib.zh: 她做了一个流畅但没有实质的演讲。

diatribe.en: The politician launched a diatribe against his opponent.
diatribe.zh: 那位政治家对对手发起了抨击。

diatribe.en: Her diatribe lasted for over an hour.
diatribe.zh: 她的谴责持续了一个多小时。

declaim.en: He will declaim his poem at the event.
declaim.zh: 他将在活动上朗读他的诗。

declaim.en: She loves to declaim in front of a crowd.
declaim.zh: 她喜欢在人群前慷慨陈词。

chastise.en: The teacher will chastise the lazy student.
chastise.zh: 老师会责骂那个懒惰的学生。

chastise.en: Parents should not chastise children harshly.
chastise.zh: 父母不应严厉惩罚孩子。

thrall.en: He was a thrall to his own desires.
The kingdom kept many thralls for labor.
thrall.zh: 王国保留了许多奴隶做苦工。

obstinacy.en: His obstinacy made the negotiation difficult.
obstinacy.zh: 他的固执使谈判变得困难。

obstinacy.en: She showed obstinacy in refusing to change.
obstinacy.zh: 她表现出顽固，拒绝改变。

luxuriant.en: The garden has luxuriant green plants.
luxuriant.zh: 花园里有繁茂的绿色植物。

luxuriant.en: Her hair is thick and luxuriant.

luminary.en: She is a luminary in the field of science.
luminary.zh: 她是科学领域的杰出人物。
会议吸引了许多杰出人物。

cinder.en: A cinder flew out of the fire.
cinder.zh: 一块煤渣从火中飞出来。

cinder.en: The road was covered with cinder.

begrudge.en: I don't begrudge him his success.
She begrudged every minute spent waiting.
begrudge.zh: 她吝惜每一分钟等待的时间。

largesse.en: The king's largesse pleased the people.
largesse.zh: 国王的慷慨赠与使人民高兴。

largesse.en: She distributed largesse to the poor.
largesse.zh: 她把慷慨赠与物分发给穷人。

husk.en: Remove the husk from the corn.
The husk of the nut is hard.

babble.en: The baby began to babble happily.
babble.zh: 婴儿开始快乐地牙牙学语。

babble.en: Don't babble about things you don't know.
babble.zh: 不要喋喋不休地说你不知道的事情。

shimmer.en: The lake shimmered in the moonlight.
A soft shimmer came from the diamond.

reprove.en: The teacher will reprove the noisy student.
reprove.zh: 老师会责备吵闹的学生。

reprove.en: She reproved him for his rude behavior.
reprove.zh: 她因他粗鲁的行为而责骂他。

pastiche.en: The movie is a pastiche of old films.
pastiche.zh: 这部电影是旧电影的模仿作品。

pastiche.en: His painting is a pastiche of famous styles.
pastiche.zh: 他的画是著名风格的东拼西凑。

daze.en: The accident left him in a daze.
The bright light dazed her for a moment.
daze.zh: 明亮的灯光使她一时眼花缭乱。

azure.en: The sky is a beautiful azure today.
azure.zh: 今天天空是美丽的蔚蓝色。

virile.en: He has a virile and strong personality.

virile.zh: 运动员展现出男性的活力。

rostrum.en: The speaker stood on the rostrum.
He climbed onto the rostrum to speak.

fallible.en: The system is fallible and needs checks.
fallible.zh: 系统可能犯错，需要检查。

trowel.en: He used a trowel to spread cement.
The gardener dug with a small trowel.

recluse.en: He lives as a recluse in the mountains.
recluse.zh: 他作为隐遁者住在山里。

recluse.en: The writer became a recluse after fame.
recluse.zh: 那位作家成名后成了遁世者。

fatuous.zh: 他愚笨的评论惹恼了所有人。

fatuous.en: She gave a fatuous smile without reason.
fatuous.zh: 她无缘无故地露出发呆的微笑。

pantheon.en: The ancient Greeks had a pantheon of gods.

glade.en: They found a sunny glade in the forest.
glade.zh: 他们在森林里找到一块阳光明媚的林间空地。

glade.en: The deer rested in the quiet glade.
glade.zh: 鹿在安静的林间空地休息。

epitomize.zh: 这座建筑概括了现代建筑。

whit.en: I don't care a whit about his opinion.
whit.zh: 我一点也不在乎他的意见。

whit.en: There is not a whit of truth in it.

sluice.en: The sluice gate controls the water flow.
They sluice the floor with water.

ail.en: He has been ailing for weeks.

ingest.zh: 你应该摄取足够的维生素。

ingest.en: The medicine is easy to ingest.

sprightly.en: The old man is still sprightly.
She danced sprightly across the stage.
sprightly.zh: 她活泼地跳舞穿过舞台。

intransigent.en: The intransigent leader refused to negotiate.
intransigent.zh: 不妥协的领袖拒绝谈判。

intransigent.en: He remained intransigent despite the pleas.
intransigent.zh: 尽管恳求，他仍然不妥协。

foolproof.en: This plan is foolproof and simple.
foolproof.zh: 这个计划十分简单且安全。

foolproof.en: The system is designed to be foolproof.

doyen.en: He is the doyen of the film industry.
The doyen of the group gave a speech.
doyen.zh: 团体的首席发表了演讲。

unseemly.en: His unseemly behavior shocked everyone at the party.
unseemly.zh: 他不得体的行为让派对上的所有人震惊。

unseemly.en: It is unseemly to laugh at someone's mistake.
unseemly.zh: 嘲笑别人的错误是不合适的。

tawdry.en: She wore a tawdry dress to the event.
tawdry.zh: 她穿了一件廉价而俗丽的裙子去参加活动。

tawdry.en: The decorations looked tawdry and cheap.
tawdry.zh: 这些装饰看起来廉价而俗丽。

smattering.en: He has only a smattering of French.
smattering.zh: 他只有一点肤浅的法语知识。

smattering.en: She picked up a smattering of Spanish on vacation.
smattering.zh: 她在度假时学到了一点西班牙语。

restive.en: The children grew restive during the long wait.
restive.zh: 孩子们在漫长的等待中变得不耐烦。

restive.en: The horse was restive and refused to move.
restive.zh: 这匹马很倔强，不肯向前走。

mettle.en: She showed her true mettle in the crisis.
mettle.zh: 她在危机中展现了她真正的勇气。

mettle.en: The team's mettle was tested in the final game.
mettle.zh: 这支队伍的耐力在最后一场比赛中受到了考验。

commiserate.en: I commiserate with you on your loss.
commiserate.zh: 我对你的损失表示同情。

commiserate.en: They commiserated with each other after the defeat.

rectitude.en: His rectitude is admired by all his colleagues.
rectitude.zh: 他的正直受到所有同事的钦佩。

rectitude.en: She is known for her moral rectitude.

harangue.en: The politician gave a long harangue to the crowd.
harangue.zh: 这位政治家向人群发表了长篇大论。

harangue.en: He harangued the students about their behavior.
harangue.zh: 他就学生的行为对他们进行了长篇大论的训斥。

depravity.en: The novel explores the depths of human depravity.
depravity.zh: 这部小说探讨了人类堕落的深度。

depravity.en: His depravity shocked even his closest friends.
depravity.zh: 他的腐败甚至让他最亲密的朋友震惊。

retrenchment.en: The company announced a retrenchment of staff.
Retrenchment is necessary to reduce costs.
retrenchment.zh: 紧缩是减少开支所必需的。

injurious.en: Smoking is injurious to your health.
Such behavior is injurious to the company's reputation.
injurious.zh: 这种行为对公司声誉有害。

impetuous.en: His impetuous decision led to many problems.
impetuous.zh: 他冲动的决定导致了许多问题。

impetuous.en: She is known for her impetuous nature.
impetuous.zh: 她以冲动的性格而闻名。

ulterior.en: He had an ulterior motive for helping her.
ulterior.zh: 他帮助她有一个隐秘不明的动机。
她怀疑他有隐秘不明的意图。

spasmodic.en: He had a spasmodic cough all night.
spasmodic.zh: 他整夜有痉挛性的咳嗽。

spasmodic.en: Her interest in the project was spasmodic.
spasmodic.zh: 她对项目的兴趣是间歇性的。

slouch.en: Don't slouch when you sit at the desk.
slouch.zh: 坐在桌前时不要没精打采地耷拉着。

slouch.en: He is no slouch when it comes to cooking.
slouch.zh: 他在烹饪方面可不是笨人。

sidle.en: She sidled up to him to whisper a secret.
sidle.zh: 她悄悄贴近他，低声说了一个秘密。

sidle.en: The cat sidled along the wall cautiously.
sidle.zh: 猫小心翼翼地沿着墙侧身而行。

repellent.en: The smell of the chemical is repellent to me.
repellent.zh: 这种化学物质的气味让我感到令人讨厌。

repellent.en: We used insect repellent to keep mosquitoes away.
repellent.zh: 我们用了驱虫剂来驱赶蚊子。

hovel.en: They lived in a small hovel by the river.
hovel.zh: 他们住在河边的一个简陋小屋里。

hovel.en: The old hovel was barely standing.
hovel.zh: 那个旧简陋小屋几乎要倒塌了。

decoy.en: The police used a decoy to catch the thief.
decoy.zh: 警察用了一个圈套来抓小偷。

decoy.en: He decoyed the enemy into a trap.
decoy.zh: 他诱骗敌人进入了一个陷阱。

asparagus.en: I love eating grilled asparagus with dinner.
asparagus.zh: 我喜欢晚餐时吃烤芦笋。

asparagus.en: Asparagus is a healthy green vegetable.
asparagus.zh: 芦笋是一种健康的绿色蔬菜。

swill.en: He swilled down the beer in one gulp.
The pigs ate the swill from the kitchen.

slew.en: She has a slew of books on her shelf.
slew.zh: 她的书架上有一大量书。

slew.en: The car slewed on the icy road.
slew.zh: 汽车在结冰的路上侧滑了。

sampler.en: She bought a sampler of different cheeses.
sampler.zh: 她买了一个各种奶酪的样品组合。

sampler.en: The sampler showed her skill with embroidery.
sampler.zh: 这个刺绣样品展示了她的刺绣技巧。

lithe.en: The dancer had a lithe and graceful body.
lithe.zh: 这位舞者有一个柔软而优雅的身体。

lithe.en: Cats are known for their lithe movements.
lithe.zh: 猫以其柔软的动作而闻名。

dissection.en: The biology class performed a frog dissection.
dissection.zh: 生物课进行了一次青蛙解剖。

dissection.en: His dissection of the argument was thorough.
dissection.zh: 他对论点的剖析很彻底。

cadence.en: The music had a soothing cadence.
cadence.zh: 这首音乐有一种舒缓的节奏。

cadence.en: She spoke with a gentle cadence in her voice.
cadence.zh: 她说话时声音带有一种温柔的抑扬。

truss.en: The roof is supported by a wooden truss.
He trussed the chicken before roasting it.
truss.zh: 他在烤鸡之前把鸡捆绑好。

plenary.en: The committee held a plenary session.
plenary.zh: 委员会举行了一次全体会议。

plenary.en: She was given plenary authority to make decisions.
plenary.zh: 她被赋予了充分的权力来做决定。

brocade.en: The dress was made of gold brocade.
brocade.zh: 这条裙子是用金色织锦做的。

brocade.en: The curtains were decorated with brocade patterns.
brocade.zh: 窗帘上装饰有织锦图案。

girder.en: The steel girder supports the bridge.
girder.zh: 钢制大梁支撑着这座桥。

girder.en: Workers lifted the heavy girder into place.
girder.zh: 工人们把沉重的大梁吊装到位。

vocalist.en: The vocalist sang beautifully at the concert.
vocalist.zh: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱得很美。

vocalist.en: She is the lead vocalist in the band.

abscond.en: The thief absconded with the stolen money.
abscond.zh: 小偷带着偷来的钱潜逃了。

abscond.en: He absconded from the prison last night.

staccato.en: The piano piece was played in a staccato style.
staccato.zh: 这首钢琴曲以断奏的风格演奏。

staccato.en: She spoke in short, staccato sentences.
staccato.zh: 她用简短、不连贯的句子说话。

sparring.en: The boxers were sparring in the ring.
sparring.zh: 拳击手们在拳击台上对打。

sparring.en: Their verbal sparring was entertaining to watch.
sparring.zh: 他们的口头争论看起来很有趣。

regress.en: The patient began to regress under stress.
regress.zh: 病人在压力下开始退化。

regress.en: We must not regress to old habits.
regress.zh: 我们绝不能退回到旧习惯。

libido.en: Stress can affect a person's libido.
libido.zh: 压力会影响一个人的性欲。

libido.en: He has a high libido and energy level.
libido.zh: 他有很高的性欲和精力水平。

supine.en: The patient lay supine on the examination table.
He was in a supine position on the beach.
supine.zh: 他以仰卧的姿势躺在沙滩上。

vanquish.en: The army vanquished its enemies in battle.
vanquish.zh: 军队在战斗中打败了敌人。

vanquish.en: She vanquished her fears and spoke publicly.
vanquish.zh: 她克服了恐惧，公开演讲。

steadfast.en: She remained steadfast in her beliefs.
steadfast.zh: 她对自己的信念坚定不移。

steadfast.en: He is a steadfast friend through difficult times.
steadfast.zh: 在困难时期，他是一个坚定的朋友。

squeamish.en: He is squeamish about seeing blood.
squeamish.zh: 他看到血容易感到恶心。

squeamish.en: She is too squeamish to watch horror movies.
squeamish.zh: 她过于拘谨，不敢看恐怖电影。

missive.en: She received a long missive from her friend.
missive.zh: 她收到了朋友的一封长信。

missive.en: The king sent a missive to the general.
missive.zh: 国王给将军送去了一份公文。

gargantuan.en: The elephant took a gargantuan step forward.
gargantuan.zh: 大象向前迈出了巨大的一步。

gargantuan.en: They built a gargantuan statue in the park.
gargantuan.zh: 他们在公园里建造了一座巨大的雕像。

emboss.en: The artist will emboss the metal with a design.
emboss.zh: 艺术家将在金属上压印一个图案。

emboss.en: They emboss the leather with gold letters.
emboss.zh: 他们在皮革上浮雕金色字母。

efficacious.en: This medicine is efficacious for headaches.
The new method proved efficacious in tests.
efficacious.zh: 新方法在测试中被证明是有效的。

disparage.en: Do not disparage your coworkers in public.
disparage.zh: 不要在公共场合贬低你的同事。

disparage.en: He tends to disparage others' achievements.
disparage.zh: 他倾向于贬低他人的成就。

unmitigated.en: The storm caused unmitigated disaster to the town.
unmitigated.zh: 风暴给小镇带来了全然的灾难。

unmitigated.en: His speech was an unmitigated success.
unmitigated.zh: 他的演讲是彻底的成功。

undeserved.en: He received undeserved praise for the project.
undeserved.zh: 他因这个项目得到了不应得的赞扬。

undeserved.en: The punishment seemed harsh and undeserved.
undeserved.zh: 惩罚似乎严厉且不该受。

traceable.en: The error is traceable to a simple mistake.
traceable.zh: 这个错误可追溯到一个简单的失误。

traceable.en: The package is traceable with a tracking number.
traceable.zh: 这个包裹可以用追踪号码追踪。

stratagem.en: They used a clever stratagem to win the game.
stratagem.zh: 他们用了一个巧妙的策略赢了比赛。

stratagem.en: The general devised a stratagem to surprise the enemy.
stratagem.zh: 将军设计了一个计谋来突袭敌人。

ream.en: He printed a ream of paper for the report.
ream.zh: 他为报告打印了一令纸。

ream.en: She wrote reams of notes during the lecture.
ream.zh: 她在讲座期间写了大量的笔记。

pithy.en: His pithy remarks made everyone think.
pithy.zh: 他简洁有力的评论让每个人思考。

pithy.en: She gave a pithy summary of the book.
pithy.zh: 她给出了这本书的简洁有力的总结。

perky.en: The puppy was perky and full of energy.
perky.zh: 小狗得意洋洋，充满活力。

perky.en: She had a perky attitude despite the rain.

inveterate.en: He is an inveterate smoker who cannot quit.
inveterate.zh: 他是个积习难改的烟民，戒不掉。

inveterate.en: She is an inveterate optimist in tough times.
inveterate.zh: 在困难时期，她是个根深蒂固的乐观主义者。

ignominious.en: The team suffered an ignominious defeat.
ignominious.zh: 球队遭受了可耻的失败。
他可耻的行为震惊了所有人。

heirloom.en: This necklace is a family heirloom from my grandmother.
heirloom.zh: 这条项链是我祖母留下的传家宝。

heirloom.en: They passed down the heirloom to their children.
heirloom.zh: 他们把传家宝传给了孩子们。

grovel.en: He had to grovel for forgiveness after the mistake.
grovel.zh: 犯错后他不得不卑躬屈膝地请求原谅。

grovel.en: The dog began to grovel when scolded.

gild.en: They gild the frame with a thin layer of gold.
gild.zh: 他们用薄薄一层金镀了画框。

gild.en: The artist will gild the statue's surface.
gild.zh: 艺术家将给雕像表面镀金。

fledge.en: The mother bird will fledge her chicks soon.
fledge.zh: 母鸟很快就会喂养她的雏鸟到能飞。

fledge.en: They fledge the young eagles in the nest.
fledge.zh: 他们在巢中喂养幼鹰直到它们长羽毛。

dowdy.en: She wore a dowdy dress to the party.
dowdy.zh: 她穿了一件过时的裙子去派对。

dowdy.en: His dowdy appearance surprised his friends.
dowdy.zh: 他邋遢的外表让朋友们惊讶。

blurb.en: The book's blurb made it sound interesting.
blurb.zh: 书的推荐广告让它听起来有趣。

blurb.en: She wrote a blurb for the new novel.
blurb.zh: 她为这本新小说写了推荐广告。

voluptuous.en: She had a voluptuous figure that turned heads.
voluptuous.zh: 她有着妖娆的身材，引人注目。

voluptuous.en: The painting depicted a voluptuous woman.
voluptuous.zh: 这幅画描绘了一个妖娆的女人。

raze.en: They plan to raze the old building next week.
raze.zh: 他们计划下周把旧楼夷为平地。

raze.en: The earthquake razed the entire village.

prance.en: The horse began to prance in the field.
She watched the dancers prance across the stage.
prance.zh: 她看着舞者昂首阔步地穿过舞台。

knotty.en: The wood was knotty and hard to cut.
They faced a knotty problem in the project.
knotty.zh: 他们在项目中面临一个棘手的问题。

hunk.en: He ate a hunk of bread for lunch.
hunk.zh: 他午餐吃了一块大面包。

hunk.en: She thought the actor was a real hunk.
hunk.zh: 她觉得那个演员是个真正的猛男。

carpentry.en: He learned carpentry from his grandfather.
carpentry.zh: 他从祖父那里学了木工手艺。
木工业需要技巧和耐心。

bludgeon.en: The thief carried a bludgeon for protection.
bludgeon.zh: 小偷带了一根大头棒防身。

bludgeon.en: He used his words to bludgeon his opponent.

profane.en: He used profane language in the meeting.
profane.zh: 他在会议上用了亵渎的语言。

profane.en: Do not profane the sacred temple.

jest.en: He made a jest about the weather.
jest.zh: 他开了个关于天气的玩笑。

jest.en: She spoke in jest, not in anger.
jest.zh: 她开玩笑地说，不是生气。

haggard.en: After the long night, he looked haggard.
haggard.zh: 经过漫长的一夜，他看起来憔悴。

haggard.en: She had a haggard face from worry.

gnarled.en: The old tree had gnarled branches.
His gnarled hands showed years of work.
gnarled.zh: 他粗糙的双手显示了多年的劳作。

giddy.en: The spinning ride made her feel giddy.
giddy.zh: 旋转的游乐设施让她感到头晕。

depredation.en: The army's depredation destroyed the village.
depredation.zh: 军队的掠夺摧毁了村庄。

depredation.en: They suffered from the depredation of thieves.
depredation.zh: 他们遭受了小偷的破坏。

bedraggled.en: The cat came home bedraggled after the rain.
She looked bedraggled after the long hike.
bedraggled.zh: 长途徒步后她看起来满身湿透。

baleful.en: He gave her a baleful stare.
baleful.zh: 他给了她一个恶意的凝视。

baleful.en: The witch cast a baleful spell.
baleful.zh: 女巫施了一个有害的咒语。

peremptory.en: His peremptory tone left no room for debate.
peremptory.zh: 他断然的语气没有留下辩论的余地。

peremptory.en: She issued a peremptory order to leave.
peremptory.zh: 她发出了不容置疑的命令要求离开。

cornice.en: The cornice was decorated with intricate carvings.
cornice.zh: 檐口装饰着复杂的雕刻。

cornice.en: They installed a new cornice in the living room.
cornice.zh: 他们在客厅安装了一个新的檐口。

convalescent.en: The convalescent patient rested in the garden.
convalescent.zh: 恢复期的病人在花园里休息。

convalescent.en: She is a convalescent after the surgery.
convalescent.zh: 她手术后是个康复中的病人。

stupor.en: He lay in a stupor after the accident.
stupor.zh: 事故后他处于人事不省的状态。

stupor.en: The news left her in a stupor of disbelief.
stupor.zh: 消息让她陷入麻木的怀疑中。

seminary.en: He studied at a seminary to become a priest.
seminary.zh: 他在神学院学习成为牧师。

seminary.en: The seminary is located in a quiet town.
seminary.zh: 神学院坐落在一个安静的小镇。

monotone.en: He spoke in a dull monotone.
Her voice was a flat monotone.

herbaceous.en: Herbaceous plants die back in winter.

asterisk.en: Please put an asterisk next to it.

wizardry.zh: 他的巫术让所有人惊叹。

wizardry.en: She used wizardry to solve it.

weasel.en: The weasel is a small animal.
He tried to weasel out of it.

iodine.en: She put iodine on the cut.

damper.en: The rain put a damper on our fun.
He adjusted the damper on the stove.

myopic.en: He is myopic and needs glasses.
Her myopic view limited her options.
myopic.zh: 她目光短浅，限制了选择。

purported.en: The purported expert was a fraud.
purported.zh: 那个所谓的专家是个骗子。

purported.en: This is the purported reason for it.

anticipatory.zh: 他的先行行动帮助了我们。

quiescent.en: He remained quiescent during the talk.

purgatory.en: He believed in purgatory after death.

rhubarb.en: She made a pie with rhubarb.
Rhubarb stems are edible when cooked.

functionary.zh: 一个低级职员帮了我们。

accretion.en: The accretion of dust was slow.
Each year brought a small accretion.

truncate.en: Please truncate the long file name.
They had to truncate the meeting.

sully.en: Do not sully your good name.
The mud sullied his clean shirt.
sully.zh: 泥弄脏了他的干净衬衫。

stilted.en: His speech sounded stilted and formal.
stilted.zh: 他的演讲听起来做作而正式。

stilted.en: The conversation felt stilted and awkward.

realign.en: We need to realign the wheels.
realign.zh: 我们需要重新调整车轮。

realign.en: The company will realign its goals.

fritter.en: Do not fritter away your time.
She ate a corn fritter for lunch.
fritter.zh: 她午餐吃了个玉米油煎饼。

ruminate.en: He sat to ruminate on the problem.
ruminate.zh: 他坐下来沉思这个问题。

rebuttal.en: She gave a strong rebuttal to his claim.
rebuttal.zh: 她对她的主张进行了有力的反驳。

rebuttal.en: His rebuttal was clear and logical.
rebuttal.zh: 他的反驳清晰而有逻辑。

palatial.en: They live in a palatial mansion.
palatial.zh: 他们住在一座宫殿般的宅邸里。

palatial.en: The hotel room was palatial and grand.

malign.en: The rumor had a malign influence.
malign.zh: 这个谣言有有害的影响。

guile.en: He used guile to get what he wanted.
guile.zh: 他用狡计得到了他想要的。

guile.en: She was known for her guile and cunning.

decant.en: Please decant the wine into a glass.

debase.en: They debased the currency by adding lead.
debase.zh: 他们通过加铅来降低货币价值。

debase.en: Do not debase yourself by lying.
debase.zh: 不要通过说谎来贬低自己。

bracing.en: The cold air was bracing and fresh.
bracing.zh: 冷空气令人振奋而清新。

bracing.en: A bracing walk helped clear my mind.
bracing.zh: 一次爽快的散步帮我清醒了头脑。

beholden.en: I am beholden to you for your help.
He felt beholden to his benefactor.

unearthly.en: The light had an unearthly glow.
unearthly.zh: 那光有一种神秘的光辉。

unearthly.en: She heard an unearthly sound at night.
unearthly.zh: 她晚上听到了怪异的声音。

trinket.en: She bought a cheap trinket at the fair.
trinket.zh: 她在集市上买了个便宜的小饰品。

trinket.en: The trinket was made of plastic.
trinket.zh: 这个小玩意儿是塑料做的。

sleazy.en: The fabric felt sleazy and thin.
sleazy.zh: 这布料感觉又薄又劣质。

sleazy.en: He stayed in a sleazy hotel downtown.
sleazy.zh: 他住在市中心一家低级庸俗的旅馆。

rile.en: His comments began to rile her.
Do not rile the dog with teasing.

fitful.en: He had a fitful sleep last night.
fitful.zh: 他昨晚断断续续地睡了一觉。

fitful.en: The wind was fitful and unpredictable.

defile.en: Do not defile the sacred temple.
The soldiers marched through the defile.

croon.en: She began to croon a lullaby.
croon.zh: 她开始低声哼唱摇篮曲。

croon.en: He would croon softly to the baby.

confection.en: The bakery sells a sweet confection.
She made a confection of chocolate and nuts.
confection.zh: 她用巧克力和坚果做了一种糖果。

cavort.en: The children cavort in the park.
Lambs cavort in the spring fields.
cavort.zh: 小羊在春天的田野里腾跃。

alchemy.en: Alchemy was practiced in medieval times.
alchemy.zh: 炼金术在中世纪被实践。

alchemy.en: He studied alchemy to turn lead into gold.
alchemy.zh: 他研究炼金术想把铅变成金。

airtight.en: The container is airtight to keep food fresh.
airtight.zh: 这个容器是气密的，以保持食物新鲜。

airtight.en: Her argument was airtight and convincing.
airtight.zh: 她的论点无懈可击且令人信服。

tutelage.en: He learned piano under her tutelage.
tutelage.zh: 他在她的指导下学习钢琴。

tutelage.en: The young artist grew under his tutelage.
tutelage.zh: 这位年轻艺术家在他的监护下成长。

surly.en: The surly waiter ignored our requests.
surly.zh: 那位无礼的服务员无视了我们的请求。

surly.en: He gave a surly reply to the question.
surly.zh: 他对这个问题给出了粗暴的回答。

rankle.en: The unfair criticism continued to rankle him.
rankle.zh: 不公正的批评继续让他怨恨。

rankle.en: Her harsh words rankled for days.
rankle.zh: 她严厉的话语怨恨了好几天。

conformist.en: He is a conformist who follows all rules.
conformist.zh: 他是一个遵纪守法者，遵守所有规则。
遵奉习俗者从不质疑权威。

bonhomie.en: His bonhomie made everyone feel welcome.
bonhomie.zh: 他的和蔼让每个人都感到受欢迎。

bonhomie.en: The party was full of warmth and bonhomie.
bonhomie.zh: 派对充满了温暖和愉快。

stutter.en: He has a slight stutter when nervous.
She began to stutter during the speech.
stutter.zh: 她在演讲中开始结结巴巴地说。

progenitor.en: The wolf is a progenitor of the dog.
He is the progenitor of a famous family.
progenitor.zh: 他是一个著名家族的祖先。

minion.en: The boss always has a minion do his work.
minion.zh: 老板总是让一个奴才做他的工作。

minion.en: She treated her assistant like a minion.
minion.zh: 她把她的助手当作宠臣对待。

institutionalized.en: The practice became institutionalized over time.
institutionalized.zh: 这种做法随着时间的推移变得有组织。

institutionalized.en: He was institutionalized after the accident.
institutionalized.zh: 他在事故后被收容机构收容。

chrysanthemum.en: She planted a yellow chrysanthemum in the garden.
chrysanthemum.zh: 她在花园里种了一朵黄色菊花。

artifice.en: He used artifice to avoid the police.
The plan was full of clever artifice.
artifice.zh: 这个计划充满了巧妙的技巧。

affectation.en: Her British accent is just an affectation.
affectation.zh: 她的英国口音只是假装。

affectation.en: He dropped the affectation after a while.
affectation.zh: 过了一会儿他放弃了做作。

sledgehammer.en: He used a sledgehammer to break the wall.
The sledgehammer was too heavy for her.

meditative.en: She sat in a meditative pose by the lake.
meditative.zh: 她以冥想的姿势坐在湖边。

meditative.en: His meditative mood helped him relax.
meditative.zh: 他默想的心情帮助他放松。

inane.en: The movie had an inane plot.
inane.zh: 这部电影有一个愚蠢的情节。

inane.en: He made an inane comment during class.
inane.zh: 他在课堂上做了一个空洞的评论。

coterie.en: A small coterie of friends met weekly.
coterie.zh: 一小群圈内人每周见面。

coterie.en: The coterie controlled the art scene.
coterie.zh: 这个小集团控制了艺术界。

clipper.en: He trimmed the hedge with a clipper.
clipper.zh: 他用大剪刀修剪了树篱。

clipper.en: The clipper sailed across the ocean fast.
clipper.zh: 这艘快速帆船快速穿越大洋。

sideshow.en: The main event was just a sideshow.
sideshow.zh: 主要事件只是一个附属活动。

sideshow.en: Don't get distracted by this sideshow.
sideshow.zh: 不要被这个枝节问题分心。

ostensible.en: His ostensible reason was to help us.
ostensible.zh: 他表面的理由是帮助我们。

ostensible.en: The ostensible leader had no real power.
ostensible.zh: 表面的领导者没有真正的权力。

linoleum.en: The kitchen floor is covered with linoleum.
She cleaned the linoleum every morning.

boggle.en: The complex math problem made him boggle.
boggle.zh: 复杂的数学问题让他犹豫。

boggle.en: Don't boggle at the new technology.
boggle.zh: 不要对新科技感到吃惊。

asymmetric.en: The design is asymmetric but beautiful.
asymmetric.zh: 这个设计不对称但美丽。

biennial.en: The art fair is a biennial event.
biennial.zh: 艺术博览会是一个两年一次的活动。

biennial.en: This biennial plant flowers in its second year.

miscellany.zh: 她喜欢阅读各种文章的杂集。

banister.en: He slid down the banister for fun.
banister.zh: 他为了好玩顺着楼梯扶手滑下来。

banister.en: Hold the banister when you go downstairs.

uptight.en: Don't be so uptight about the small things.

depreciate.en: The value of the car will depreciate quickly.

不要贬低她的辛勤工作。

aberrant.en: His aberrant behavior worried his parents.
aberrant.zh: 他反常的行为让父母担心。

aberrant.en: The scientist studied aberrant cells in the lab.
aberrant.zh: 科学家在实验室研究了异常细胞。

frolic.en: The children frolic in the park.

frolic.zh: 小狗喜欢在草地上嬉戏。

counterfeit.zh: 这幅画是赝品，不是原作。

capillary.zh: 血液流过身体里微小的毛细血管。

capillary.en: A capillary tube draws water upward.

oligarchy.en: The country was ruled by an oligarchy.

oligarchy.zh: 寡头政治常常忽视穷人的需求。

genealogy.en: She researched her family genealogy online.
genealogy.zh: 她在网上研究了自己的家谱。

genealogy.en: Genealogy helps us learn about our ancestors.
genealogy.zh: 家谱学帮助我们了解祖先。

ruffian.zh: 那个恶棍偷了老妇人的包。

ruffian.en: A group of ruffians caused trouble in the street.

clam.en: We ate fresh clams at the beach.
clam.zh: 我们在海滩吃了新鲜的蛤蜊。

clam.en: He clammed up when asked about the secret.
clam.zh: 当被问及秘密时，他闭口不言。

vertigo.en: Looking down from the tower gave him vertigo.
vertigo.zh: 从塔上往下看让他感到眩晕。

vertigo.en: She suffers from vertigo and avoids heights.
vertigo.zh: 她患有眩晕症，避免高处。

repatriate.en: The government helped repatriate the refugees.
He was repatriated to his home country.
repatriate.zh: 他被遣返回了他的祖国。

racy.en: She wore a racy dress to the party.
racy.zh: 她穿了一件活泼的裙子去派对。

racy.en: The novel has a racy and exciting plot.
racy.zh: 这部小说有一个生动刺激的情节。

apparel.en: He bought new apparel for the trip.

utopia.en: He dreams of a perfect utopia.
utopia.zh: 他梦想一个完美的乌托邦。

utopia.en: No society is a true utopia.
utopia.zh: 没有社会是真正的乌托邦。

transcendent.en: Her beauty was transcendent and unforgettable.
transcendent.zh: 她的美超凡脱俗，令人难忘。

transcendent.en: The music gave a transcendent experience.

underrate.en: Many people underrate the importance of sleep.
underrate.zh: 许多人低估了睡眠的重要性。

torrid.en: The torrid sun made everyone seek shade.
torrid.zh: 酷热的太阳让每个人都找阴凉处。

torrid.en: They had a torrid romance that summer.
torrid.zh: 那年夏天他们有一段热烈的恋情。

snide.en: He made a snide comment about her work.
snide.zh: 他对她的工作做了刻薄的评论。

snide.en: Her snide remarks hurt his feelings.
snide.zh: 她恶意的评论伤害了他的感情。

interloper.en: The party was ruined by an interloper.
interloper.zh: 派对被一个闯入者破坏了。

interloper.en: He felt like an interloper at the meeting.
interloper.zh: 他在会议上感觉自己像个闯入者。

galvanize.en: The speech galvanized the crowd to action.
galvanize.zh: 演讲激励了人群采取行动。

galvanize.en: They galvanize the metal to prevent rust.
galvanize.zh: 他们给金属镀锌以防生锈。

flagging.en: His flagging energy made him stop running.
flagging.zh: 他疲惫的精力让他停止了跑步。

flagging.en: The flagging sales worried the manager.
flagging.zh: 下滑的销售额让经理担心。

encumber.en: Heavy bags encumber the hiker's progress.
encumber.zh: 沉重的包阻碍了徒步者的前进。

encumber.en: Debt can encumber a family's finances.
encumber.zh: 债务会拖累家庭的财务。

prevaricate.en: He tends to prevaricate when asked difficult questions.
prevaricate.zh: 当被问到难题时，他倾向于搪塞。

prevaricate.en: Don't prevaricate; just tell the truth.
prevaricate.zh: 别支吾其辞，直接说实话。

pliable.en: The clay is pliable and easy to shape.

pincers.en: The crab uses its pincers to catch food.
pincers.zh: 螃蟹用它的螯来抓食物。

pincers.en: He used pincers to pull out the nail.

pillory.en: The thief was put in the pillory as punishment.
pillory.zh: 小偷被戴上颈手枷作为惩罚。

pillory.en: The media pilloried the politician for his mistake.
pillory.zh: 媒体因政客的错误而公开嘲笑他。

orifice.en: The nose has two small orifices.

orifice.zh: 医生仔细检查了那个孔口。

mangle.en: The machine can mangle the clothes for drying.
mangle.zh: 这台机器可以轧干衣服。

mangle.en: He mangled the speech by forgetting his lines.
mangle.zh: 他因忘词而把演讲搞得一团糟。

ire.en: His rude comment raised her ire.
ire.zh: 他粗鲁的评论激起了她的愤怒。

ire.en: The unfair decision caused public ire.
ire.zh: 不公正的决定引起了公众的愤怒。

aspirant.en: The young aspirant dreams of becoming a doctor.
aspirant.zh: 这位有抱负的年轻人梦想成为医生。

aspirant.zh: 许多有抱负的人申请了奖学金。

apotheosis.en: The painting is the apotheosis of beauty.

apotheosis.zh: 他作为伟大的领袖达到了巅峰。

spank.en: The mother spanked the child for misbehaving.
spank.zh: 母亲因孩子行为不端而打他屁股。

spank.en: He gave the dog a gentle spank.

solicitous.en: She is solicitous about her elderly mother's health.
solicitous.zh: 她很关心年迈母亲的健康。

solicitous.en: The nurse was solicitous and kind to patients.
solicitous.zh: 护士对病人既关心又和善。

pique.en: He left in a fit of pique.

pique.zh: 她的好奇心被这个谜团激起了。

multifarious.zh: 图书馆有各种各样的书。

multifarious.en: Her multifarious interests keep her busy.
multifarious.zh: 她多种多样的兴趣让她很忙。

meteoric.en: His rise to fame was meteoric.

congeal.en: The fat will congeal as it cools.
Blood congeals when exposed to air.
congeal.zh: 血液暴露在空气中会凝结。

canvass.en: They canvass the neighborhood for votes.
We need to canvass opinions on this issue.
canvass.zh: 我们需要就这个问题征求意见。

askew.en: The picture hung askew on the wall.
askew.zh: 那幅画歪斜地挂在墙上。

servitude.zh: 他们过了多年奴役生活。

ravishing.en: She looked ravishing in that dress.
ravishing.zh: 她穿那条裙子看起来迷人极了。

nepotism.zh: 该公司被指责偏袒亲属。

nepotism.en: Nepotism is unfair to other employees.
nepotism.zh: 任人唯亲对其他员工不公平。

midget.en: He is a midget but very strong.
They bought a midget car for the city.
midget.zh: 他们为城市买了一辆小型车。

inhumane.en: The conditions in the prison were inhumane.

inhumane.zh: 残忍对待动物是不人道的。

carnivorous.en: Some plants are carnivorous and eat insects.
carnivorous.zh: 有些植物是食肉的，吃昆虫。

calligraphy.en: His calligraphy is beautiful and elegant.

nadir.en: His career reached its nadir that year.
nadir.zh: 他的事业在那年跌入低谷。

egocentric.en: He is too egocentric to care about others.

blotch.en: There is a red blotch on her skin.

blotch.zh: 油漆在墙上留下了一个污斑。

winkle.zh: 他们试图把他从工作中逐出。

uncooperative.zh: 她不合作的态度让事情变得困难。

statuary.en: The park is filled with beautiful statuary.
statuary.zh: 公园里满是美丽的雕像。

statuary.zh: 他在大学学习雕像艺术。

leer.zh: 不要斜眼看人，这很无礼。

cohabit.en: They decided to cohabit before marriage.
Many couples cohabit without getting married.

narcissism.en: His narcissism made him hard to like.
narcissism.zh: 他的自恋让人难以喜欢。

appellation.en: The wine has a special appellation.
appellation.zh: 这种酒有一个特殊名称。

acquittal.en: The jury returned a verdict of acquittal.
acquittal.zh: 陪审团作出了无罪判决。

acquittal.zh: 他的无罪开释让法庭上所有人都惊讶。

interlocutor.en: My interlocutor was a friendly man.
interlocutor.zh: 我的对话者是个友好的人。

interlocutor.zh: 她仔细听她的谈话者说话。

colonnade.en: We walked through the marble colonnade.

demonstrative.en: She is very demonstrative with her love.

demonstrative.zh: 他就这个话题作了说明性演讲。

embezzlement.zh: 贪污在商业中是严重犯罪。

scorching.en: The scorching sun made us seek shade.
scorching.zh: 灼热的太阳让我们找阴凉。

cosset.zh: 父母常溺爱第一个孩子。

stolid.en: He remained stolid during the crisis.

stolid.zh: 她麻木的表情没有流露情感。

internecine.en: The family had an internecine conflict.

internecine.zh: 自相残杀的战争会摧毁一个国家。

infatuated.en: He became infatuated with his new neighbor.

bigot.en: A bigot refuses to listen to others.
bigot.zh: 偏执的人拒绝听别人意见。

unrequited.zh: 她的感情没有回报，很悲伤。

trenchant.en: She made a trenchant criticism of the plan.
trenchant.zh: 她对计划作了尖锐批评。

trenchant.zh: 他犀利的机智给观众留下印象。

spongy.zh: 这种海绵状的面包很吸奶。

moron.en: He called me a moron for forgetting.
moron.zh: 他因我忘记而叫我笨蛋。

moron.zh: 只有低能者才会开那么快。

intercede.en: She asked him to intercede for her.

gratuity.en: He left a small gratuity for the waiter.
gratuity.zh: 他给服务员留了一点小费。

gratuity.zh: 小费并非必需，但很受欢迎。

exultant.en: The team was exultant after winning the game.
exultant.zh: 球队赢得比赛后欢欣鼓舞。

exultant.zh: 她对升职感到非常高兴。

curdle.en: The milk will curdle if left out.

convalesce.en: She needs time to convalesce after surgery.
convalesce.zh: 手术后她需要时间康复。

convalesce.en: He went to the countryside to convalesce.

cloying.zh: 这道甜点对我来说太甜腻了。

calculating.en: He is a very calculating person.
calculating.zh: 他是个很精于算计的人。

calculating.en: Her calculating nature made her successful.
calculating.zh: 她精于算计的性格让她成功。

subterfuge.en: He used a subterfuge to avoid work.

subterfuge.zh: 间谍的托辞很快被识破。

rivulet.en: A small rivulet flowed through the valley.

rivulet.zh: 雨水在小路上形成了一条小溪。

peripatetic.en: He led a peripatetic life as a traveler.

peripatetic.zh: 这位徒步旅行的老师从一个镇走到另一个镇。

hawker.zh: 小贩大声叫卖以吸引顾客。

despot.en: The despot ruled the country with fear.

despot.zh: 人民反抗残暴的专制君主。

defeatist.en: Don't be a defeatist; try your best.
defeatist.zh: 别做失败主义者，尽力而为。

approbation.zh: 她微笑着认可他的工作。

pomposity.en: His pomposity made him hard to like.

pomposity.en: The speech was full of pomposity.

permeable.en: This fabric is permeable to water.

permeable.zh: 土壤有渗透性，排水良好。

disavow.en: He tried to disavow any knowledge of the crime.
disavow.zh: 他试图否认对罪行知情。

dote.en: He dotes on his little sister.

pitcher.en: He filled the pitcher with water.

incriminate.en: She refused to incriminate her friend.

fascia.en: He injured the fascia in his leg.

carrion.en: The smell of carrion attracted flies.
carrion.zh: 腐肉的气味吸引了苍蝇。

titanic.en: The titanic effort moved the boulder.
titanic.zh: 巨大的努力移动了巨石。

vitiate.en: The error vitiated the entire experiment.

scooter.en: The child rode a scooter to school.

scooter.zh: 他把小型摩托车停在商店附近。

horticulture.en: Horticulture involves growing plants and flowers.
horticulture.zh: 园艺涉及种植植物和花卉。

herbicide.en: The farmer used herbicide on the weeds.
herbicide.zh: 农民在杂草上用了除草剂。

choreography.en: She learned choreography for the show.
choreography.zh: 她为演出学习了舞蹈编排。

firefly.en: The firefly glowed in the dark.

firefly.zh: 孩子们在罐子里捉了一只萤火虫。

magisterial.en: He spoke in a magisterial tone.

magisterial.zh: 法官有权威的判决是最终的。

garbled.en: The message was garbled in transmission.
garbled.zh: 消息在传输中混乱不清。

garbled.en: He gave a garbled account of events.
garbled.zh: 他对事件做了曲解的描述。

wreathe.en: She wreathed flowers in her hair.

unworldly.zh: 他超凡的想法让所有人惊讶。

superlative.zh: 她做了无与伦比的表演。

supercilious.zh: 他傲慢的表情让我生气。

supercilious.en: She spoke in a supercilious tone.
supercilious.zh: 她以目空一切的语气说话。

spoof.en: The movie was a spoof of horror films.
spoof.zh: 这部电影是对恐怖片的戏弄。

pygmy.en: The pygmy elephant is very small.

pygmy.zh: 在巨人旁边他觉得自己像矮人。

entreaty.en: She made an entreaty for help.

entreaty.zh: 他的恳求感动了房间里的每个人。

discomfiture.en: His discomfiture was obvious to all.
discomfiture.zh: 他的困窘对所有人来说都很明显。

discomfiture.en: She felt discomfiture after the mistake.

deaden.en: The medicine will deaden the pain.

deaden.zh: 巨大的噪音会使你的听力减弱。

bluster.en: The wind began to bluster outside.
He tends to bluster when angry.

queasy.en: The boat ride made me queasy.
She felt queasy after eating too much.

limpid.en: The lake water was limpid and clear.

limpid.zh: 她清晰的散文容易阅读。

fetter.en: The prisoner wore a heavy fetter.

fetter.zh: 不要让恐惧束缚你的梦想。

credo.en: Honesty is part of his credo.
credo.zh: 诚实是他信条的一部分。

credo.en: Their credo emphasizes kindness and respect.
credo.zh: 他们的信条强调善良和尊重。

contrite.en: He felt contrite after lying to her.
contrite.zh: 对她撒谎后他感到后悔。

tango.zh: 他们优美地跳了探戈舞。

tango.zh: 她喜欢和舞伴跳探戈舞。

revitalize.zh: 新计划将使城市恢复生气。

revitalize.en: Exercise can revitalize your body and mind.
revitalize.zh: 锻炼能使你的身心恢复活力。

moralistic.zh: 他道德家的语气惹恼了学生。

moralistic.zh: 她做了一个关于诚实的说教演讲。

gangrene.zh: 坏疽如果不治疗会扩散。

culpable.en: He was found culpable for the accident.

culpable.zh: 她为那个错误感到该责备。

covet.en: Do not covet your neighbor's car.

compunction.en: He felt no compunction for his actions.
compunction.zh: 他对自己的行为没有悔恨。

compunction.en: She showed compunction after hurting him.
compunction.zh: 伤害他后她表现出后悔。

chaff.zh: 农民把谷壳从谷物中分离出来。

ditty.en: She sang a little ditty for us.
ditty.zh: 她为我们唱了一首小调。

dawdle.zh: 上学路上不要游手好闲。

benediction.zh: 牧师在结束时给了祝福。

benediction.zh: 我们为旅程收到了祝福。

monopolize.en: He tried to monopolize the conversation.

inborn.en: She has an inborn talent for music.

specious.zh: 她看穿了他似是而非的推理。

plaudit.en: She earned plaudits for her hard work.
plaudit.zh: 她因努力工作赢得了赞美。

mope.zh: 不要整天在房子里闲荡。

imprudent.zh: 他鲁莽的决定导致了许多问题。

imbibe.en: Children imbibe knowledge from their parents.
imbibe.zh: 孩子们从父母那里吸取知识。

imbibe.en: She likes to imbibe new ideas quickly.
imbibe.zh: 她喜欢快速吸收新想法。

deadpan.zh: 他面无表情地讲了这个笑话。

deadpan.zh: 她无表情的脸让大家都笑了。

cranky.en: The baby is cranky because he is tired.
cranky.zh: 宝宝因为累了而脾气暴躁。

cranky.en: My grandfather gets cranky when he is hungry.
cranky.zh: 我爷爷饿的时候会变得暴躁。

bungle.zh: 他把工作搞糟了，不得不重做。

balk.zh: 马在高栅栏前犹豫不前。

balk.zh: 他对移居国外的想法感到迟疑。

subliminal.zh: 广告使用潜意识信息来销售产品。

rote.zh: 机械性背诵并不总是有效的。

fixate.en: She tends to fixate on small details.
fixate.zh: 她倾向于专注于小细节。

fixate.zh: 不要太过于执着于你的错误。

facetious.en: His facetious remarks made everyone smile.
facetious.zh: 他滑稽的评论让每个人都笑了。

facetious.en: She gave a facetious answer to the question.
facetious.zh: 她对问题给出了一个爱开玩笑的回答。

doleful.zh: 那只狗脸上带着悲哀的表情。

doleful.zh: 她忧郁的歌让我们都感到悲伤。

jocular.en: He is known for his jocular personality.

acrobat.zh: 熟练的表演特技者能单手平衡。

rove.en: They rove through the forest all day.

fertilize.en: Bees help fertilize flowers as they fly.

emancipate.zh: 她为解放妇女摆脱旧规则而斗争。

autocracy.zh: 这个国家由独裁统治管理。

autocracy.zh: 独裁统治把全部权力给一个人。

patina.en: The old statue has a green patina.

patina.zh: 铜绿给金属一种古色外观。

verdant.zh: 青翠的山丘延伸到视线尽头。

personable.zh: 她是一位风度好且友好的老师。

personable.zh: 他讨人喜欢的性格使他受欢迎。

deranged.zh: 精神错乱的男人对陌生人喊叫。

elegy.zh: 这首哀歌表达了深深的悲伤和失落。

agnostic.en: He is an agnostic about the existence of God.

agnostic.zh: 她在那政治问题上持不可知态度。

underplay.en: The actor chose to underplay his role.

inalienable.en: Freedom is an inalienable human right.

episodic.zh: 他对事件的记忆是片段的。

doctrinaire.zh: 她过于教条，不愿考虑新想法。

polemical.en: His polemical speech sparked a heated debate.
polemical.zh: 他好辩的演讲引发了一场激烈的辩论。

polemical.zh: 这篇文章充满争议且挑起论战。

skewer.zh: 他把蔬菜串起来准备烧烤。

empiricism.zh: 科学依赖经验主义获取证据。

visceral.zh: 他在黑暗中感到一种发自内心的恐惧。

visceral.zh: 手术影响了他的内脏器官。

deductive.en: She used deductive reasoning to solve the puzzle.
deductive.zh: 她用演绎推理解决了这个谜题。

deductive.en: Deductive logic helps us draw conclusions from facts.
deductive.zh: 演绎逻辑帮助我们根据事实得出结论。

nemesis.zh: 英雄最终在战斗中面对了他的宿敌。

nemesis.zh: 她的克星似乎总是领先一步。

singe.zh: 小心别在蜡烛旁烧焦你的头发。

singe.zh: 厨师烧焦了鸡皮以去除羽毛。

serpentine.zh: 河流蜿蜒曲折地穿过山谷。

serpentine.zh: 她蛇形般的动作优雅而流畅。

insolence.zh: 他对老师的无礼让他惹上了麻烦。

insolence.zh: 她无法容忍那个粗鲁顾客的傲慢态度。

obelisk.zh: 古老的方尖碑矗立在城市广场上。

obelisk.zh: 他们参观了罗马著名的方尖碑。

porcupine.zh: 豪猪用它的刺来保护自己。

porcupine.zh: 一只豪猪摇摇摆摆地穿过森林小径。

outgrowth.zh: 新政策是早期改革的自然结果。

disburse.zh: 公司将在周五支付工资。

disburse.en: They disburse funds to local charities each year.
disburse.zh: 他们每年向当地慈善机构分配资金。

surrealism.zh: 超现实主义常在艺术中使用梦幻般的图像。

surrealism.zh: 他研究了超现实主义及其著名画家。

pyre.zh: 他们为葬礼仪式搭建了柴堆。

pyre.zh: 柴堆在夜空中明亮地燃烧。

impugn.en: She did not impugn his honesty in public.
impugn.zh: 她没有公开责难他的诚实。

impugn.zh: 他们抨击报告的准确性。

aviary.zh: 动物园有一个大型鸟舍，用于热带鸟类。

aviary.zh: 我们参观了鸟类饲养场，看到了许多鹦鹉。

loam.en: Gardeners prefer loam for growing vegetables.
loam.zh: 园丁喜欢用壤土种植蔬菜。

loam.en: This soil is a rich loam with good drainage.
loam.zh: 这种土壤是排水良好的肥沃壤土。

tuber.en: A potato is a common example of a tuber.
tuber.zh: 土豆是块茎的常见例子。

tuber.en: The plant stores food in its underground tuber.

indemnify.zh: 他们同意保障承包商免受索赔。

dyslexia.en: Dyslexia makes reading difficult for some children.
dyslexia.zh: 诵读困难使一些孩子阅读困难。

dyslexia.zh: 她在七岁时被诊断出诵读困难。

highbrow.zh: 他是一个喜欢古典音乐的文化修养高的人。

highbrow.zh: 这部电影对普通观众来说太知识分子化了。

disjunction.en: There is a disjunction between theory and practice.
disjunction.zh: 理论与实践之间存在分离。

disjunction.en: The disjunction in their views caused a debate.
disjunction.zh: 他们观点上的分裂引发了一场辩论。

clemency.zh: 法官对年轻罪犯表现出仁慈。

betroth.en: They plan to betroth their daughter next month.
betroth.zh: 他们计划下个月将女儿许配出去。

betroth.zh: 这对情侣决定在一个小型仪式上订婚。

perquisite.en: A company car is a common perquisite for managers.
perquisite.zh: 公司配车是经理常见的额外补贴。

perquisite.zh: 免费餐食是这份工作的特殊待遇。

detonation.zh: 炸弹的爆炸震动了建筑物。

detonation.en: They heard a loud detonation from the mine.
detonation.zh: 他们听到矿里传来巨大的爆炸声。

stethoscope.zh: 医生用听诊器检查我的心脏。

stethoscope.zh: 她把听诊器挂在脖子上。

imputation.zh: 对他偷窃的归罪是不公平的。

imputation.zh: 她否认了不诚实的非难。

papyrus.en: Ancient Egyptians wrote on papyrus scrolls.
papyrus.zh: 古埃及人在纸草卷上写字。

papyrus.zh: 博物馆展示了一片古老的纸草纸。

pharmacology.en: She studies pharmacology to understand drug effects.
pharmacology.zh: 她学习药理学以了解药物作用。

pharmacology.zh: 药理学对开发新药至关重要。

suture.zh: 他手臂上的缝合处愈合得很快。

sanatorium.zh: 他住在疗养院以恢复健康。

opiate.zh: 滥用鸦片制剂可能导致成瘾。

farrow.zh: 母猪生了一窝十只小猪。

farrow.zh: 农民每天检查新生的那窝小猪。

caucus.en: The party held a caucus to choose a candidate.
caucus.zh: 政党召开核心会议以选择候选人。

caucus.zh: 他们明天将开核心会议讨论政策。

meteorology.en: Meteorology helps predict the weather accurately.
meteorology.zh: 气象学有助于准确预测天气。

cuticle.en: She pushed back her cuticles during a manicure.

investiture.zh: 她参加了主教的授职仪式。

slurp.en: Don't slurp your soup at the table.
slurp.zh: 不要在餐桌上出声地喝汤。

slurp.zh: 他喝茶时发出很大的吃的声音。

lullaby.en: She sang a lullaby to put the baby to sleep.
lullaby.zh: 她唱摇篮曲让宝宝入睡。

lullaby.zh: 轻柔的催眠曲安抚了哭泣的孩子。

wraith.zh: 夜晚，旧城堡里出现了一个幽灵。

wraith.en: He felt like a wraith after the long illness.
wraith.zh: 久病之后，他感觉自己像个幻影。

upfront.zh: 公司要求预先支付服务费用。

tremulous.zh: 她颤抖的声音表明她很紧张。

eclecticism.zh: 设计中的折衷主义将不同风格完美结合。

centurion.zh: 在古罗马，百人队队长指挥一百名士兵。

igneous.zh: 火成岩由冷却的熔岩或岩浆形成。

epilogue.zh: 小说以一个简短的尾声结束。

pollster.zh: 一位民意调查人进行了一项关于公众意见的调查。

baste.zh: 她会在烹饪时用黄油润以油脂火鸡。

baste.zh: 首先，用长针脚将布料片粗缝在一起。

elixir.zh: 这种草药酏剂被认为能治愈许多疾病。

doodle.zh: 她喜欢在课堂上在笔记本上涂鸦。

lope.zh: 他以稳定的步伐大步慢跑沿着小路出发。

osmosis.zh: 植物通过渗透作用从土壤中吸收水分。

osmosis.zh: 她在国外生活时通过潜移默化学会了这门语言。
