sycophant.zh: 他是一个奉承每个人的人。

retentive.en: She has a retentive memory for names.
retentive.zh: 她对名字有很好的记忆力。

retentive.en: A retentive mind helps in studying.

implode.en: The building might implode during demolition.
implode.zh: 建筑物在拆除时可能会内爆。

implode.en: The star will implode into a black hole.

gander.en: The gander chased the children away.
A gander is larger than a goose.

edify.en: Good books can edify the mind.
The teacher's words edify the students.

cherubic.en: The baby has a cherubic face.
cherubic.zh: 婴儿有一张天使般的脸。

cherubic.en: Her cherubic smile made everyone happy.
cherubic.zh: 她无邪的微笑让每个人都开心。

taxonomist.en: The taxonomist classified the new species.
taxonomist.zh: 分类学家给新物种分类。

taxonomist.en: A taxonomist studies how organisms are related.
taxonomist.zh: 分类学家研究生物之间的关系。

superintend.en: He will superintend the construction project.
superintend.zh: 他将监督这个建筑项目。

superintend.en: The manager superintends all the workers.

prissy.en: She is too prissy about her clothes.
prissy.zh: 她对衣服太过谨小慎微。

prissy.en: Don't be so prissy about small things.

pontifical.en: The bishop wore his pontifical robes.
pontifical.zh: 主教穿着他的主教服饰。

pontifical.en: His pontifical manner annoyed the crowd.
pontifical.zh: 他教皇般的态度惹恼了人群。

laminate.en: They laminate the paper for protection.
laminate.zh: 他们把纸压成薄片以保护。

laminate.en: The table has a laminate surface.

gibe.en: His gibe hurt her feelings deeply.
gibe.zh: 他的嘲笑深深伤害了她的感情。

gibe.en: She made a gibe about his hat.

ewer.en: She poured water from the ewer.
The antique ewer was made of silver.
ewer.zh: 这个古董水罐是银制的。

twaddle.en: His speech was full of twaddle.

stowaway.en: The stowaway hid in the cargo hold.
They found a stowaway on the ship.
stowaway.zh: 他们在船上发现了一个偷渡者。

raffish.en: He had a raffish charm about him.
Her raffish dress was too flashy.
raffish.zh: 她俗艳的裙子太花哨了。

hydrant.en: The firefighter connected the hose to the hydrant.
hydrant.zh: 消防员把水管接到消火栓上。

hydrant.en: There is a hydrant on the corner.

enrapture.en: The music will enrapture the audience.
Her beauty enraptured everyone in the room.
enrapture.zh: 她的美丽使房间里的每个人都陶醉。

sleigh.en: We rode a sleigh through the snow.
They sleighed the goods to the village.
sleigh.zh: 他们用雪橇把货物运到村庄。

manacle.zh: 警察给嫌疑人戴上手铐。

manacle.en: He felt manacled by his fears.

domesticate.en: People domesticate wild animals for food.
domesticate.zh: 人们驯养野生动物作为食物。

domesticate.en: They domesticated the land for farming.
domesticate.zh: 他们开垦土地用于耕作。

stigmatize.en: Society should not stigmatize mental illness.
stigmatize.zh: 社会不应污名化精神疾病。

stigmatize.en: They stigmatized him as a liar.

aseptic.en: Keep the wound aseptic to avoid infection.
aseptic.zh: 保持伤口无菌以防感染。

cleaver.en: The chef used a cleaver to cut meat.
A cleaver has a large square blade.
cleaver.zh: 切肉刀有一个大的方形刀片。

cardiologist.zh: 心脏病专家检查了我的心脏。

cardiologist.en: She visited a cardiologist for chest pain.
cardiologist.zh: 她因胸痛去看心脏病专家。

parabola.en: The ball followed a parabola in the air.
parabola.zh: 球在空中沿抛物线运动。

parabola.en: A parabola is a type of curve.

lucre.en: He only cares about filthy lucre.
They sought lucre through dishonest means.
lucre.zh: 他们通过不诚实手段谋取钱财。

importune.en: The beggar importuned me for money.
She importuned her father for a new toy.
importune.zh: 她缠着父亲要一个新玩具。

gratis.en: We received gratis tickets to the show.
gratis.zh: 我们免费得到了演出的门票。

expiation.en: He made expiation for his sins.

chasten.en: Failure can chasten a proud person.
The teacher chastened the unruly student.
chasten.zh: 老师惩罚了不守规矩的学生。

waspish.en: Her waspish remarks hurt his feelings.
waspish.zh: 她尖刻的言语伤害了他的感情。

waspish.en: He has a waspish temper today.

screed.en: He wrote a long screed about politics.
screed.zh: 他写了一篇关于政治的长篇大论。

screed.en: The screed was boring and repetitive.
screed.zh: 那篇冗长的文章无聊又重复。

centripetal.en: Centripetal force keeps planets in orbit.
centripetal.zh: 向心力使行星保持在轨道上。

centripetal.en: The centripetal motion pulled it inward.
centripetal.zh: 向心运动把它拉向内部。

carouse.en: They caroused all night at the party.
carouse.zh: 他们在聚会上痛饮了一整夜。
喧闹的酒会持续到黎明。

winnow.en: Farmers winnow the grain from the chaff.
winnow.zh: 农民扬去谷壳留下谷粒。

winnow.en: We need to winnow the good ideas.
winnow.zh: 我们需要精选出好主意。

vapid.en: The movie was vapid and boring.
She gave a vapid smile in response.

splurge.en: She splurged on a new handbag.
splurge.zh: 她挥霍买了一个新手提包。

splurge.en: His splurge on dinner was extravagant.
splurge.zh: 他在晚餐上的挥霍很奢侈。

perfidious.zh: 背信弃义的朋友背叛了他。

ineluctable.en: Death is an ineluctable fact of life.
ineluctable.zh: 死亡是生命中不可避免的事实。
变化在自然界中不可避免。

hieroglyph.zh: 古埃及人使用象形文字。

hieroglyph.en: The hieroglyph was hard to read.
hieroglyph.zh: 这个象形文字很难辨认。

gambol.en: The lambs gamboled in the field.
gambol.zh: 小羊在田野里跳跃嬉戏。

gambol.en: Children gambol happily in the park.
gambol.zh: 孩子们在公园里欢快地雀跃。

feisty.en: The feisty old woman argued with everyone.
feisty.zh: 那位好争吵的老妇人和每个人争论。

feisty.en: He is feisty and never gives up.

chary.en: He gave a chary answer to the question.
chary.zh: 他对问题给出了谨慎的回答。

canker.en: The tree had a canker on its bark.
Canker can destroy a plant's health.
canker.zh: 溃疡会破坏植物的健康。

burlesque.en: The show was a burlesque of politics.
burlesque.zh: 这场表演是对政治的滑稽模仿。

burlesque.en: He performed a burlesque dance on stage.
burlesque.zh: 他在舞台上表演了滑稽舞蹈。

bucolic.en: They enjoyed a bucolic life in the country.
bucolic.zh: 他们享受乡下的田园生活。

bucolic.en: The painting shows a bucolic scene.
bucolic.zh: 这幅画描绘了田园风光。

wizen.en: The old man's face was wizened.
The fruit wizened in the sun.

unpremeditated.zh: 他的话是未经事先考虑的。

simian.en: The simian climbed the tree quickly.
simian.zh: 那只猴子迅速爬上了树。

simian.en: He has simian features like a monkey.

polymath.en: Leonardo da Vinci was a polymath.
polymath.zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一位博学者。

polymath.en: A polymath knows many different subjects.
polymath.zh: 博学者通晓许多不同学科。

idolize.zh: 青少年常常崇拜流行明星。

faze.en: The criticism didn't faze her at all.
He was fazed by the difficult exam.
faze.zh: 他被困难的考试弄得狼狈。

abstemious.en: He is abstemious in eating and drinking.
An abstemious diet can improve health.
abstemious.zh: 有节制的饮食能改善健康。

undirected.en: His efforts were undirected and wasted.
undirected.zh: 他的努力没有方向，白费了。

undirected.en: The letter was undirected and lost.
undirected.zh: 那封信没有地址，丢失了。

pulsation.en: The pulsation of the heart is regular.
pulsation.zh: 心脏的搏动是有规律的。

pulsation.en: He felt a pulsation in his temple.

profiteer.en: The profiteer sold masks at high prices.

profiteer.zh: 他们在危机期间牟取暴利。

littoral.en: The littoral zone is rich in marine life.
littoral.zh: 沿海地区海洋生物丰富。

littoral.en: They live in the littoral region.

grounded.en: The metal box is grounded for safety.
grounded.zh: 金属盒已接地以确保安全。

grounded.en: Her arguments are grounded in facts.

cygnet.en: A cygnet swims behind its mother.
cygnet.zh: 一只小天鹅游在它母亲后面。

cygnet.en: The cygnet has soft gray feathers.
cygnet.zh: 这只小天鹅有柔软的灰色羽毛。

toupee.en: He wears a toupee to cover baldness.

toupee.zh: 他的假发看起来很自然。

perfidy.en: His perfidy shocked all his friends.
perfidy.zh: 他的背信弃义震惊了所有朋友。

perfidy.en: She could not forgive his perfidy.
perfidy.zh: 她无法原谅他的背信弃义。

noncommittal.en: He gave a noncommittal answer to the question.
noncommittal.zh: 他对问题给出了一个不明确的回答。

noncommittal.en: Her tone was noncommittal and vague.
noncommittal.zh: 她的语气不明确且含糊。

expository.en: This book is an expository text on science.
expository.zh: 这本书是一本说明性的科学文本。

expository.en: She wrote an expository essay about trees.
expository.zh: 她写了一篇关于树木的说明文。

confederacy.en: They fought for the confederacy during the war.
confederacy.zh: 他们在战争期间为邦联而战。

proboscis.en: The elephant uses its proboscis to drink water.
proboscis.zh: 大象用它的长鼻子喝水。

proboscis.en: A butterfly has a long proboscis for feeding.
proboscis.zh: 蝴蝶有用于进食的长喙。

bombast.en: His speech was full of bombast and little meaning.
bombast.zh: 他的演讲充满了夸大的言辞，没什么意义。

bombast.en: I dislike bombast in political debates.
bombast.zh: 我讨厌政治辩论中的夸大言辞。

optimization.en: Optimization improves the performance of the system.
optimization.zh: 优化提高了系统的性能。

optimization.en: We need optimization to reduce costs.
optimization.zh: 我们需要优化来降低成本。

vitreous.en: The vitreous humor fills the eye.
This material has a vitreous appearance.
vitreous.zh: 这种材料有玻璃般的外观。

fretwork.en: The wooden box has beautiful fretwork on it.
fretwork.zh: 木盒上有美丽的回纹装饰。

fretwork.en: Fretwork adds elegance to the furniture.
fretwork.zh: 回纹装饰给家具增添了优雅。

hyperactivity.en: The child's hyperactivity makes it hard to sit still.
hyperactivity.zh: 孩子的活动过多使他很难静坐。

hyperactivity.en: Hyperactivity is common in some young children.
hyperactivity.zh: 活动过多在一些幼儿中很常见。

neonate.en: The neonate needs special care after birth.
neonate.zh: 新生儿出生后需要特殊护理。

neonate.en: A neonate sleeps most of the day.
neonate.zh: 新生儿一天大部分时间都在睡觉。

defame.en: Do not defame others with false stories.
defame.zh: 不要用虚假故事诽谤他人。

defame.en: He tried to defame his rival in the election.
defame.zh: 他试图在选举中诽谤他的对手。

condiment.en: Ketchup is a popular condiment for fries.
condiment.zh: 番茄酱是薯条受欢迎的调味品。

condiment.en: She added a condiment to the soup for flavor.
condiment.zh: 她往汤里加了调味品提味。

sophistry.en: His argument is full of sophistry and tricks.
sophistry.zh: 他的论点充满了诡辩和花招。

gab.en: She has the gift of gab and talks a lot.
They gab for hours about nothing important.
gab.zh: 他们闲聊几个小时，没什么重要事。

spoor.en: The hunter followed the animal's spoor carefully.
spoor.zh: 猎人小心地追踪动物的足迹。

spoor.en: We found spoor in the mud near the river.
spoor.zh: 我们在河边的泥里发现了足迹。

spangle.en: Her dress was covered with shiny spangles.
spangle.zh: 她的裙子布满了闪亮的小亮片。

spangle.en: The stars spangle the night sky beautifully.
spangle.zh: 星星美丽地闪烁在夜空中。

smarmy.en: His smarmy smile made everyone uncomfortable.
smarmy.zh: 他虚情假意的微笑让所有人不舒服。

smarmy.en: I don't trust that smarmy salesman.
smarmy.zh: 我不相信那个虚情假意的销售员。

saccharine.en: The movie had a saccharine happy ending.
saccharine.zh: 这部电影有一个过于甜蜜的快乐结局。

saccharine.en: Her saccharine voice annoyed the listeners.
saccharine.zh: 她过于甜腻的声音让听众厌烦。

obfuscate.en: He tried to obfuscate the truth with lies.
obfuscate.zh: 他试图用谎言使真相模糊。

obfuscate.en: Don't obfuscate the issue with complex words.
obfuscate.zh: 不要用复杂的词语使问题模糊。

expiate.en: He tried to expiate his guilt by helping others.
expiate.zh: 他试图通过帮助他人来赎罪。

expiate.en: She wanted to expiate her past mistakes.
expiate.zh: 她想要补偿过去的错误。

delectation.en: The music was played for our delectation.
delectation.zh: 音乐是为我们的愉悦而演奏的。

delectation.en: He read the book with great delectation.
delectation.zh: 他带着极大的愉快读这本书。

percussionist.en: The percussionist played the drums beautifully.
percussionist.zh: 敲击乐器演奏者优美地演奏了鼓。

percussionist.en: She is a talented percussionist in the band.
percussionist.zh: 她是乐队里一位有才华的敲击乐器演奏者。

munificence.en: Her munificence helped many poor families.
munificence.zh: 她的慷慨帮助了许多贫困家庭。

munificence.en: We thanked him for his munificence.

mellifluous.en: Her mellifluous voice calmed the baby.
mellifluous.zh: 她甜美的声音安抚了婴儿。

mellifluous.en: The music had a mellifluous and soothing tone.
mellifluous.zh: 音乐有甜美舒缓的调子。

disembody.en: The ghost seemed to disembody from its form.
disembody.zh: 鬼魂似乎脱离了它的形体。

disembody.en: The idea can disembody from its original context.
disembody.zh: 这个想法可以从原始背景中脱离出来。

choleric.en: His choleric temper often gets him into trouble.
choleric.zh: 他易怒的脾气常给他惹麻烦。

choleric.en: She became choleric when she heard the news.
choleric.zh: 她听到消息后变得易怒。

argot.en: Thieves use their own argot to communicate.
argot.zh: 小偷用他们自己的黑话交流。

argot.en: The argot of doctors can be hard to understand.
argot.zh: 医生的行话可能很难理解。

vegetate.en: He just wants to vegetate in front of the TV.
vegetate.zh: 他只想在电视前无所事事。

vegetate.en: Don't vegetate all day; do something active.
vegetate.zh: 别整天无所事事；做点积极的事。

supplicant.en: She knelt as a supplicant before the altar.
supplicant.zh: 她作为恳求者跪在祭坛前。

stygian.en: The cave was dark and Stygian inside.
They walked through the Stygian forest at night.
stygian.zh: 他们夜晚穿过阴森的森林。

somnolent.en: The warm room made him feel somnolent.
somnolent.zh: 温暖的房间让他感到想睡。

somnolent.en: Her somnolent voice put the class to sleep.
somnolent.zh: 她催眠的声音让全班睡着了。

retrench.en: The company had to retrench to save money.
retrench.zh: 公司不得不紧缩开支以省钱。

retrench.en: They retrenched by cutting unnecessary staff.
retrench.zh: 他们通过裁减不必要的员工来削减费用。

plangent.en: The plangent sound of the bell echoed loudly.
A plangent cry came from the distance.
plangent.zh: 远处传来一声凄切的哭喊。

phony.en: He is a phony who pretends to be rich.
phony.zh: 他是个假装富有的假货。

phony.en: Her smile looked phony and insincere.
phony.zh: 她的微笑看起来虚假且不真诚。

mordant.en: His mordant wit offended some people.
mordant.zh: 他尖酸的机智冒犯了一些人。

mordant.en: She made a mordant comment about the food.
mordant.zh: 她对食物做了尖酸的评论。

emollient.en: This cream is an emollient for dry skin.
emollient.zh: 这款面霜是干性皮肤的润肤剂。

emollient.en: The lotion has an emollient effect on hands.
emollient.zh: 这款乳液对手有软化效果。

egress.en: The egress from the theater was crowded.
We found the emergency egress quickly.
egress.zh: 我们很快找到了紧急出口。

desperado.en: The desperado was wanted by the law.
desperado.zh: 那个亡命之徒被法律通缉。

desperado.en: A desperado robbed the bank yesterday.
desperado.zh: 一个亡命之徒昨天抢劫了银行。

deputize.en: She will deputize for the manager today.
They deputize him to lead the team.
deputize.zh: 他们指定他代理领导团队。

blustering.en: The blustering wind knocked down trees.
blustering.zh: 狂风大作的风吹倒了树木。

blustering.en: We stayed inside during the blustering storm.
blustering.zh: 在狂暴的暴风雨期间我们待在室内。

tautological.en: His speech was tautological and boring.
Avoid tautological phrases in your writing.
tautological.zh: 在你的写作中避免赘述的短语。

subvention.en: The university received a government subvention.
subvention.zh: 这所大学获得了政府补助金。

subvention.en: They applied for a subvention to fund research.
subvention.zh: 他们申请了津贴来资助研究。

preeminent.en: She is a preeminent scientist in her field.
preeminent.zh: 她是她领域内卓越的科学家。

preeminent.en: This museum has a preeminent art collection.
preeminent.zh: 这个博物馆拥有超群的艺术收藏。

imperturbable.en: He remained imperturbable during the crisis.

imperturbable.zh: 她泰然自若的冷静给每个人留下印象。

retroactive.en: The new law is retroactive to last year.
They gave retroactive pay for the extra work.
retroactive.zh: 他们为额外工作提供了有追溯效力的报酬。

iridescence.en: The soap bubble showed beautiful iridescence.
iridescence.zh: 肥皂泡显示出美丽的彩虹色。

iridescence.en: The butterfly's wings had a lovely iridescence.
iridescence.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀有可爱的晕色。

diaphanous.en: She wore a diaphanous silk dress.
diaphanous.zh: 她穿了一件透明的丝绸连衣裙。

diaphanous.en: The curtains were made of diaphanous fabric.
diaphanous.zh: 窗帘由轻柔的织物制成。

blazon.en: They blazon the family crest on the shield.
blazon.zh: 他们在盾牌上装饰家族纹章。

blazon.en: The knight's armor was blazoned with gold.
blazon.zh: 骑士的盔甲用金色装饰。

gridiron.en: He cooked steak on the gridiron.
The gridiron was hot and ready for fish.
gridiron.zh: 烤架很热，准备好烤鱼了。

forager.en: The forager gathered berries in the forest.
forager.zh: 粮秣征收员在森林里采集浆果。

forager.en: A forager searches for food every day.
forager.zh: 一个抢劫者每天寻找食物。

academician.en: The academician gave a lecture on physics.
academician.zh: 院士做了一场关于物理的讲座。

academician.en: She was elected as an academician last year.
academician.zh: 她去年被选为学会会员。

arabesque.en: The dancer performed a beautiful arabesque.
arabesque.zh: 舞者表演了一个优美的阿拉伯式花饰。

arabesque.en: She held the arabesque pose for a long time.
arabesque.zh: 她长时间保持阿拉伯式花饰姿势。

plenitude.en: The garden had a plenitude of flowers.
A plenitude of food was on the table.

ductile.en: Gold is a very ductile metal.
ductile.zh: 金是一种非常易延展的金属。

ductile.en: The ductile wire can be bent easily.
ductile.zh: 这种韧性的电线容易弯曲。

spunk.en: He showed great spunk in the competition.
spunk.zh: 他在比赛中表现出极大的勇气。

spunk.en: She used dry leaves as spunk for the fire.
spunk.zh: 她用干叶子作为引火柴。

gadfly.en: The gadfly bothered the horses in the field.
gadfly.zh: 牛虻打扰了田野里的马。

gadfly.en: He was a gadfly at the meeting, asking questions.
gadfly.zh: 他在会议上是个讨厌的人，不断提问。

consonance.en: The poem used consonance for effect.
consonance.zh: 这首诗使用辅音韵来达到效果。

consonance.en: There is consonance between their opinions.
consonance.zh: 他们的意见之间有一致。

dyspeptic.en: He felt dyspeptic after the heavy meal.
dyspeptic.zh: 他在大餐后感到消化不良。

dyspeptic.en: The dyspeptic patient avoided spicy food.
dyspeptic.zh: 消化不良的病人避免辛辣食物。

glitch.en: The computer had a glitch in the system.
glitch.zh: 电脑系统有一个假信号。

glitch.en: A glitch caused the program to crash.
glitch.zh: 一个故障导致程序崩溃。

incubus.en: The nightmare felt like an incubus on his chest.
incubus.zh: 噩梦感觉像梦魇压在他胸口。

incubus.en: Debt can be an incubus on a person's life.
incubus.zh: 债务可能成为一个人生活的沉重负担。

expatiate.en: He began to expatiate on the topic.
The professor expatiated on the theory for hours.
expatiate.zh: 教授细说这个理论几个小时。

valediction.en: She gave a heartfelt valediction at graduation.
valediction.zh: 她在毕业典礼上发表了衷心的告别辞。

valediction.en: His valediction moved the audience to tears.
valediction.zh: 他的告别让观众感动落泪。

theocracy.en: The country was ruled as a theocracy.
theocracy.zh: 这个国家作为神权政治被统治。

theocracy.en: In a theocracy, religious leaders hold power.
theocracy.zh: 在神权国，宗教领袖掌握权力。

seraphic.en: The child had a seraphic smile.

seraphic.zh: 她纯洁的声音让每个人平静。

puckish.en: He gave a puckish grin and ran away.
puckish.zh: 他顽皮地咧嘴一笑然后跑开了。

puckish.en: Her puckish sense of humor amused us.
puckish.zh: 她恶作剧的幽默感逗乐了我们。

pellucid.en: The lake water was pellucid and clear.
His explanation was pellucid and easy to follow.
pellucid.zh: 他的解释明了且容易理解。

lackadaisical.en: He was lackadaisical about his homework.
Her lackadaisical attitude annoyed the teacher.
lackadaisical.zh: 她愁闷的态度惹恼了老师。

gnomic.en: His gnomic sayings were hard to understand.
gnomic.zh: 他含格言的谚语很难理解。

cosmopolitanism.zh: 世界主义促进全球理解。

cosmopolitanism.en: He believed in cosmopolitanism and open borders.
cosmopolitanism.zh: 他相信世界主义和开放边界。

coarsen.en: The fabric will coarsen after many washes.
coarsen.zh: 布料多次洗涤后会变粗。

coarsen.en: His manners began to coarsen over time.
coarsen.zh: 他的举止随时间开始变粗。

boor.en: He acted like a boor at the dinner party.
boor.zh: 他在晚宴上表现得像个粗野的人。

boor.en: Don't be a boor; say please and thank you.
boor.zh: 别不懂礼貌；说请和谢谢。

besmirch.en: They tried to besmirch his reputation.
besmirch.zh: 他们试图弄污他的名声。

besmirch.en: False rumors can besmirch a person's name.
besmirch.zh: 虚假谣言会弄污一个人的名字。

backhanded.en: Her backhanded remark was hard to interpret.
backhanded.zh: 她间接的评论很难解读。

antediluvian.en: The building looked antediluvian and old.
antediluvian.zh: 这栋建筑看起来陈旧古老。

antediluvian.en: His ideas are antediluvian and outdated.

proverbially.en: He is proverbially known for his honesty.
The city is proverbially rainy in winter.
proverbially.zh: 这个城市冬天如谚语所说多雨。

polyglot.en: She is a polyglot who speaks five languages.
polyglot.zh: 她是一个会说五种语言的多语者。

polyglot.en: This polyglot dictionary has many translations.
polyglot.zh: 这本多语词典有很多翻译。

factotum.en: He works as a factotum in the office.
The factotum handles all kinds of tasks.
factotum.zh: 这个杂工处理各种任务。

skit.en: They performed a funny skit at the party.
skit.zh: 他们在聚会上表演了一个有趣的短剧。

skit.en: The skit made everyone laugh out loud.
skit.zh: 这个短剧让每个人都大笑起来。

remiss.en: He was remiss in his duties today.
It is remiss of you to forget the meeting.

recondite.en: The professor discussed a recondite topic.
recondite.zh: 教授讨论了一个深奥的话题。

recondite.en: This book is too recondite for beginners.
recondite.zh: 这本书对初学者来说太难懂了。

pulverize.en: The machine can pulverize rocks into dust.
pulverize.zh: 这台机器能把岩石磨成粉末。

pulverize.en: She used a blender to pulverize the spices.
pulverize.zh: 她用搅拌机把香料磨成粉。

pecan.en: She baked a pie with fresh pecan nuts.
pecan.zh: 她用新鲜的山核桃烤了一个派。

pecan.en: The pecan tree in the yard is very tall.
pecan.zh: 院子里的山核桃树非常高。

parley.en: The two leaders met to parley about peace.
parley.zh: 两位领导人会面谈判和平。

parley.en: They held a parley to end the conflict.
parley.zh: 他们举行会谈以结束冲突。

mollycoddle.en: Don't mollycoddle your child too much.
mollycoddle.zh: 不要过分溺爱你的孩子。

mollycoddle.en: He is a mollycoddle who never works hard.
mollycoddle.zh: 他是个娇生惯养的人，从不努力工作。

mien.en: Her calm mien impressed everyone at the meeting.
mien.zh: 她平静的风度给会议上的每个人留下了印象。

mien.en: He has a serious mien when working.

lineal.en: He is a lineal descendant of the king.
The family follows a lineal inheritance system.
lineal.zh: 这个家族遵循直系继承制度。

insouciant.en: She remained insouciant despite the problems.
insouciant.zh: 尽管有问题，她仍然漫不经心。

insouciant.en: His insouciant attitude annoyed his boss.
insouciant.zh: 他满不在乎的态度惹恼了老板。

immure.en: The prisoner was immured in a dark cell.
immure.zh: 囚犯被监禁在黑暗的牢房里。

immure.en: They immured themselves in the library to study.
immure.zh: 他们把自己关在图书馆里学习。

encomium.en: The teacher gave an encomium to the student.
encomium.zh: 老师给了这个学生一番赞美。

encomium.en: Her speech was full of encomium for the team.
encomium.zh: 她的演讲充满了对团队的赞美。

browbeat.en: He tried to browbeat his younger brother.
Don't let anyone browbeat you into silence.
browbeat.zh: 不要让任何人吓唬你保持沉默。

asperity.en: He spoke with asperity to the rude customer.
asperity.zh: 他粗暴地对那个粗鲁的顾客说话。

asperity.en: The asperity of winter made travel difficult.
asperity.zh: 冬天的严酷使旅行变得困难。

sunder.en: The storm sunder the old bridge in two.
sunder.zh: 暴风雨把旧桥劈成两半。

sunder.en: Nothing can sunder their strong friendship.
sunder.zh: 没有什么能分离他们坚固的友谊。

puerile.en: His puerile jokes annoyed the adults.
puerile.zh: 他幼稚的笑话惹恼了成年人。

puerile.en: Stop being so puerile and act mature.
puerile.zh: 别那么幼稚，表现得成熟点。

piebald.en: The piebald horse ran across the field.
She adopted a piebald cat from the shelter.
piebald.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只花斑猫。

illiberal.en: His illiberal views shocked his friends.
illiberal.zh: 他狭隘的观点震惊了他的朋友。

illiberal.en: The policy was criticized as illiberal.
illiberal.zh: 这项政策被批评为狭隘。

flunk.en: He flunked the math exam last semester.
flunk.zh: 他上学期数学考试不及格。

flunk.en: If you don't study, you will flunk the test.
flunk.zh: 如果你不学习，考试就会不及格。

deactivate.en: The soldier was deactivated after the war.
deactivate.zh: 战后这名士兵被撤消了现役。

deactivate.en: Please deactivate your account before leaving.
deactivate.zh: 离开前请停用你的账户。

coagulate.en: Blood will coagulate when exposed to air.
coagulate.zh: 血液暴露在空气中会凝结。

coagulate.en: The milk began to coagulate in the heat.
coagulate.zh: 牛奶在高温下开始凝结。

cloudburst.en: A sudden cloudburst soaked everyone outside.
cloudburst.zh: 一场突如其来的倾盆大雨淋湿了外面所有人。

cloudburst.en: The cloudburst caused flooding in the streets.
cloudburst.zh: 这场豪雨导致街道洪水泛滥。

suppliant.en: The suppliant begged for mercy from the king.
suppliant.zh: 恳求者向国王乞求怜悯。

suppliant.en: She knelt as a suppliant before the altar.
suppliant.zh: 她作为恳求者跪在祭坛前。

savvy.en: She has a lot of business savvy.
He is savvy about technology trends.

satirize.zh: 这幅漫画讽刺政治腐败。
作家经常讽刺社会规范。

omnivorous.en: Bears are omnivorous animals that eat plants and meat.
omnivorous.zh: 熊是杂食动物，吃植物和肉。

omnivorous.en: She is an omnivorous reader of many genres.
omnivorous.zh: 她是一个什么书都读的读者。

jingoism.en: Jingoism often leads to unnecessary wars.
jingoism.zh: 沙文主义常常导致不必要的战争。

jingoism.en: The politician's speech was full of jingoism.
jingoism.zh: 这位政治家的演讲充满了沙文主义。

freelancer.en: She works as a freelancer for several magazines.
freelancer.zh: 她为几家杂志做自由撰稿人。

freelancer.en: The freelancer enjoys flexible working hours.
freelancer.zh: 这个自由职业者享受灵活的工作时间。

honorarium.en: The speaker received an honorarium for the talk.
honorarium.zh: 演讲者因演讲获得了一笔酬金。

honorarium.en: They paid a small honorarium to the guest.
honorarium.zh: 他们付给客人一小笔谢礼。

shipshape.en: The kitchen is always kept shipshape.
shipshape.zh: 厨房总是保持整洁干净。

shipshape.en: He likes everything in his room shipshape.
shipshape.zh: 他喜欢房间里的一切都整整齐齐。

ostracize.en: The group decided to ostracize the troublemaker.
ostracize.zh: 这个团体决定排斥那个惹麻烦的人。

ostracize.en: She felt ostracized by her former friends.
ostracize.zh: 她感到被以前的朋友排斥了。

habituate.en: You need to habituate yourself to the cold.
habituate.zh: 你需要让自己习惯于寒冷。

habituate.en: The animals habituate to the noise quickly.
habituate.zh: 动物们很快就习惯了噪音。

lactic.en: Lactic acid builds up in muscles after exercise.
lactic.zh: 运动后肌肉中会积累乳酸。

lactic.en: This yogurt contains lactic acid bacteria.

gazetteer.en: The gazetteer listed all the towns in the region.
gazetteer.zh: 地名辞典列出了该地区所有城镇。

gazetteer.en: He worked as a gazetteer for the local paper.
gazetteer.zh: 他曾为当地报纸担任公报作者。

excoriate.en: The critic excoriated the new movie harshly.
excoriate.zh: 评论家严厉地批评了这部新电影。

excoriate.en: She excoriated him for his careless mistake.
excoriate.zh: 她因他粗心的错误而严厉责难他。

arboreal.en: Monkeys are arboreal animals living in trees.
arboreal.zh: 猴子是生活在树上的树栖动物。

arboreal.en: The arboreal habitat is rich in biodiversity.
arboreal.zh: 树栖栖息地生物多样性丰富。

ellipsis.en: Use an ellipsis to show omitted words.
ellipsis.zh: 用省略号表示省略的词语。

ellipsis.en: The ellipsis in the text indicates a pause.
ellipsis.zh: 文本中的省略号表示停顿。

declamation.en: His declamation moved the audience deeply.
declamation.zh: 他慷慨激昂的演说深深打动了观众。

declamation.en: She practiced her declamation for the contest.
declamation.zh: 她为比赛练习慷慨激昂的演说。

neophyte.en: The neophyte joined the church last year.
neophyte.zh: 这位新入教者去年加入了教会。

neophyte.en: She is a neophyte in this field.
neophyte.zh: 她在这个领域是个新手。

bumptious.zh: 他傲慢的态度惹恼了所有人。

bumptious.en: She is too bumptious for a beginner.
bumptious.zh: 她作为初学者太自大了。

superfluity.en: The kitchen has a superfluity of spices.
Superfluity of wealth can cause waste.

shibboleth.en: They used a shibboleth to identify members.
shibboleth.zh: 他们用一个暗号来识别成员。

shibboleth.en: That phrase is a shibboleth of the group.
shibboleth.zh: 那个短语是这个群体的行话。

foppish.en: His foppish clothes drew many stares.
foppish.zh: 他浮华的衣着引来了许多目光。

foppish.en: She found his foppish manner ridiculous.
foppish.zh: 她觉得他矫饰的举止很可笑。

drizzly.en: The drizzly morning made me stay inside.
drizzly.zh: 下毛毛雨的早晨让我待在室内。

drizzly.en: We walked in the drizzly weather.
drizzly.zh: 我们在毛毛雨的天气里散步。

vim.en: She worked with great vim and vigor.
His writing is full of vim and style.
vim.zh: 他的写作充满活力和风格。

skinflint.en: The skinflint refused to donate any money.
skinflint.zh: 那个吝啬鬼拒绝捐任何钱。

skinflint.en: He is such a skinflint he never tips.
skinflint.zh: 他真是个吝啬鬼，从不给小费。

seemly.en: It is seemly to dress for the occasion.
seemly.zh: 根据场合着装是恰当的。

seemly.en: Her behavior was always seemly and polite.
seemly.zh: 她的行为总是得体和礼貌的。

obstreperous.en: The obstreperous children disrupted the class.
obstreperous.zh: 吵闹的孩子们扰乱了课堂。

obstreperous.en: He became obstreperous after drinking too much.
obstreperous.zh: 他喝太多后变得不守秩序。

demotic.en: The demotic language is used by common people.
demotic.zh: 通俗语言被普通人使用。

demotic.en: He wrote in a demotic style for everyone.
demotic.zh: 他以通俗的风格为所有人写作。

coddle.en: Parents should not coddle their children too much.
coddle.zh: 父母不应过分溺爱孩子。

coddle.en: She likes to coddle eggs for breakfast.
coddle.zh: 她喜欢用文火煮鸡蛋当早餐。

beatific.en: She had a beatific smile on her face.
beatific.zh: 她脸上带着至福的微笑。

beatific.en: The beatific vision brought him peace.
beatific.zh: 这赐福的景象给他带来了平静。

avowal.en: His avowal of love surprised everyone.
avowal.zh: 他公开表示爱意让所有人惊讶。

avowal.en: She made an avowal of her innocence.
avowal.zh: 她坦率承认自己的清白。

adulterate.en: They adulterate the milk with water.
Do not adulterate the wine with cheap alcohol.
adulterate.zh: 不要用廉价酒精掺杂葡萄酒。

sententious.en: His sententious remarks bored the audience.
sententious.zh: 他警句式的言论让观众厌烦。

sententious.en: She gave a sententious speech full of morals.
sententious.zh: 她做了一个充满格言的简洁演讲。

racketeer.en: The racketeer was arrested for fraud.
racketeer.zh: 那个敲诈者因诈骗被捕。

racketeer.en: He operates as a racketeer in the city.

noisome.en: The noisome smell came from the garbage.
They avoided the noisome swamp area.
noisome.zh: 他们避开了那个有害的沼泽区域。

muffler.en: She wore a warm muffler around her neck.
muffler.zh: 她脖子上围着一条温暖的围巾。

muffler.en: The car's muffler needs to be replaced.
muffler.zh: 汽车的消声器需要更换。

gutless.en: He is too gutless to speak up.
gutless.zh: 他太无胆量，不敢说出来。

gutless.en: The gutless decision disappointed the team.
gutless.zh: 这个无胆量的决定让团队失望。

dormancy.en: The seeds remain in dormancy during winter.
The volcano is in a state of dormancy.

disquisition.en: He wrote a disquisition on ancient history.
disquisition.zh: 他写了一篇关于古代史的专题论文。

disquisition.en: The professor's disquisition was very detailed.

snowdrift.en: The car got stuck in a snowdrift.
Children played in the large snowdrift.
snowdrift.zh: 孩子们在大雪堆里玩耍。

dotage.en: He is in his dotage and needs care.
dotage.zh: 他处于老耄状态，需要照顾。

dotage.en: Her dotage shows in her forgetfulness.
dotage.zh: 她的老迷糊表现在健忘上。

aureole.en: The saint had an aureole around his head.
We saw the aureole during the eclipse.
aureole.zh: 我们在日食期间看到了光晕。

antedate.en: This artifact antedates the Roman era.
antedate.zh: 这件人工制品先于罗马时代。

antedate.en: The document antedates the contract by a week.
antedate.zh: 这份文件比合同早一周。

toady.en: He is a toady who flatters the boss.
toady.zh: 他是个谄媚老板的马屁精。

toady.en: She toadies to the manager for favors.
toady.zh: 她拍经理马屁以求好处。

slanderous.en: The slanderous rumors hurt her reputation.
slanderous.zh: 中伤性的谣言损害了她的声誉。

slanderous.en: He made slanderous statements about his rival.
slanderous.zh: 他对对手做了诽谤性的陈述。

remonstrance.en: They filed a remonstrance against the policy.
remonstrance.zh: 他们对该政策提出了抗议。

remonstrance.en: His remonstrance was ignored by the council.
remonstrance.zh: 他的规劝被议会忽视了。

nostrum.en: He sells a nostrum that claims to cure all.
nostrum.zh: 他卖一种声称能治百病的万能药。

nostrum.en: That nostrum is not approved by doctors.
nostrum.zh: 那种成药未经医生批准。

impermanent.en: All things in life are impermanent.
impermanent.zh: 生活中所有事物都是暂时的。

impermanent.en: The beauty of flowers is impermanent.

heterodox.en: His heterodox views challenged the tradition.
heterodox.zh: 他非正统的观点挑战了传统。

heterodox.en: The heterodox theory was rejected by many.
heterodox.zh: 这个异端理论被许多人拒绝。

yaw.en: The ship began to yaw in the storm.
The pilot corrected the yaw of the plane.
yaw.zh: 飞行员纠正了飞机的偏航。

emaciation.zh: 疾病导致了严重的消瘦。

emaciation.en: Emaciation is a sign of malnutrition.
emaciation.zh: 瘦弱是营养不良的迹象。

clairvoyance.en: She claimed to have clairvoyance powers.
His clairvoyance helped solve the mystery.
clairvoyance.zh: 他的洞察力帮助解开了谜团。

derogate.en: Do not derogate his achievements unfairly.
derogate.zh: 不要不公平地贬损他的成就。

derogate.en: Her comments derogate the value of the work.
derogate.zh: 她的评论贬损了工作的价值。

savant.en: The savant is an expert in mathematics.
She is a savant in ancient languages.

corpuscle.en: A red blood corpuscle carries oxygen.
The microscope showed a tiny corpuscle.
corpuscle.zh: 显微镜显示了一个微小的微粒。

sybaritic.en: He leads a sybaritic life of luxury.
sybaritic.zh: 他过着奢侈享乐的生活。

sybaritic.en: The sybaritic resort attracted wealthy guests.
sybaritic.zh: 这个骄奢淫逸的度假胜地吸引了富有的客人。

wastrel.en: The wastrel spent all his money on games.
wastrel.zh: 这个浪子把所有的钱都花在游戏上。

wastrel.en: She called him a wastrel for wasting food.
wastrel.zh: 她叫他饭桶，因为他浪费食物。

scissor.en: Please scissor the paper along the line.
He used a tool to scissor the wire.

proselytize.en: They tried to proselytize their neighbors.
proselytize.zh: 他们试图劝诱邻居改变信仰。

proselytize.en: He does not like to proselytize at work.
proselytize.zh: 他不喜欢在工作中劝人改变信仰。

penumbra.en: The penumbra of the eclipse was visible.
She stood in the penumbra of the tree.

overweening.en: His overweening pride made him unpopular.
overweening.zh: 他过分的骄傲使他不受欢迎。

overweening.en: She had an overweening confidence in her plan.
overweening.zh: 她对她的计划过于自信。

disport.en: The children disport themselves in the park.
They disport on the beach all afternoon.
disport.zh: 他们整个下午在海滩上娱乐。

diabolic.en: The villain had a diabolic plan.
diabolic.zh: 这个恶棍有一个恶毒的计划。
他恶魔般的笑声吓坏了所有人。

unwonted.en: She showed unwonted kindness to strangers.
unwonted.zh: 她对陌生人表现出不寻常的友善。

unwonted.en: His unwonted silence worried his friends.
unwonted.zh: 他不寻常的沉默让朋友们担心。

rustler.en: The rustler stole cattle from the farm.
rustler.zh: 偷家畜贼从农场偷了牛。

rustler.en: Police caught the rustler near the river.
rustler.zh: 警察在河边抓住了偷家畜贼。

nugatory.en: The old contract is now nugatory.
His efforts proved nugatory in the end.
nugatory.zh: 他的努力最终证明是无用的。

labile.en: Her mood is labile and changes quickly.
labile.zh: 她的情绪不稳定，变化很快。

labile.en: The chemical compound is highly labile.
labile.zh: 这种化合物非常不稳定。

duplicitous.en: He is a duplicitous person you cannot trust.
duplicitous.zh: 他是一个你不能信任的奸诈之人。
她搞两面派的行为让所有人惊讶。

dexterous.en: The artist is dexterous with her hands.
He made a dexterous move to catch the ball.
dexterous.zh: 他灵巧地移动接住了球。

abase.en: Do not abase yourself for anyone.
abase.zh: 不要为任何人贬低自己。

abase.en: He tried to abase his rival publicly.
abase.zh: 他试图公开贬低他的对手。

zephyr.en: A gentle zephyr blew through the garden.
The zephyr carried the scent of flowers.

presentiment.en: She had a presentiment of danger ahead.
presentiment.zh: 她对前方的危险有一种预感。

presentiment.en: His presentiment turned out to be correct.

gerontology.en: She studies gerontology at the university.
gerontology.zh: 她在大学学习老年医学。

gerontology.en: Gerontology helps us understand aging better.
gerontology.zh: 老年医学帮助我们更好地理解衰老。

genuflect.en: They genuflect before the altar in church.
genuflect.zh: 他们在教堂的祭坛前屈膝跪拜。

genuflect.en: He refused to genuflect to the king.

fusillade.en: A fusillade of bullets rang out suddenly.
fusillade.zh: 一阵齐射的子弹突然响起。

fusillade.en: The soldiers faced a fusillade from the enemy.
fusillade.zh: 士兵们面对敌人的齐射。

dullard.en: He is a dullard who never learns anything.
dullard.zh: 他是个从不学任何东西的笨蛋。

dullard.en: Don't be a dullard; think before you act.
dullard.zh: 别做蠢人，行动前先思考。

cacophonous.en: The cacophonous noise hurt my ears.
cacophonous.zh: 不和谐的声音伤害了我的耳朵。

cacophonous.en: Their singing was cacophonous and unpleasant.
cacophonous.zh: 他们的歌声不和谐且令人不快。

tamp.en: He used a tool to tamp the soil firmly.
Please tamp the tobacco into the pipe.

saccharin.en: She uses saccharin instead of sugar in tea.
saccharin.zh: 她在茶里用糖精代替糖。
糖精是一种无热量的甜味剂。

gavel.en: The judge banged his gavel for silence.
gavel.zh: 法官敲击他的小木槌要求安静。

gavel.en: The auctioneer used a gavel to close the sale.
gavel.zh: 拍卖商用木槌结束了拍卖。

swank.en: He likes to swank about his new car.
Her swank dress impressed everyone at the party.
swank.zh: 她优雅的裙子给派对上的每个人留下了印象。

preponderant.en: The preponderant opinion favored the new law.
preponderant.zh: 占优势的意见支持新法律。

preponderant.en: Her influence was preponderant in the group.
preponderant.zh: 她的影响在团体中是主要的。

nestling.en: The nestling waited for its mother to return.
nestling.zh: 雏鸟等待它的母亲回来。

nestling.en: A nestling fell from the tree yesterday.
nestling.zh: 昨天一只雏鸟从树上掉了下来。

muzzy.en: I feel muzzy after taking the medicine.
muzzy.zh: 服药后我感到昏昏沉沉。

muzzy.en: His memory of the event is muzzy.
muzzy.zh: 他对那件事的记忆是模糊的。

gnawing.en: The dog is gnawing on a bone in the yard.
She felt a gnawing pain in her stomach.

tauten.en: The rope will tauten when you pull it hard.
tauten.zh: 当你用力拉时，绳子会绷紧。

tauten.en: Her muscles tauten as she lifts the weight.

adventitious.en: The discovery was adventitious, not planned.
adventitious.zh: 这个发现是偶然的，不是计划好的。

adventitious.en: Adventitious roots grow from the stem.
adventitious.zh: 不定根从茎上生长出来。

cognizance.en: He took cognizance of the new rules.
The court has cognizance of this case.

pullet.en: The pullet laid its first egg today.
pullet.zh: 小母鸡今天下了第一个蛋。

pullet.en: She bought a pullet from the farmer.
pullet.zh: 她从农民那里买了一只小母鸡。

antihistamine.en: She took an antihistamine for her allergies.
antihistamine.zh: 她服用了抗组胺药来治疗过敏。
抗组胺药有助于减少打喷嚏。

reprobate.en: The reprobate was known for his bad deeds.
reprobate.zh: 这个恶棍以其恶行而闻名。

reprobate.en: He is a reprobate who lies all the time.
reprobate.zh: 他是一个总是说谎的堕落之人。

mistral.en: The mistral blows strongly in winter here.
mistral.zh: 这里的密史脱拉风在冬天吹得很猛。

mistral.en: Farmers fear the mistral during harvest time.
mistral.zh: 农民在收获季节害怕密史脱拉风。

colloquium.en: The colloquium on science was very interesting.
colloquium.zh: 关于科学的讨论会非常有趣。

colloquium.en: She presented her research at the colloquium.
colloquium.zh: 她在讨论会上展示了她的研究。

fossilize.en: The bones began to fossilize over time.
fossilize.zh: 骨头随着时间的推移开始变成化石。

fossilize.en: His ideas fossilize and never change.
fossilize.zh: 他的想法变得陈腐，从不改变。

musicologist.zh: 这位音乐学者研究了古代歌曲。

musicologist.en: A musicologist gave a lecture on jazz.
musicologist.zh: 一位音乐学者就爵士乐做了讲座。

ethnology.zh: 人种学研究不同的人类文化。

ethnology.en: She is a professor of ethnology at college.
ethnology.zh: 她是大学的人种学教授。

potable.en: We need potable water for camping.

apostate.en: He was called an apostate for leaving.
apostate.zh: 他因离开而被称作叛教者。

apostate.en: The apostate leader lost all support.
apostate.zh: 那位变节领袖失去了所有支持。

accrete.zh: 矿物在岩石周围附着生长。

ruminant.zh: 羊是常见的反刍哺乳动物。

runic.zh: 他研究了古代如尼符号。

pantechnicon.zh: 家具搬运车搬走了我们的家具。

pantechnicon.en: We hired a pantechnicon for the move.
pantechnicon.zh: 我们雇了一辆家具搬运车搬家。

obloquy.en: He faced public obloquy for his actions.
obloquy.zh: 他的行为招致了公众辱骂。
那位政客忍受了许多毁谤。

exiguous.en: The exiguous meal left him hungry.
exiguous.zh: 那顿稀少的饭让他饿着。

exiguous.en: They had exiguous resources for the trip.
exiguous.zh: 他们旅行资源极其匮乏。

backslide.en: He tried not to backslide in his studies.
backslide.zh: 他努力不在学习上退步。

backslide.en: After a good start, she began to backslide.
backslide.zh: 好的开始后，她开始堕落。

vaporous.en: The vaporous mist covered the valley.
vaporous.zh: 雾状的薄雾笼罩了山谷。

vaporous.en: Her ideas were vaporous and unclear.
vaporous.zh: 她的想法空想而不清晰。

sagacious.en: The sagacious leader made wise decisions.
sagacious.zh: 睿智的领导者做出了明智的决定。
她是一位聪明的女商人。

perambulate.en: They perambulate the park every morning.
perambulate.zh: 他们每天早晨在公园漫步。

perambulate.en: He likes to perambulate around the city.

mendacious.en: His mendacious story fooled no one.
mendacious.zh: 他虚假的故事骗不了任何人。

extenuate.zh: 没有什么能减轻他的罪行。

extenuate.en: She tried to extenuate her mistake.
extenuate.zh: 她试图为自己的错误找借口。

svelte.en: She looked svelte in her new dress.
svelte.zh: 她穿着新裙子显得苗条。
苗条的模特优雅地走着。

piddling.en: He wasted time on piddling tasks.
piddling.zh: 他把时间浪费在琐屑的任务上。

piddling.en: The amount was piddling and insignificant.
piddling.zh: 那数量微不足道且不重要。

petrify.en: The loud noise petrified the child.
petrify.zh: 巨大的声响把孩子吓呆了。

petrify.en: Wood can petrify over millions of years.
petrify.zh: 木头经过数百万年可以石化。

perspicacious.en: She is a perspicacious judge of character.
perspicacious.zh: 她是一位敏锐的性格判断者。
他聪颖的评论给所有人留下了印象。

dabbler.en: He is a dabbler in many hobbies.
dabbler.zh: 他在许多爱好上都是浅尝者。

dabbler.en: She is just a dabbler in painting.
dabbler.zh: 她在绘画上只是个戏水者。

cavil.en: He tends to cavil at small details.

badinage.en: Their badinage was light and friendly.
badinage.zh: 他们的玩笑轻松而友好。

badinage.en: She enjoyed the witty badinage at the party.
badinage.zh: 她喜欢派对上的机智嘲弄。

apropos.en: His comment was apropos to the discussion.
apropos.zh: 他的评论对讨论很恰当。

apropos.en: She spoke apropos of the current situation.
apropos.zh: 她恰当地谈论了当前局势。

periscope.en: The submarine used a periscope to see above.
periscope.zh: 潜艇用潜望镜观察上方。

periscope.en: He looked through the periscope at the view.

fusty.en: The old room smelled fusty and damp.
fusty.zh: 旧房间闻起来发霉而潮湿。
他守旧的想法已经过时了。

frigidity.en: The frigidity of the water shocked him.

emulsify.en: The blender helps emulsify the oil and water.
emulsify.zh: 搅拌机帮助乳化油和水。

emulsify.en: You need to emulsify the ingredients slowly.
emulsify.zh: 你需要慢慢乳化这些成分。

bespeak.zh: 他平静的声音表示自信。

turncoat.en: He was called a turncoat for switching sides.
turncoat.zh: 他因改变立场而被称作背叛者。

turncoat.en: The turncoat betrayed his former allies.
turncoat.zh: 那位变节者背叛了从前的盟友。

sparing.en: He is sparing with his words.
She was sparing in her use of salt.

skillet.en: She fried eggs in a skillet.
The skillet was hot on the stove.

petrology.zh: 岩石学帮助我们了解岩石。

peregrination.en: His peregrination took him across Europe.
peregrination.zh: 他的徒步旅行带他穿越了欧洲。

peregrination.en: She wrote about her peregrination in Asia.
peregrination.zh: 她写了关于亚洲旅程的文章。

pandemic.en: The pandemic affected the whole world.
pandemic.zh: 大流行病影响了整个世界。
大流行的疾病迅速传播。

imposture.zh: 他的欺诈很快被发现了。

rive.en: The storm rived the old tree.
He rived the wood with an axe.

recantation.zh: 他的放弃信仰让所有人吃惊。

recantation.en: She made a public recantation of her views.
recantation.zh: 她公开改变了自己的观点。

loutish.en: His loutish behavior annoyed the guests.
loutish.zh: 他粗野的行为惹恼了客人。
那个粗野的男人大声喊叫。

libertine.en: He lived as a libertine in his youth.
libertine.zh: 他年轻时过着放荡者的生活。

libertine.en: The libertine ignored all moral rules.
libertine.zh: 那个放荡者无视所有道德规则。

disjunctive.zh: 这个论点使用了选言推理。
分离的从句分隔了想法。

bibliophile.en: The bibliophile owned thousands of books.
bibliophile.zh: 那位藏书家拥有数千本书。

bibliophile.en: She is a true bibliophile who loves reading.
bibliophile.zh: 她是一个真正爱书的人，热爱阅读。

uproarious.en: The party was uproarious and full of laughter.
uproarious.zh: 派对喧嚣热闹，充满了笑声。

uproarious.en: His joke caused an uproarious response from the crowd.
uproarious.zh: 他的笑话引起了人群的喧闹反应。

ramify.en: The tree roots ramify in many directions.
The river ramifies into smaller streams.
ramify.zh: 这条河分叉成更小的溪流。

neologism.en: The word 'selfie' is a popular neologism.
neologism.zh: '自拍'这个词是一个流行的新语。

neologism.en: She invented a neologism for the new technology.
neologism.zh: 她为这项新技术创造了一个新词。

augury.en: The dark clouds were an augury of rain.
He saw the bird as a good augury.
augury.zh: 他把那只鸟视为好兆头。

prehensile.en: Monkeys have prehensile tails for grasping branches.
prehensile.zh: 猴子有能抓握的尾巴来抓住树枝。

prehensile.en: Her prehensile mind quickly understood the complex idea.
prehensile.zh: 她善于领会的头脑迅速理解了复杂的概念。

hallow.en: They hallow the ground where the hero died.
hallow.zh: 他们使英雄牺牲之地变得神圣。

hallow.en: The church hallows this day every year.
hallow.zh: 教堂每年都使这一天成为圣日。

chipmunk.en: A chipmunk ran across the garden path.
chipmunk.zh: 一只金花鼠跑过花园小径。

chipmunk.en: The chipmunk stored nuts in its cheek pouches.
chipmunk.zh: 金花鼠把坚果储存在颊囊里。

wrangler.en: The wrangler argued loudly about the rules.
wrangler.zh: 那个争论者大声争论规则。

wrangler.en: He is a wrangler who never backs down.
wrangler.zh: 他是一个从不退缩的争论者。

immunize.en: Doctors immunize children against many diseases.
immunize.zh: 医生使儿童对许多疾病免疫。

immunize.en: The vaccine will immunize you from the flu.
immunize.zh: 疫苗将使你对流感免疫。

encyclopedic.en: He has an encyclopedic knowledge of history.
encyclopedic.zh: 他有百科全书式的历史知识。
她百科全书式的记忆力让所有人惊讶。

asphyxia.en: Asphyxia can occur from drowning or choking.
asphyxia.zh: 窒息可能由溺水或窒息引起。

asphyxia.en: The lack of oxygen caused asphyxia.

crepuscular.en: Bats are crepuscular animals that fly at dusk.
crepuscular.zh: 蝙蝠是在黄昏飞行的微光动物。

crepuscular.en: The crepuscular light made the forest look magical.
crepuscular.zh: 微光使森林看起来神奇。

braggart.en: The braggart boasted about his wealth all night.
braggart.zh: 那个吹牛者整晚吹嘘他的财富。

braggart.en: Nobody likes a braggart who never listens.
braggart.zh: 没人喜欢从不听别人说话的吹牛者。

disbar.en: The court decided to disbar the dishonest lawyer.
disbar.zh: 法庭决定剥夺那个不诚实律师的资格。

disbar.en: He was disbarred for unethical behavior.
disbar.zh: 他因不道德行为被剥夺律师资格。

lode.en: Miners discovered a rich lode of gold.
lode.zh: 矿工发现了一条丰富的金矿脉。

lode.en: The lode contained valuable silver ore.
lode.zh: 这条矿脉含有珍贵的银矿石。

pugilist.en: The pugilist trained hard for the championship fight.
pugilist.zh: 拳击手为冠军赛刻苦训练。

pugilist.en: He became a famous pugilist in his country.
pugilist.zh: 他在自己的国家成了著名的拳击手。

lasso.en: The cowboy used a lasso to catch the horse.
He learned how to lasso cattle on the ranch.
lasso.zh: 他在牧场学会了如何用套索捕牛。

forswear.en: He decided to forswear smoking for his health.
forswear.zh: 他决定为了健康发誓戒烟。

forswear.en: She forswore her old habits and started fresh.
forswear.zh: 她发誓抛弃旧习惯，重新开始。

cringing.en: His cringing behavior annoyed his colleagues.
cringing.zh: 他奉承的行为惹恼了同事。

cringing.en: She gave a cringing apology to the boss.

counterpoise.en: The weight acts as a counterpoise to the load.
counterpoise.zh: 这个砝码作为负载的平衡物。

counterpoise.en: They used a stone to counterpoise the lever.
counterpoise.zh: 他们用一块石头来平衡杠杆。

careworn.en: The mother looked careworn after her long illness.
careworn.zh: 母亲在长期生病后看起来忧心忡忡。

careworn.en: His careworn face showed the stress of work.
careworn.zh: 他忧心忡忡的脸显示了工作的压力。

acerbity.en: The lemon's acerbity made her pucker her lips.
acerbity.zh: 柠檬的酸味让她噘起了嘴。

acerbity.en: His acerbity in the argument hurt everyone's feelings.
acerbity.zh: 他在争论中的尖刻伤害了每个人的感情。

traduce.en: He tried to traduce his rival's reputation.
traduce.zh: 他试图诽谤对手的名誉。

traduce.en: The article traduced the politician unfairly.
traduce.zh: 那篇文章不公正地中伤了那位政治家。

sibilant.en: The snake made a sibilant sound in the grass.
sibilant.zh: 蛇在草丛中发出咝咝声。

sibilant.en: The letter 's' is a sibilant consonant.

scabrous.en: The comedian told a scabrous joke that shocked the audience.
scabrous.zh: 喜剧演员讲了一个猥亵的笑话，震惊了观众。

scabrous.en: The book contained scabrous material not for children.
scabrous.zh: 这本书包含不适合儿童的猥亵内容。

rigor.en: The scientific rigor of the study was impressive.
rigor.zh: 这项研究的科学严谨性令人印象深刻。

rigor.en: He endured the rigor of the harsh winter.
rigor.zh: 他忍受了严酷冬天的苛刻。

rhinestone.en: Her dress was decorated with rhinestones.
rhinestone.zh: 她的裙子装饰着莱茵石。

rhinestone.en: The rhinestone necklace looked like real diamonds.
rhinestone.zh: 莱茵石项链看起来像真钻石。

mendacity.en: His mendacity made it hard to trust him.
mendacity.zh: 他的虚伪让人很难信任他。

mendacity.en: The politician's mendacity was exposed by the press.
mendacity.zh: 那位政治家的谎话被媒体揭露了。

masticate.en: You should masticate your food thoroughly.
The cow masticates grass slowly in the field.

leery.en: She was leery of strangers offering help.
leery.zh: 她对提供帮助的陌生人猜疑。

leery.en: He is leery about investing in risky stocks.
leery.zh: 他对投资风险股票很猜疑。

intercessor.en: The intercessor helped resolve the dispute between them.
intercessor.zh: 调解人帮助解决了他们之间的争端。

intercessor.en: She acted as an intercessor for the two parties.
intercessor.zh: 她充当了双方的调解人。

imbroglio.en: The political imbroglio lasted for months.
Their argument created an imbroglio at the meeting.
imbroglio.zh: 他们的争论在会议上造成了一团糟。

eviscerate.en: The chef eviscerated the fish before cooking.
eviscerate.zh: 厨师在烹饪前取出了鱼的内脏。

eviscerate.en: The new law eviscerated the old regulations.
eviscerate.zh: 新法律废除了旧规定中的精华。

desuetude.en: The old custom fell into desuetude over time.
desuetude.zh: 旧习俗随时间废止不用了。

desuetude.en: The law is in desuetude and rarely enforced.
desuetude.zh: 这项法律已废止，很少执行。

comport.en: She comports herself with dignity at all times.
His actions do not comport with his words.
comport.zh: 他的行为与言语不相称。

ceremonious.en: The wedding was a ceremonious event with many rituals.
ceremonious.zh: 婚礼是一个隆重的活动，有许多仪式。

ceremonious.en: He gave a ceremonious bow to the queen.

barefaced.en: He told a barefaced lie to his parents.
barefaced.zh: 他对父母说了个无耻的谎言。

barefaced.en: Her barefaced cheating was caught on camera.
barefaced.zh: 她公然的作弊被摄像头拍到了。

windbag.en: The speaker was a windbag who talked for hours.
windbag.zh: 那个演讲者是个空话连篇的人，讲了几个小时。

windbag.en: Nobody wanted to listen to the windbag's stories.
windbag.zh: 没人想听那个空话连篇的人的故事。

vaporize.en: The sun will vaporize the water in the puddle.
vaporize.zh: 太阳会使水坑里的水蒸发。

vaporize.en: The heat vaporized the liquid quickly.

procreate.en: Many animals procreate in the spring season.
They decided to procreate and start a family.
procreate.zh: 他们决定生育并组建家庭。

precipitant.en: The chemist added a precipitant to the solution.
precipitant.zh: 化学家向溶液中加入了一种沉淀剂。

precipitant.en: A precipitant caused the solid to form quickly.
precipitant.zh: 一种沉淀剂使固体迅速形成。

plagiarize.en: Students should never plagiarize their essays.
plagiarize.zh: 学生绝不应该抄袭他们的论文。

plagiarize.en: He tried to plagiarize from a famous book.
plagiarize.zh: 他试图从一本著名的书中抄袭。

perjure.en: The witness chose to perjure herself in court.
perjure.zh: 证人选择在法庭上作伪证。

perjure.en: Do not perjure yourself during the trial.
perjure.zh: 在审判期间不要作伪证。

malinger.en: He tried to malinger to avoid the exam.
malinger.zh: 他试图装病以逃避考试。

malinger.en: She would malinger to get out of work.

lubricious.en: The lubricious surface made the floor dangerous.
lubricious.zh: 光滑的表面使地板很危险。

lubricious.en: Be careful on the lubricious wet road.
lubricious.zh: 在光滑的湿路上要小心。

incandescence.en: The metal glowed with incandescence in the fire.
incandescence.zh: 金属在火中发出白热光。

incandescence.en: Incandescence from the bulb lit the room.
incandescence.zh: 灯泡的白炽光照亮了房间。

heliotrope.en: The garden had a beautiful purple heliotrope.
heliotrope.zh: 花园里有一株美丽的紫色天芥菜。

heliotrope.en: She wore a dress the color of heliotrope.
heliotrope.zh: 她穿了一件淡紫色的裙子。

hawser.en: The sailor tied the hawser to the dock.
hawser.zh: 水手把大缆系在码头上。

hawser.en: A thick hawser held the ship in place.
hawser.zh: 一根粗大的系船索把船固定住了。

gloaming.en: They walked home in the soft gloaming.
gloaming.zh: 他们在柔和的暮色中走回家。

gloaming.en: The stars appeared during the gloaming.

excitability.en: Her excitability made her jump at every sound.
excitability.zh: 她的易兴奋性使她听到每个声音都跳起来。

excitability.en: The child's excitability was hard to control.
excitability.zh: 孩子的激动性很难控制。

enervate.en: The long illness began to enervate him.
enervate.zh: 漫长的疾病开始使他衰弱。

enervate.en: Heat can enervate even the strongest person.
enervate.zh: 炎热甚至能使最强壮的人衰弱。

egotist.en: The egotist only talked about himself.
egotist.zh: 那个自我中心主义者只谈论他自己。

egotist.en: An egotist rarely listens to others.
egotist.zh: 自我中心主义者很少听别人说话。

colloquy.en: They had a formal colloquy about the treaty.
colloquy.zh: 他们就条约进行了一次正式会谈。

colloquy.en: The colloquy lasted for several hours.
colloquy.zh: 这次会谈持续了几个小时。

venial.en: His mistake was venial and easily forgiven.
venial.zh: 他的错误是可原谅的，很容易被宽恕。

venial.en: She committed only a venial sin.
venial.zh: 她只犯了一个轻微的罪过。

tare.en: The tare weight of the box is two pounds.
tare.zh: 这个盒子的皮重是两磅。

tare.en: Farmers removed the tare from the wheat.
tare.zh: 农民们从小麦中除去了稗子。

shipwright.en: The shipwright built a strong wooden boat.
shipwright.zh: 造船木匠造了一艘坚固的木船。

shipwright.en: A skilled shipwright worked on the vessel.
shipwright.zh: 一位熟练的造船木匠在船上工作。

sequestrate.en: The court decided to sequestrate his property.
sequestrate.zh: 法院决定扣押他的财产。

sequestrate.en: They sequestrate the funds until the trial.
sequestrate.zh: 他们扣押资金直到审判。

homogenize.en: The machine helps homogenize the milk.
homogenize.zh: 这台机器帮助使牛奶均匀。

homogenize.en: They homogenize the mixture for a smooth texture.
homogenize.zh: 他们使混合物均匀以获得光滑的质地。

eugenic.en: Eugenic policies are controversial in history.
eugenic.zh: 优生政策在历史上是有争议的。

eugenic.en: They studied eugenic improvements in plants.
eugenic.zh: 他们研究了植物的优种改良。

gardenia.en: The gardenia has a lovely white flower.
gardenia.zh: 栀子花有可爱的白色花朵。

gardenia.en: She smelled the sweet gardenia in the garden.
gardenia.zh: 她闻到了花园里甜美的栀子花。

welsh.en: He learned to speak Welsh fluently.
welsh.zh: 他学会了流利地说威尔士语。

welsh.en: She is from a Welsh family.
welsh.zh: 她来自一个威尔士家庭。

fissile.en: The rock is fissile and breaks easily.
fissile.zh: 这种岩石易分裂，容易破碎。

exculpate.en: The evidence helped exculpate the suspect.
exculpate.zh: 证据帮助开脱了嫌疑人的罪名。

exculpate.en: He tried to exculpate himself from blame.
exculpate.zh: 他试图为自己开脱责任。

espy.en: She could espy a ship on the horizon.
espy.zh: 她能望见地平线上的一艘船。

espy.en: He espied a bird in the tree.

monochromatic.en: The room was decorated in monochromatic colors.
He prefers monochromatic light for photography.
monochromatic.zh: 他更喜欢单色光用于摄影。

medicate.en: The doctor will medicate the patient's wound.
medicate.zh: 医生会给病人的伤口用药。

medicate.en: She needs to medicate her cat for fleas.
medicate.zh: 她需要给她的猫用药治疗跳蚤。

locution.en: That locution is common in legal documents.
locution.zh: 那种措辞在法律文件中很常见。

locution.en: He used an old-fashioned locution in his speech.
locution.zh: 他在演讲中用了过时的表达方式。

potentiate.en: This drug can potentiate the effect of alcohol.
potentiate.zh: 这种药可以加强酒精的效果。

potentiate.en: Exercise may potentiate the benefits of the treatment.
potentiate.zh: 锻炼可能加强治疗的好处。

irremediable.en: The damage to the painting was irremediable.
irremediable.zh: 对这幅画的损害是无法挽回的。

irremediable.en: His mistake led to irremediable consequences.
irremediable.zh: 他的错误导致了无法挽回的后果。

ligature.en: The doctor used a ligature to stop the bleeding.
In music, a ligature connects two notes.
ligature.zh: 在音乐中，连音线连接两个音符。

diminuendo.en: The music ended with a long diminuendo.
diminuendo.zh: 音乐以一段很长的渐弱结束。

diminuendo.en: The singer's voice faded in a diminuendo.
diminuendo.zh: 歌手的声音以渐弱消失。

logjam.en: There was a logjam in the river.
The meeting hit a logjam over the budget.
logjam.zh: 会议在预算问题上陷入了僵局。

externalize.en: He tends to externalize his feelings.
externalize.zh: 他倾向于外化他的感受。

externalize.en: The artist externalizes her thoughts in paintings.
externalize.zh: 艺术家在画作中外化她的想法。

fosse.en: The castle was surrounded by a deep fosse.
They dug a fosse for defense.
fosse.zh: 他们挖了一条防御用的壕沟。

hearken.en: Hearken to the sound of the birds.
He asked them to hearken to his words.

potpourri.en: The potpourri smelled of lavender and roses.
potpourri.zh: 百花香闻起来有薰衣草和玫瑰的味道。

potpourri.en: She made a potpourri from dried flowers.
potpourri.zh: 她用干花做了一罐百花香。

atonal.en: The music was atonal and hard to follow.
atonal.zh: 音乐是无调性的，很难跟上。

atonal.en: He composed an atonal piece for piano.
atonal.zh: 他创作了一首无调性的钢琴曲。

dissonant.en: The dissonant chords made the audience uncomfortable.
dissonant.zh: 不和谐的和弦让观众感到不舒服。

dissonant.en: Their opinions were dissonant with each other.
dissonant.zh: 他们的意见彼此不一致。

shiftless.en: The shiftless man never looked for a job.
shiftless.zh: 那个懒惰的人从不找工作。

shiftless.en: His shiftless attitude frustrated his parents.
shiftless.zh: 他偷懒的态度让父母很沮丧。

impolitic.en: It was impolitic to criticize the boss publicly.
impolitic.zh: 公开批评老板是失策的。

impolitic.en: His impolitic remarks caused a lot of trouble.
impolitic.zh: 他不得当的言论引起了很多麻烦。

hirsute.en: The hirsute man had a thick beard.
hirsute.zh: 那个多毛的男人留着浓密的胡子。

hirsute.en: Her hirsute arms were covered in hair.
hirsute.zh: 她多毛的手臂上长满了汗毛。

equivocate.en: Politicians often equivocate to avoid answering.
equivocate.zh: 政客们常常支吾其词以避免回答。

equivocate.en: Don't equivocate; just tell me the truth.
equivocate.zh: 别含糊其辞，直接告诉我真相。

trammel.en: The trammel held the horse in place.
trammel.zh: 那副拘束具把马固定住了。

trammel.en: He felt no trammel on his freedom.
trammel.zh: 他感觉不到自由受到任何束缚。

purgative.en: The doctor gave him a purgative medicine.
purgative.zh: 医生给了他一种通便的药。

purgative.en: This purgative will clean his system.
purgative.zh: 这种泻药会清理他的身体系统。

prepossessing.en: Her smile was very prepossessing and warm.
prepossessing.zh: 她的微笑非常讨人喜欢且温暖。

prepossessing.en: He has a prepossessing appearance and manner.
prepossessing.zh: 他有着讨人喜欢的外表和举止。

huckster.en: The huckster sold cheap goods on the street.
huckster.zh: 那个小贩在街上卖廉价商品。

huckster.en: A huckster shouted loudly to attract customers.
huckster.zh: 一个小贩大声叫卖以吸引顾客。

hangdog.en: He gave a hangdog look after being caught.
hangdog.zh: 被抓后他露出了一副卑躬屈膝的表情。

hangdog.en: Her hangdog expression showed her guilt.
hangdog.zh: 她鬼鬼祟祟的表情显露出她的内疚。

defoliate.en: The chemicals defoliate the trees in autumn.
defoliate.zh: 这些化学物质在秋天使树木落叶。

defoliate.en: Insects can defoliate an entire forest quickly.
defoliate.zh: 昆虫能迅速使整片森林落叶。

stentorian.en: His stentorian voice filled the large hall.
stentorian.zh: 他洪亮的声音充满了整个大厅。

stentorian.en: The teacher used a stentorian tone to command.
stentorian.zh: 老师用洪亮的语调发号施令。

saturnine.en: His saturnine expression made everyone uneasy.
saturnine.zh: 他阴沉的脸色让每个人都不安。

saturnine.en: She had a saturnine personality and rarely smiled.

meddlesome.en: The meddlesome neighbor always asks questions.
meddlesome.zh: 那个爱管闲事的邻居总是问问题。

meddlesome.en: Her meddlesome behavior annoyed everyone around.
meddlesome.zh: 她好干涉的行为惹恼了周围的人。

defoliant.en: The army used defoliant to clear the jungle.
defoliant.zh: 军队使用落叶剂来清理丛林。

defoliant.en: Defoliant is sprayed on crops to remove leaves.
defoliant.zh: 落叶剂被喷洒在作物上以去除叶子。

bifurcate.en: The road will bifurcate into two paths ahead.
bifurcate.zh: 这条路在前面会分叉成两条小径。

bifurcate.en: The river bifurcates near the old bridge.
bifurcate.zh: 这条河在老桥附近分叉。

addle.en: The heat will addle the eggs if left out.
addle.zh: 如果放在外面，热量会使鸡蛋腐坏。

addle.en: His confusing speech seemed to addle my mind.
addle.zh: 他令人困惑的演讲似乎使我的头脑昏乱。

abnegation.en: His abnegation of power surprised everyone.
abnegation.zh: 他对权力的放弃让所有人惊讶。

abnegation.en: Abnegation of selfish desires is a virtue.
abnegation.zh: 克制自私的欲望是一种美德。

warmonger.en: The warmonger urged the country to start war.
warmonger.zh: 那个战争贩子鼓动国家发动战争。

warmonger.en: People protested against the warmonger's speech.
warmonger.zh: 人们抗议那个战争贩子的演讲。

unregenerate.en: He remained unregenerate despite many warnings.
unregenerate.zh: 尽管多次警告，他仍然顽固不化。

unregenerate.en: Her unregenerate attitude led to more trouble.
unregenerate.zh: 她不悔改的态度导致了更多麻烦。

paunchy.en: The paunchy man struggled to tie his shoes.
paunchy.zh: 那个大腹便便的男人费力地系鞋带。

paunchy.en: He became paunchy after years of overeating.
paunchy.zh: 经过多年暴饮暴食，他变得大腹便便。

hydrate.en: Drink water to hydrate your body after exercise.
hydrate.zh: 运动后喝水以补充身体水分。

hydrate.en: The cream helps hydrate dry skin effectively.
hydrate.zh: 这种面霜能有效补充干燥皮肤的水分。

dodder.en: The old man began to dodder as he walked.
dodder.zh: 那位老人走路时开始蹒跚。

dodder.en: She watched the plant dodder in the wind.
dodder.zh: 她看着那株植物在风中摇摆。

cession.en: The cession of land ended the long dispute.
cession.zh: 土地的割让结束了长期的争端。

cession.en: They agreed to the cession of their rights.
cession.zh: 他们同意转让他们的权利。

sopping.en: He came inside with sopping wet clothes.
sopping.zh: 他进来时衣服浑身湿透。

sopping.en: The ground was sopping after the heavy rain.

inadvertence.en: The error was due to simple inadvertence.
inadvertence.zh: 这个错误是由于单纯的粗心大意。

inadvertence.en: His inadvertence caused a small accident.
inadvertence.zh: 他的漫不经心导致了一场小事故。

incorporeal.en: Ghosts are often described as incorporeal beings.
incorporeal.zh: 鬼魂常被描述为无形的存在。

incorporeal.en: The idea of justice is incorporeal yet powerful.
incorporeal.zh: 正义的概念是无形的，但很强大。

discography.en: I read the band's discography online.
discography.zh: 我在网上看了这个乐队的唱片目录。

discography.en: Her discography includes ten studio albums.
discography.zh: 她的唱片目录包括十张录音室专辑。

filibuster.en: The senator used a filibuster to delay the vote.
filibuster.zh: 那位参议员用冗长演说拖延投票。

filibuster.en: They planned to filibuster the new bill.
filibuster.zh: 他们计划用冗长演说阻挠新法案。

sextant.en: The sailor used a sextant to navigate at sea.
sextant.zh: 水手用六分仪在海上导航。

sextant.en: A sextant measures the angle between stars.
sextant.zh: 六分仪测量星星之间的角度。

wanderlust.en: Her wanderlust took her to many countries.
wanderlust.zh: 她的漫游癖带她去了许多国家。

wanderlust.en: He has a strong wanderlust and loves travel.
wanderlust.zh: 他有强烈的流浪癖，热爱旅行。

panegyric.en: The speech was a panegyric to the hero.
panegyric.zh: 那篇演讲是对英雄的赞颂。

panegyric.en: She wrote a panegyric for her late teacher.
panegyric.zh: 她为已故的老师写了一篇颂词。

parturition.en: Parturition is the process of giving birth.

parturition.zh: 医生在分娩过程中提供协助。

gusher.en: The oil well turned out to be a gusher.
gusher.zh: 那口油井结果是个喷油井。

gusher.en: A gusher erupted, spilling oil everywhere.
gusher.zh: 一口自喷井喷发，石油四处飞溅。

effluvia.en: The effluvia from the factory smelled terrible.
effluvia.zh: 工厂排出的臭气难闻极了。

effluvia.en: Effluvia from the swamp made the air foul.
effluvia.zh: 沼泽的泄出物使空气变得污浊。

oracular.en: His oracular statements were hard to understand.
oracular.zh: 他神谕般的陈述很难理解。

oracular.en: The priest gave an oracular response to the question.
oracular.zh: 牧师对问题给出了神谕式的回答。

prate.en: Stop your prate and listen to me.
His prate about nothing bored everyone.
prate.zh: 他关于无聊事的空谈让所有人厌烦。

plutocracy.en: The country was ruled by a plutocracy.
Plutocracy often ignores the needs of the poor.
plutocracy.zh: 富豪统治常常忽视穷人的需求。

ossify.en: Cartilage can ossify into bone over time.
ossify.zh: 软骨会随时间骨化成骨头。

ossify.en: His opinions began to ossify as he aged.
ossify.zh: 随着年龄增长，他的观点开始僵化。

mountebank.en: The mountebank tricked people with fake medicine.
mountebank.zh: 那个江湖郎中用药骗人。

mountebank.en: Don't trust that mountebank at the fair.
mountebank.zh: 别相信集市上那个骗子。

hie.en: Hie yourself to the store before it closes.
She hied away from the danger quickly.

garble.en: The message was garbled during transmission.
garble.zh: 信息在传输过程中被曲解了。

garble.en: Don't garble the facts to suit your story.
garble.zh: 不要为了迎合你的说法而混淆事实。

factitious.en: The smile on his face seemed factitious.
factitious.zh: 他脸上的微笑似乎不自然。

factitious.en: They created a factitious demand for the product.
factitious.zh: 他们为产品制造了人为的需求。

dolt.en: He is such a dolt for forgetting the keys.
dolt.zh: 他真是个笨蛋，竟然忘了钥匙。

dolt.en: Don't be a dolt; read the instructions first.

broil.en: We will broil the chicken for dinner.
The sun began to broil the beach sand.
broil.zh: 太阳开始烤热沙滩的沙子。

befuddle.en: The loud noise seemed to befuddle the old man.
befuddle.zh: 巨大的噪音似乎让老人昏沉。

befuddle.en: Too much information can befuddle a student.
befuddle.zh: 太多信息会让学生迷惑。

asinine.en: That was an asinine thing to say.

asinine.zh: 他愚蠢的行为惹恼了所有人。

abash.en: Her rude comment did not abash him.
abash.zh: 她粗鲁的评论没有让他羞愧。

abash.en: The public praise seemed to abash the shy girl.
abash.zh: 公开的赞扬似乎让害羞的女孩不安。

quotidian.en: She enjoys the quotidian routine of morning coffee.
quotidian.zh: 她喜欢早晨咖啡的日常习惯。

quotidian.en: His life was full of quotidian tasks.
quotidian.zh: 他的生活充满了平凡的任务。

quadruped.en: A dog is a common quadruped animal.
quadruped.zh: 狗是一种常见的四足动物。

pusillanimous.en: His pusillanimous decision surprised no one.
pusillanimous.zh: 他胆怯的决定没人感到意外。

pusillanimous.en: A leader cannot be pusillanimous in a crisis.
pusillanimous.zh: 领导者在危机中不能胆怯。

incommensurate.en: The reward was incommensurate with the effort.
His skills are incommensurate to the job.
incommensurate.zh: 他的技能与工作不相适应。

gastronomy.en: He studied gastronomy in culinary school.
gastronomy.zh: 他在烹饪学校学习美食法。

bathetic.en: The movie's ending was too bathetic for me.
bathetic.zh: 电影的结局对我来说太陈腐了。

bathetic.en: His bathetic speech made everyone roll their eyes.
bathetic.zh: 他陈腐的演讲让所有人翻白眼。

vernal.en: The vernal equinox marks the start of spring.
vernal.zh: 春分标志着春天的开始。

vernal.en: Vernal flowers bloom in the garden.
vernal.zh: 春天的花朵在花园里绽放。

splashy.en: The splashy water soaked my shoes.
splashy.zh: 溅起的水弄湿了我的鞋子。

splashy.en: Kids love splashy puddles after rain.
splashy.zh: 孩子们喜欢雨后泥泞的水坑。

restiveness.en: The restiveness of the crowd was obvious.
restiveness.zh: 人群的焦躁不安显而易见。

restiveness.en: His restiveness grew during the long meeting.
restiveness.zh: 在漫长的会议中，他的焦躁不安加剧了。

pesky.en: Those pesky mosquitoes keep me awake.
pesky.zh: 那些讨厌的蚊子让我睡不着。

pesky.en: I have a pesky cold that won't go away.
pesky.zh: 我得了个讨厌的感冒，一直不好。

palliate.en: Medicine can palliate the pain but not cure it.

sidesplitting.zh: 她令人捧腹大笑的故事让每个人都笑出了泪。

sloven.zh: 那个懒散的人从不打扫房间。

tightfisted.zh: 那个吝啬的人从不分享他的钱。

ultramundane.zh: 他研究地球之外的超俗现象。

ultramundane.zh: 超俗生命的想法让许多人着迷。

undergird.zh: 教育应该支持孩子的发展。

undisputable.zh: 她的才华是无可置疑的事实。

ungrudging.zh: 她慷慨地支持她的朋友。

unguent.zh: 把这种软膏涂在干燥的皮肤上。

unscrupulousness.zh: 他的不择手段导致了不道德的决定。

unscrupulousness.zh: 这家公司的狂妄伤害了许多人。

unspotted.zh: 白布使用后依然无污点。

unthreatening.zh: 这只狗看起来不具威胁且友好。

unthreatening.zh: 他不具威胁的态度让每个人放松。

ursine.zh: 那只像熊的动物在森林里游荡。

ursine.zh: 他有着熊一般的外貌，毛发浓密。

uxorious.en: The uxorious husband always obeyed his wife.
uxorious.zh: 那个怕老婆的丈夫总是听从妻子。

uxorious.zh: 他溺爱妻子的行为常被开玩笑。

valetudinarian.zh: 那个过分担心健康的人担心每一个小疼痛。

valetudinarian.zh: 他像个病弱的人一样生活，总是小心翼翼。

variegate.zh: 用不同的花使花园多样化。

vaunting.zh: 他自吹自擂的态度惹恼了同事。

vaunting.zh: 她发表了一篇吹嘘自己成功的演讲。

veracious.zh: 她真实的叙述得到了每个人的信任。

verisimilar.en: The story seemed verisimilar and believable.
verisimilar.zh: 这个故事看起来真实可信。

verisimilar.zh: 一个貌似真实的解释让观众满意。

viands.zh: 他们为长途旅行准备了食物。

vicissitudinous.zh: 人生充满变迁，变化无常。

vicissitudinous.zh: 她多变的职业生涯有许多起伏。

vitrify.zh: 热量可以将沙子玻璃化。

paper.zh: 她在一张纸上写了一封信。

england.zh: 他出生在英格兰，但住在法国。

refund.zh: 商店很快处理了我的退款。

malaria.zh: 疟疾在许多国家是一种严重的疾病。

alaska.zh: 她想明年夏天去阿拉斯加。

piety.zh: 她的虔诚通过每日祈祷表现出来。

piety.en: Piety is important in many religions.
piety.zh: 虔诚在许多宗教中很重要。

heartbeat.zh: 跑步后我能感觉到自己的心跳。

recycled.zh: 这个瓶子是用回收塑料制成的。

phd.en: She earned her PhD in biology.
phd.zh: 她获得了生物学博士学位。

phd.en: He is studying for a PhD in history.

audition.zh: 她去参加了话剧的试演。

rivers.zh: 许多河流流经这个山谷。

sarcasm.zh: 讽刺并不总是容易理解。

raincoat.en: I wear a raincoat when it rains.

raincoat.zh: 她为旅行买了一件新雨衣。

prospectus.zh: 大学给学生寄了一份招生简章。

null.en: The contract was declared null and void.
The result of the test is null.

interviewee.en: The interviewee answered all questions well.
interviewee.zh: 被面试者很好地回答了所有问题。

interviewee.en: Each interviewee had ten minutes to talk.
interviewee.zh: 每个被采访者有十分钟发言时间。

forbes.en: She reads Forbes for business news.
forbes.zh: 她读福布斯获取商业新闻。

childcare.zh: 好的儿童照管对上班的父母很重要。

childcare.zh: 他们在房子附近找到了负担得起的儿童保育。

helpline.en: Call the helpline if you need help.
helpline.zh: 如果你需要帮助，请拨打热线电话。

helpline.zh: 热线服务电话全天24小时开放。

gaily.en: The children ran gaily through the park.
gaily.zh: 孩子们欢乐地跑过公园。

gaily.en: She dressed gaily for the party.

multilateral.zh: 他们签署了一项多边贸易协定。

healthcare.en: Good healthcare is essential for everyone.
healthcare.zh: 良好的医疗保健对每个人都很重要。

healthcare.en: She works in the healthcare industry.
healthcare.zh: 她在医疗保健行业工作。

arduous.en: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
arduous.zh: 爬山是一项费力的任务。

arduous.zh: 她安全完成了这段费力的旅程。

lax.en: The security at the airport was lax.
lax.zh: 机场的安全措施不严格。

lax.en: He has a lax attitude toward homework.

treble.en: The treble voice is very high.
treble.zh: 最高声部的声音非常高。

treble.en: His income will treble this year.
treble.zh: 他的收入今年将增至三倍。

tolerable.en: The pain is tolerable with medicine.
tolerable.zh: 疼痛在服药后是可容忍的。

tolerable.en: The weather was tolerable for a walk.

outdated.en: This computer is outdated and slow.
outdated.zh: 这台电脑过时了，而且很慢。

outdated.en: Her fashion style is a bit outdated.
outdated.zh: 她的时尚风格有点过时。

abort.en: They had to abort the mission due to weather.
abort.zh: 由于天气原因，他们不得不中止任务。

outlying.en: They live in an outlying village.
outlying.zh: 他们住在一个边远的村庄。

outlying.en: The outlying areas are less populated.

fervent.en: She is a fervent supporter of the team.
fervent.zh: 她是球队的热心支持者。

fervent.en: His fervent speech moved the audience.
fervent.zh: 他热心的演讲感动了观众。

posterity.en: We must protect nature for posterity.
posterity.zh: 我们必须为后代保护自然。

posterity.en: These records will be kept for posterity.

hijack.en: The police stopped the hijack of the plane.
They tried to hijack the truck.

unconvincing.en: His excuse was unconvincing to everyone.
unconvincing.zh: 他的借口对每个人来说都不足以令人相信。

unconvincing.en: The actor gave an unconvincing performance.
unconvincing.zh: 演员的表演不足以令人相信。

overrun.en: Weeds overrun the garden every summer.
overrun.zh: 杂草每年夏天蔓延整个花园。

laborious.en: Cleaning the attic was a laborious task.
laborious.zh: 打扫阁楼是一项艰苦的任务。

laborious.en: He finished the laborious work by noon.
laborious.zh: 他在中午前完成了费劲的工作。

inspiring.en: Her speech was truly inspiring to everyone.
inspiring.zh: 她的演讲确实鼓舞了每个人。

inspiring.en: The inspiring movie made me feel hopeful.
inspiring.zh: 这部鼓舞人心的电影让我感到充满希望。

apologetic.en: He gave an apologetic smile after the mistake.
apologetic.zh: 犯错后他露出了道歉的微笑。

apologetic.en: She sounded apologetic on the phone.
apologetic.zh: 她在电话里听起来很抱歉。

incongruous.en: The modern chair looked incongruous in the old room.
incongruous.zh: 现代椅子在老房间里显得不协调。

incongruous.en: His joke was incongruous with the serious meeting.
incongruous.zh: 他的笑话与严肃的会议不一致。

photocopy.zh: 我需要影印这些页面上课用。

scapegoat.zh: 他成了团队失败的替罪羊。

scapegoat.en: Don't scapegoat others for your own mistakes.
scapegoat.zh: 不要把自己的错误归咎于别人。

safari.en: We went on a safari in Kenya last year.
safari.zh: 我们去年在肯尼亚进行了一次旅行。

safari.en: The safari allowed us to see lions up close.
safari.zh: 这次旅行让我们近距离看到了狮子。

mishap.en: A small mishap delayed our trip by an hour.
mishap.zh: 一个小意外使我们的旅行延误了一小时。

mishap.en: He had a mishap while cooking dinner.
mishap.zh: 他在做晚饭时出了点小事故。

righteous.en: She is known for her righteous anger at injustice.
righteous.zh: 她以对不公的正义愤怒而闻名。

righteous.en: He lived a righteous and honest life.
righteous.zh: 他过着正直诚实的生活。

upkeep.zh: 维护这栋老房子很昂贵。

upkeep.en: Regular upkeep keeps the car running well.
upkeep.zh: 定期保养让车运行良好。

outcast.zh: 他在新学校感到像个被遗弃的人。

outcast.en: The outcast found a new home in the village.
outcast.zh: 这个流浪者在村子里找到了新家。

deflate.zh: 他的批评似乎削弱了她的信心。

supposition.en: That is just a supposition, not a fact.
supposition.zh: 那只是一个推测，不是事实。

supposition.en: We based our plan on a false supposition.
supposition.zh: 我们的计划基于一个错误的假设。

physique.en: He has a strong and athletic physique.
physique.zh: 他拥有强壮健美的体格。
定期锻炼能改善你的体形。

bounty.en: The farmer shared the bounty of his harvest.
bounty.zh: 农夫分享了他丰收的慷慨礼物。

bounty.en: A bounty was offered for the capture of the thief.
bounty.zh: 为抓捕小偷提供了赏金。

mannerism.en: He has a habit of tapping his foot as a mannerism.
mannerism.zh: 他有敲脚的习惯性动作。

mannerism.en: Her mannerism of biting her lip is noticeable.
mannerism.zh: 她咬嘴唇的习惯性动作很明显。

cliche.zh: 避免在写作中使用陈词滥调。

cliche.zh: 那句谚语已经成了陈腐的套话。

maniac.en: He drives like a maniac on the highway.
maniac.zh: 他在高速公路上开车像个疯子。

maniac.en: She is a maniac about keeping the house clean.
maniac.zh: 她对保持房子干净有狂热。

placard.zh: 一张海报宣布了商店的盛大开业。

ultimatum.zh: 老板给了他完成工作的最后通牒。

ultimatum.en: They issued an ultimatum to the opposing team.
ultimatum.zh: 他们向对方队伍发出了最后通牒。

cola.zh: 我点餐时要了一杯冰可乐。

cola.en: She prefers cola over other soft drinks.
cola.zh: 她更喜欢可乐而不是其他软饮料。

bookcase.en: The bookcase is filled with novels and textbooks.
bookcase.zh: 书架上摆满了小说和教科书。

bookcase.zh: 他为房间做了一个木书架。

funnel.en: Use a funnel to pour the oil into the bottle.
funnel.zh: 用漏斗把油倒进瓶子里。

sectional.en: The sectional view shows the inside of the engine.

malnutrition.en: Malnutrition is a serious problem in some countries.

malnutrition.en: The child suffered from malnutrition due to poverty.
malnutrition.zh: 这个孩子因贫困而营养不良。

psychiatry.en: She decided to study psychiatry at university.
psychiatry.zh: 她决定在大学学习精神病学。

psychiatry.en: Psychiatry helps people with mental health issues.
psychiatry.zh: 精神病学帮助有心理健康问题的人。

sieve.en: Use a sieve to separate the flour from lumps.
sieve.zh: 用筛子把面粉和结块分开。

sieve.en: She sieved the sand to remove the pebbles.
sieve.zh: 她筛了沙子以去除小石子。

pharmacy.zh: 她在一家繁忙的药房做药剂师。

hiring.en: The company is hiring new employees this month.
hiring.zh: 公司这个月正在招聘新员工。

hiring.en: Hiring the right person is very important.
hiring.zh: 雇用合适的人非常重要。

rainwater.en: We collect rainwater for the garden plants.
rainwater.zh: 我们收集雨水用于花园植物。

rainwater.en: Rainwater is clean and good for washing cars.

superstructure.en: The ship's superstructure was painted white.
superstructure.zh: 船的上层建筑被漆成了白色。

superstructure.en: The building's superstructure is made of steel.
superstructure.zh: 建筑的上部结构由钢制成。

cashier.en: The cashier gave me the correct change.
cashier.zh: 出纳员给了我正确的找零。

cashier.en: She works as a cashier at the supermarket.

westerner.en: A westerner visited our small village last week.
westerner.zh: 上周一个西方人访问了我们的小村庄。

westerner.en: Many westerners enjoy learning about Asian culture.
westerner.zh: 许多西方人喜欢了解亚洲文化。

potion.en: The witch brewed a magical potion in her cauldron.
potion.zh: 女巫在她的锅里煮了一种魔法药水。

potion.en: He drank a potion to cure his illness.
potion.zh: 他喝了一种药剂来治病。

seafood.en: We had fresh seafood for dinner last night.
seafood.zh: 我们昨晚晚餐吃了新鲜海鲜。

seafood.en: She loves seafood like shrimp and crab.
seafood.zh: 她喜欢虾和蟹之类的海鲜。

subcommittee.en: The subcommittee will review the new policy.
subcommittee.zh: 小组委员会将审查新政策。

subcommittee.en: She was appointed to the finance subcommittee.
subcommittee.zh: 她被任命为财务小组委员会成员。

optic.en: The optic nerve sends signals to the brain.
optic.zh: 视神经向大脑发送信号。

optic.en: He studied optic fibers in his engineering class.
optic.zh: 他在工程课上学习了光纤。

insolvent.en: The company became insolvent and closed down.

insolvent.zh: 他被法院宣告无力偿还债务。

thesaurus.en: Use a thesaurus to find synonyms for common words.
thesaurus.zh: 使用同义词词典查找常见词的同义词。

thesaurus.en: The thesaurus helped me improve my vocabulary.
thesaurus.zh: 同义词词典帮助我提高了词汇量。

annuity.en: She receives an annuity every month.

annuity.zh: 他的年金提供稳定的收入。

yoga.en: Yoga helps me relax and focus.
yoga.zh: 瑜伽帮助我放松和集中注意力。

reflectance.zh: 科学家测量表面反射率。

scrupulous.zh: 她是个一丝不苟的工人。

paraphernalia.en: The artist's paraphernalia filled the room.
paraphernalia.zh: 艺术家的用具堆满了房间。

vehement.en: Her speech was vehement and powerful.

invincible.zh: 今天这支队伍感觉无敌。
他的精神确实不可战胜。

laudable.zh: 她的努力确实值得赞赏。
那是一个值得称赞的目标。

perceptible.en: There was a perceptible change in temperature.

perceptible.zh: 她脸上能看出淡淡的微笑。

perturb.en: The news did not perturb him.

microcosm.en: The garden is a microcosm of nature.
microcosm.zh: 这个花园是大自然的缩影。

microcosm.en: This town is a microcosm of society.
microcosm.zh: 这个小镇是社会的缩影。

walls.en: The walls of the house are white.

walls.zh: 我们把墙壁刷成了蓝色。

downtown.en: The downtown area is very busy.

memorise.en: She tried to memorise the poem.
You need to memorise these words.

palatable.zh: 她觉得这个想法可以接受。

equivocal.zh: 她给出了一个含糊的回应。

piracy.en: Piracy is a serious crime at sea.
piracy.zh: 海盗行为在海上是一种严重犯罪。

condolence.en: We sent our condolences to the family.
condolence.zh: 我们向家属表达了哀悼。

escalator.en: Take the escalator to the second floor.
The escalator is not working today.

ruinous.zh: 洪水造成了毁灭性的破坏。
他的消费习惯是毁灭性的。

laden.en: The truck was laden with goods.

starch.en: Potatoes contain a lot of starch.
She used starch to stiffen the collar.

excrement.en: The dog left excrement on the lawn.
excrement.zh: 狗在草坪上留下了粪便。

storehouse.en: The old building is a storehouse.
This book is a storehouse of knowledge.

sicken.zh: 暴力让大多数人感到厌恶。

carcase.en: The carcase of the deer was found.

fluff.en: There is fluff on your sweater.
She fluffed her lines on stage.

madden.zh: 他不停的抱怨激怒了她。

oblong.en: The table is oblong in shape.
She drew an oblong on the paper.
oblong.zh: 她在纸上画了一个长方形。

wager.en: He placed a wager on the race.

perplexity.en: He looked at me in perplexity.

perplexity.zh: 这个问题引起了极大的困惑。

bookshelf.en: The bookshelf is full of books.
Please put the book on the bookshelf.

sundial.en: The garden has an old sundial.
A sundial tells time by the sun.

outdo.en: She tried to outdo her brother.
He outdid himself in the exam.
outdo.zh: 他在考试中超越了自己。

reinforced.en: The wall is reinforced with steel.
They reinforced the bridge for safety.
reinforced.zh: 他们加固了桥梁以确保安全。

bedsit.en: She rents a small bedsit near the university.
bedsit.zh: 她在大学附近租了一间小卧室兼起居室。

bedsit.en: His bedsit is cozy but very compact.
bedsit.zh: 他的卧室兼起居室很舒适但非常紧凑。

accuser.en: The accuser presented strong evidence in court.
accuser.zh: 控诉者在法庭上出示了强有力的证据。

accuser.en: Her accuser finally admitted he was wrong.
accuser.zh: 她的指控者最终承认自己错了。

misconceive.en: Do not misconceive my intentions; I mean well.
misconceive.zh: 不要误解我的意图；我是好意。

misconceive.en: Many people misconceive the purpose of this law.
misconceive.zh: 许多人误解了这项法律的目的。

paternity.en: The test confirmed his paternity of the child.
paternity.zh: 测试确认了他对孩子的父亲身份。

paternity.en: He proudly accepted paternity of the newborn.
paternity.zh: 他自豪地接受了新生儿的父亲身份。

reverent.en: The students were reverent during the ceremony.
reverent.zh: 学生们在仪式上非常恭敬。

reverent.en: She spoke in a reverent tone about the tradition.
reverent.zh: 她以虔诚的语气谈论这个传统。

misdeed.en: He apologized for his past misdeed.
misdeed.zh: 他为自己过去的不端行为道歉。

misdeed.en: The misdeed was quickly discovered by the teacher.
misdeed.zh: 这个不端行为很快被老师发现了。

shamble.en: The old man began to shamble down the street.
shamble.zh: 老人开始蹒跚地沿街走去。

shamble.en: After the long run, he could only shamble home.
