vacillation.zh: 踌躇不决常常导致错失机会。

byword.en: His name became a byword for honesty.
byword.zh: 他的名字成了诚实的代名词。

byword.en: That company is a byword for quality products.
byword.zh: 那家公司是优质产品的代名词。

fortuitously.en: We fortuitously met an old friend at the park.
fortuitously.zh: 我们偶然在公园遇到了一位老朋友。

fortuitously.en: She fortuitously found the lost keys under the sofa.
fortuitously.zh: 她偶然在沙发下找到了丢失的钥匙。

homespun.en: She wore a simple homespun dress to the party.
homespun.zh: 她穿了一件简朴的土布裙子去派对。

homespun.en: His homespun advice was full of wisdom.
homespun.zh: 他朴实的建议充满了智慧。

matchless.en: Her matchless beauty captivated everyone in the room.
matchless.zh: 她无比的美丽迷住了房间里的每个人。

matchless.en: The athlete showed matchless skill during the game.
matchless.zh: 这位运动员在比赛中展现了无比的技巧。

breakup.en: Their breakup was very sad for both of them.
breakup.zh: 他们的分手对双方都很伤心。

breakup.en: The breakup of the ice sheet was dramatic.

boastful.en: His boastful attitude annoyed his classmates.
boastful.zh: 他自夸的态度惹恼了同学。

boastful.en: She tried not to sound boastful about her success.
boastful.zh: 她尽量不让自己的成功听起来自夸。

reputed.en: He is reputed to be a very generous person.
reputed.zh: 他被认为是一个非常慷慨的人。

reputed.en: This restaurant is reputed for its delicious seafood.
reputed.zh: 这家餐厅以美味的海鲜闻名。

connivance.en: The crime happened with the connivance of the guard.
connivance.zh: 这起犯罪是在守卫的纵容下发生的。

connivance.en: Connivance in illegal activities is unacceptable.
connivance.zh: 纵容非法活动是不可接受的。

slavish.en: His slavish imitation of the artist was obvious.
slavish.zh: 他对那位艺术家的盲从模仿很明显。

slavish.en: She rejected a slavish adherence to tradition.

dismembered.en: The dismembered body was found in the forest.
dismembered.zh: 被肢解的尸体在森林中被发现。

dismembered.en: The toy was dismembered after the dog played with it.
dismembered.zh: 玩具被狗玩过后肢解了。

bashful.en: The bashful child hid behind his mother.
bashful.zh: 害羞的孩子躲在他妈妈身后。

bashful.en: She gave a bashful smile when praised.
bashful.zh: 被表扬时她害羞地笑了笑。

agonize.en: She would agonize over every small decision.
agonize.zh: 她会为每个小决定感到痛苦。

agonize.en: Don't agonize too much about the test results.
agonize.zh: 不要太为考试结果感到痛苦。

interconnected.en: All the systems in the building are interconnected.
interconnected.zh: 大楼里所有系统都是互相连接的。

interconnected.en: Our lives are interconnected in many ways.
interconnected.zh: 我们的生活以多种方式互相联系。

unbridgeable.en: There was an unbridgeable gap between their opinions.
unbridgeable.zh: 他们的意见之间存在无法逾越的鸿沟。

unbridgeable.en: The cultural differences seemed unbridgeable at first.
unbridgeable.zh: 起初文化差异似乎无法逾越。

satirist.en: The satirist made fun of political leaders.
satirist.zh: 讽刺作家取笑政治领袖。

satirist.en: A good satirist uses humor to criticize society.
satirist.zh: 好的讽刺作家用幽默批评社会。

dawning.en: The dawning sun painted the sky orange.
dawning.zh: 初升的太阳把天空染成橙色。

dawning.en: At dawning, the birds began to sing.

perennially.en: This plant blooms perennially in the garden.
perennially.zh: 这种植物在花园里常年开花。

perennially.en: He is perennially optimistic about the future.

vivacity.en: Her vivacity made her the life of the party.
vivacity.zh: 她的活泼使她成为派对的核心。

vivacity.en: The child's vivacity was contagious to everyone.
vivacity.zh: 孩子的活泼感染了每个人。

immobilize.en: The doctor had to immobilize the broken arm.
immobilize.zh: 医生必须固定住骨折的手臂。

immobilize.en: Heavy snow can immobilize a city's traffic.
immobilize.zh: 大雪能使城市交通瘫痪。

designing.en: Her designing nature made others distrust her.
designing.zh: 她诡诈的本性使别人不信任她。

designing.en: He was known for his designing schemes.

herculean.en: It was a herculean task to finish on time.
herculean.zh: 按时完成是一项艰巨的任务。

herculean.en: He made a herculean effort to lift the heavy box.
herculean.zh: 他用了巨大的力气抬起沉重的箱子。

mingling.en: The mingling of colors created a beautiful painting.
mingling.zh: 颜色的混合创造了一幅美丽的画。

mingling.en: Guests were mingling and chatting at the party.
mingling.zh: 客人们在派对上交往聊天。

foretell.en: No one can foretell the future with certainty.
foretell.zh: 没有人能确切预言未来。

foretell.en: Dark clouds often foretell a coming storm.
foretell.zh: 乌云常常预示暴风雨来临。

escapist.en: He is an escapist who reads fantasy novels all day.
escapist.zh: 他是个整天读奇幻小说的逃避现实者。

escapist.en: Escapist movies help people forget their problems.
escapist.zh: 逃避现实的电影帮助人们忘记问题。

swiftness.en: The swiftness of the cheetah amazed the tourists.
swiftness.zh: 猎豹的迅速令游客惊叹。

swiftness.en: He completed the task with remarkable swiftness.
swiftness.zh: 他以惊人的迅速完成了任务。

gusty.en: Gusty winds made it hard to walk outside.
gusty.zh: 阵阵强风使外面行走困难。

gusty.en: The gusty weather forced the picnic to be canceled.
gusty.zh: 刮风的天气迫使野餐取消。

lubrication.en: Proper lubrication keeps the engine running smoothly.
lubrication.zh: 适当的润滑使发动机平稳运行。

lubrication.en: The mechanic checked the lubrication of all parts.
lubrication.zh: 机械师检查了所有部件的润滑情况。

gemstone.en: She wore a beautiful gemstone on her finger.
gemstone.zh: 她手指上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

gemstone.en: This gemstone is very rare and valuable.
gemstone.zh: 这颗宝石非常稀有且珍贵。

aquamarine.en: The sea looked aquamarine in the sunlight.
aquamarine.zh: 大海在阳光下呈现海蓝色。

aquamarine.en: She chose an aquamarine dress for the party.
aquamarine.zh: 她为派对选了一件海蓝色的裙子。

barrenness.en: The barrenness of the desert surprised us.
barrenness.zh: 沙漠的贫瘠让我们惊讶。

barrenness.en: Barrenness can be a difficult condition to treat.
barrenness.zh: 不孕症可能是一种难以治疗的状况。

disorganize.en: The sudden change will disorganize our plans.
disorganize.zh: 突然的变化会打乱我们的计划。

disorganize.en: Don't disorganize the files on my desk.

insufferable.en: His insufferable attitude made everyone angry.
insufferable.zh: 他难以忍受的态度让每个人都生气。

insufferable.en: The heat in the room was insufferable.
insufferable.zh: 房间里的热让人无法忍受。

economize.en: We need to economize on water during summer.
economize.zh: 夏天我们需要节约用水。

economize.en: She tries to economize by buying in bulk.
economize.zh: 她试图通过批量购买来节省开支。

harmonica.en: He played a beautiful tune on the harmonica.
harmonica.zh: 他用口琴吹奏了一首优美的曲子。

harmonica.en: The child learned to play the harmonica quickly.
harmonica.zh: 那个孩子很快学会了吹口琴。

satiate.en: The large meal did not satiate his hunger.
satiate.zh: 那顿大餐并没有满足他的饥饿。

satiate.en: She felt satiate after eating the whole cake.
satiate.zh: 吃完整个蛋糕后，她感到饱足了。

fruitlessly.en: He searched fruitlessly for his lost keys.
fruitlessly.zh: 他徒劳地寻找丢失的钥匙。

fruitlessly.en: They argued fruitlessly about the problem.
fruitlessly.zh: 他们无益地争论这个问题。

dime.en: I found a dime on the sidewalk today.
dime.zh: 我今天在人行道上找到了一枚10分硬币。

dime.en: A dime is worth ten cents in the US.
dime.zh: 在美国，一枚10分硬币值十美分。

aglow.en: Her face was aglow with happiness.
The sky was aglow with the setting sun.

knapsack.en: He carried his lunch in a small knapsack.
knapsack.zh: 他把午餐装在一个小背包里。

knapsack.en: The hiker packed his knapsack for the trip.
knapsack.zh: 徒步旅行者为旅行打包了背包。

gyration.en: The dancer's gyration amazed the audience.
gyration.zh: 舞者的旋转让观众惊叹。

gyration.en: The gyration of the wheel was smooth.

flighty.en: She is too flighty to focus on one job.
flighty.zh: 她太轻浮了，无法专注于一份工作。

flighty.en: His flighty behavior annoyed his friends.
flighty.zh: 他轻狂的行为惹恼了朋友们。

synthesizer.en: The musician used a synthesizer for the song.
synthesizer.zh: 音乐家为这首歌使用了合成器。

synthesizer.en: A synthesizer can create many different sounds.
synthesizer.zh: 合成器可以创造许多不同的声音。

scaled.en: The scaled armor protected the knight well.
scaled.zh: 鳞甲很好地保护了骑士。

scaled.en: The fish had a beautifully scaled body.
scaled.zh: 那条鱼有着美丽的鳞片身体。

abashed.en: He felt abashed after making a mistake.
She was abashed by the unexpected compliment.
abashed.zh: 她因意外的赞美而局促不安。

subspecies.en: This bird is a subspecies of the common sparrow.
subspecies.zh: 这种鸟是普通麻雀的一个亚种。

subspecies.en: Scientists discovered a new subspecies of frog.
subspecies.zh: 科学家发现了一种新的青蛙亚种。

cohere.en: The team's ideas cohere into a strong plan.
cohere.zh: 团队的想法凝聚成一个强有力的计划。

cohere.en: These two parts do not cohere well together.
cohere.zh: 这两个部分不能很好地粘合在一起。

rancher.en: The rancher raised cattle on the open land.
rancher.zh: 牧场主在开阔的土地上养牛。

rancher.en: A rancher must care for many animals daily.
rancher.zh: 牧场主每天必须照顾许多动物。

interconnecting.en: The interconnecting roads make travel easy.
interconnecting.zh: 相互连接的道路使旅行变得容易。

interconnecting.en: These interconnecting pipes carry water to the house.
interconnecting.zh: 这些相互连接的管道把水输送到房子。

trumpeter.en: The trumpeter played a loud and clear note.
trumpeter.zh: 小号手吹奏了一个响亮而清晰的音符。

trumpeter.en: A skilled trumpeter led the marching band.
trumpeter.zh: 一位熟练的小号手带领着行进乐队。

irreverence.en: His irreverence towards tradition shocked many.
irreverence.zh: 他对传统的不敬让许多人震惊。

irreverence.en: The comedian's irreverence made the audience laugh.
irreverence.zh: 喜剧演员的不敬让观众大笑。

dignify.en: We should dignify our work with pride.
dignify.zh: 我们应该以自豪来使工作高贵。

dignify.en: The ceremony will dignify the occasion.
dignify.zh: 这个仪式将使场合增威严。

mainspring.en: The mainspring of the watch broke yesterday.
mainspring.zh: 手表的主发条昨天断了。

mainspring.en: Curiosity is the mainspring of scientific discovery.
mainspring.zh: 好奇心是科学发现的主要动力。

constricted.en: The snake's body constricted around its prey.
constricted.zh: 蛇的身体压缩在猎物周围。

constricted.en: He felt constricted in the small room.
constricted.zh: 他在小房间里感到压抑。

systematize.en: We need to systematize our filing system.
systematize.zh: 我们需要使归档系统化。

systematize.en: The manager wants to systematize all processes.
systematize.zh: 经理想把所有流程系统化。

rattlesnake.en: A rattlesnake can be very dangerous.
We heard a rattlesnake in the desert.
rattlesnake.zh: 我们在沙漠里听到了一条响尾蛇。

swampy.en: The swampy ground made walking difficult.
swampy.zh: 沼泽的地面使行走困难。

swampy.en: They built a house in a swampy area.
swampy.zh: 他们在沼泽地区建了一所房子。

cellist.en: The cellist played a beautiful melody.
cellist.zh: 大提琴演奏家演奏了一首优美的旋律。

cellist.en: A famous cellist performed at the concert.
cellist.zh: 一位著名的大提琴家在音乐会上表演。

alliteration.en: The poem uses alliteration for effect.
alliteration.zh: 这首诗使用头韵来增强效果。

alliteration.en: Alliteration repeats the same starting sound.
alliteration.zh: 头韵重复相同的起始音。

unobstructed.en: The view from the hill was unobstructed.
unobstructed.zh: 从山丘上看到的景色没有阻挡。

unobstructed.en: We need an unobstructed path to the door.
unobstructed.zh: 我们需要一条没有障碍的通往门的路。

overbalance.en: The heavy load caused the cart to overbalance.
He overbalanced and fell off the ladder.
overbalance.zh: 他失去平衡从梯子上摔了下来。

pinion.en: The mechanic replaced the broken pinion gear.
pinion.zh: 机械师更换了损坏的小齿轮。

pinion.en: They had to pinion the prisoner's arms.
pinion.zh: 他们不得不绑住囚犯的两臂。

lyricist.en: The lyricist wrote beautiful words for the song.
lyricist.zh: 歌词作者为这首歌写了优美的词。

lyricist.en: A good lyricist can tell a story with words.
lyricist.zh: 一个好的歌词作者可以用词讲故事。

swelter.en: We swelter in the heat of summer.
swelter.zh: 我们在夏天的炎热中汗流浃背。

swelter.en: The workers swelter under the hot sun.
swelter.zh: 工人们在烈日下闷热难耐。

lyrically.en: She sang lyrically and moved the audience.
lyrically.zh: 她抒情地歌唱，感动了观众。

lyrically.en: The poem was written lyrically with emotion.
lyrically.zh: 这首诗写得充满情感和诗意。

propellant.en: The rocket uses liquid propellant for power.
propellant.zh: 火箭使用液体推进剂提供动力。

propellant.en: This spray can contains a safe propellant.
propellant.zh: 这个喷雾罐含有安全的推进剂。

touched.en: She was deeply touched by his kindness.
touched.zh: 她被他的善良深深感动了。

touched.en: He touched the soft fabric gently.
touched.zh: 他轻轻地触摸了柔软的布料。

martinet.en: The teacher is a strict martinet about rules.
martinet.zh: 这位老师对规则是个严格的纪律执行者。

martinet.en: A martinet demands perfect order in the classroom.
martinet.zh: 一个严格执行纪律的人要求教室完美有序。

spanking.en: The child received a spanking for misbehaving.
spanking.zh: 孩子因行为不当被打屁股。

spanking.en: A spanking wind blew the leaves away.

gainful.en: She found gainful employment at the bank.
gainful.zh: 她在银行找到了有报酬的工作。

gainful.en: Gainful work provides a steady income.
gainful.zh: 有收益的工作提供稳定收入。

conjectural.en: His theory is purely conjectural and unproven.
conjectural.zh: 他的理论纯粹是推测性的，未经证实。
推测性的陈述需要更多证据。

condenser.en: The condenser turns steam into water.
condenser.zh: 冷凝器将蒸汽转化为水。

condenser.en: A condenser is used in the cooling system.

gymnastic.en: She performs gymnastic exercises every morning.
gymnastic.zh: 她每天早上做体操练习。

gymnastic.en: Gymnastic skills require strength and flexibility.
gymnastic.zh: 体操技能需要力量和柔韧性。

dietitian.en: The dietitian recommended a balanced meal plan.
dietitian.zh: 营养学家推荐了均衡的饮食计划。

dietitian.en: A dietitian helps people eat healthier foods.
dietitian.zh: 营养学家帮助人们吃更健康的食物。

polygonal.en: The building has a polygonal shape.
polygonal.zh: 这座建筑有多边形形状。

polygonal.en: Polygonal tiles cover the floor beautifully.
polygonal.zh: 多边形瓷砖漂亮地覆盖了地板。

overtax.en: The government should not overtax its citizens.
overtax.zh: 政府不应过度征税给公民。

overtax.en: Don't overtax yourself with too much work.
overtax.zh: 不要用太多工作使自己负担过重。

regimentation.en: Regimentation in schools can limit creativity.
regimentation.zh: 学校中的严格控制可能限制创造力。

regimentation.en: The military relies on regimentation for order.
regimentation.zh: 军队依靠严格控制来维持秩序。

mechanized.en: The factory uses mechanized assembly lines.
mechanized.zh: 工厂使用机械化装配线。
机械化农业提高了作物产量。

dehydrated.en: He felt dehydrated after running in the sun.
dehydrated.zh: 他在阳光下跑步后感到脱水。

dehydrated.en: Dehydrated fruits are a healthy snack.
dehydrated.zh: 脱水水果是一种健康零食。

meteorologist.en: The meteorologist predicted rain for tomorrow.
meteorologist.zh: 气象学家预测明天有雨。

meteorologist.en: A meteorologist studies weather patterns carefully.
meteorologist.zh: 气象学家仔细研究天气模式。

prototypical.en: This is a prototypical example of modern art.
prototypical.zh: 这是现代艺术的一个原型例子。

prototypical.en: The prototypical design was later improved.
prototypical.zh: 原型设计后来得到了改进。

facilitation.en: Good facilitation helps the team work better.
facilitation.zh: 良好的促进有助于团队更好地工作。

facilitation.en: Facilitation of learning is the teacher's goal.
facilitation.zh: 促进学习是老师的目标。

walkout.en: The workers staged a walkout for better pay.
walkout.zh: 工人们为争取更高工资举行了罢工。

walkout.en: Her walkout from the meeting surprised everyone.
walkout.zh: 她退出会议让所有人惊讶。

irresolute.en: He was irresolute about which job to take.
irresolute.zh: 他对接受哪份工作犹豫不决。

irresolute.en: An irresolute leader cannot make quick decisions.
irresolute.zh: 一个优柔寡断的领导者无法快速做决定。

wingspan.en: The eagle has a huge wingspan of two meters.
wingspan.zh: 这只鹰有两米的巨大翼展。

wingspan.en: A plane's wingspan affects its flight stability.
wingspan.zh: 飞机的翼展影响其飞行稳定性。

platitudinous.en: His speech was full of platitudinous remarks.
platitudinous.zh: 他的演讲充满了陈词滥调。
老生常谈的建议常常听起来毫无意义。

impious.en: The impious man showed no respect for religion.
impious.zh: 那个不敬神的人对宗教毫无尊重。

impious.en: Impious actions are frowned upon in this community.
impious.zh: 不虔诚的行为在这个社区不受欢迎。

fruitfulness.en: The fruitfulness of the land ensures good harvests.
fruitfulness.zh: 土地的肥沃确保了好的收成。

fruitfulness.en: Fruitfulness in research leads to new discoveries.
fruitfulness.zh: 研究的丰硕成果带来新发现。

undistorted.en: The mirror shows an undistorted reflection.
undistorted.zh: 镜子显示未失真的反射。

undistorted.en: We need undistorted facts for a fair decision.
undistorted.zh: 我们需要未歪曲的事实来做出公正决定。

frugality.en: Frugality helps them save money for the future.
frugality.zh: 节俭帮助他们为未来存钱。

frugality.en: Her frugality is admired by her friends.
frugality.zh: 她的节俭受到朋友们的钦佩。

fireproof.en: The safe is fireproof and protects documents.
fireproof.zh: 这个保险箱是防火的，保护文件。

fireproof.en: They fireproof the building with special materials.
fireproof.zh: 他们用特殊材料使建筑防火。

colloquialism.en: “Gonna” is a common colloquialism in English.
Using colloquialisms makes speech sound natural.
colloquialism.zh: 使用口语表达使说话听起来自然。

clamorous.en: The clamorous crowd demanded immediate action.
clamorous.zh: 吵闹的人群要求立即行动。

clamorous.en: A clamorous argument broke out in the hall.
clamorous.zh: 大厅里爆发了吵闹的争论。

brawling.en: The brawling in the street disturbed the neighbors.
brawling.zh: 街上的吵闹打扰了邻居。

brawling.en: Brawling is not allowed in this quiet park.
brawling.zh: 在这个安静的公园里不允许吵架。

landmass.en: Africa is a large landmass with diverse cultures.
landmass.zh: 非洲是一个拥有多样文化的大陆块。

landmass.en: The landmass of Australia is mostly desert.
landmass.zh: 澳大利亚的陆块大部分是沙漠。

aggravating.en: The aggravating noise made it hard to sleep.
aggravating.zh: 恼人的噪音让人难以入睡。

aggravating.en: His aggravating behavior annoyed everyone in the room.
